duas.title: Prophetic Du'a for Guidance (Sahih Muslim)
duas.intro: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. Then he said:

parts.arabic: اِهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
parts.transliteration: Ihdini limakhtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi'idhnika innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratim mustaqim
parts.translation: Guide me to the truth concerning that wherein there has been difference, by Your permission. Indeed, You guide whom You will to a straight path.

duas.title: Dua for Good manners (Masnoon Dua)
duas.intro: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. Here is a part of it -

parts.arabic: وَاهْدِنِيْ لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِيْ لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
parts.transliteration: Wahdini li ahsanil-akhlaaqi, la yahdi li ahsanihaa illa anta wasrif anni sayyi'ahaa laa yasrifu anni sayyi'ahaa illa anta
parts.translation: And guide me to the best of manners; none guides to the best of them except You. And turn away from me the bad of them; none turns away from me the bad of them except You.

duas.title: Powerful Night Prayer in Witr (Dua Qunoot)
duas.intro: Narrated Al-Hasan ibn Ali (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught me some words that I say during the witr -

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِيْ فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِيْ فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ إِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَلَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
parts.transliteration: Allahum-mahdinee feeman hadayta, wa 'aafinee feeman 'aafayta, wa tawallanee feeman tawallayta, wa baarik lee feemaa 'a'atayta, wa qinee sharra maa qadhayta, fa'innaka taqdhee wa laa yuqdhaa 'alayka, 'innahu laa yadhillu man waalayta, wa laa ya 'izzu man 'aadayta, tabaarakta Rabbanaa wa ta'aalayta
parts.translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For indeed, You decree and no decree is made against You. Indeed, he is not humiliated whom You ally with, nor is he honored whom You take as an enemy. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted.

duas.title: The Power of Daily Istighfar (Hadith)
duas.subcategory: The most important thing to ask Allah for
duas.intro: Forgiveness for sins should be sought from Allah, for the most important thing a servant can ask his Lord for, is forgiveness for his sins or its inevitable consequence. Such as deliverance from Hell and entry into Paradise. The servant needs forgiveness from his Lord for his sins, because he makes mistakes every day and night and Allah alone can forgive all sins. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My heart is invaded by unmindfulness, and I ask Allah's pardon a hundred times in the day.

parts.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
parts.transliteration: Innahu layughaanu 'alaa qalbee, wa innee la'astaghfirullaaha fil-yawmi mi'ata marrah.
parts.translation: Indeed, a covering is surely placed over my heart, and indeed I surely ask Allah for forgiveness a hundred times in a day.

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ

duas.title: Dhikr for Forgiveness (Subhanallah Wa Bihamdihi Dua)
duas.subcategory: Excellence of doing Tasbeeh, Tahmid, Tahlil, Takbeer

parts.intro: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah). And those are -
parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.arabic_alt: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهٖ، سُبْحانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظِيْمِ
parts.transliteration: SubhaanAllahi wa bihamdihi, Subhaanal-laahil-'Adheem
parts.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, glory be to Allah, the Most Great.

duas.raw_markdown:
The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah). And those are -

سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهٖ، سُبْحانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظِيْمِ

SubhaanAllahi wa bihamdihi, Subhaanal-laahil-'Adheem

Translation

Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, glory be to Allah, the Most Great.

ReferenceBukhari: 6406

duas.title: Dua After Adhan that gets Accepted (Hadith)
duas.subcategory: Times and places when dua will be accepted

parts.intro: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As (RA): A man said: O Messenger of Allah, the mu'adhdhins excel us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Say (the same words) as they say, and when you come to the end, ask Allah for anything and that will be granted to you.
parts.arabic: قُلْ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ فَإِذَا انْتَهَيْتَ فَسَلْ تُعْطَهْ
parts.transliteration: Qul kamaa yaqooloona, fa'idhan-tahayta fasal tu'tah
parts.translation: Say as they say, and when you finish, ask, you will be given [it].

duas.title: Hadith on Dua After Adhan
duas.subcategory: Times and places when dua will be accepted

parts.intro: Anas (RA) said, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, when the call to prayer (adhan) is given, the gates of heaven are opened and the dua is accepted.
parts.arabic: إذا نُودِيَ بالصَّلاةِ فُتِحَت أبوابُ السَّماءِ، واستُجيبَ الدُّعاءُ
parts.transliteration: Idhaa noodiya bis-salaati futihat abwaabus-samaa'i, wastujeebad-du'aa'
parts.translation: When the call to prayer is made, the gates of heaven are opened, and supplication is answered.
parts.note: Al-Albani graded this hadith sahih through its combined chains (Silsila Sahihah 1413). Al-Daraqutni held that it is authentic only as the words of Anas (RA), not of the Prophet (ﷺ). Supplication at the time of the call to prayer is also established in other authentic hadith: Abu Dawud 2540, and between the adhan and iqamah in Abu Dawud 521 and Tirmidhi 212.

duas.raw_markdown:

duas.title: Benefit of Laylatul Qadr Surah
duas.subcategory: Times and places when dua will be accepted

parts.intro: Allah (SWT) says -
parts.arabic: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ ﴿١﴾ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ ﴿٢﴾ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ ﴿٣﴾ تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ ﴿٤﴾ سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ ﴿٥﴾
parts.arabic_alt: اِنَّا اَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ ﴿١﴾ وَمَا اَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ ﴿٢﴾ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ ﴿٣﴾ تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوْحُ فِيْهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِّن كُلِّ اَمْرٍ ﴿٤﴾ سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتّٰي مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ ﴿٥﴾
parts.translation: Indeed, We sent it down in the Night of Decree. (1) And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree? (2) The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. (3) The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter. (4) Peace it is until the emergence of dawn. (5)

Allah (SWT) says -

إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ ﴿١﴾ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ ﴿٢﴾ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ ﴿٣﴾ تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ ﴿٤﴾ سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ ﴿٥﴾

اِنَّا اَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ ﴿١﴾ وَمَا اَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ ﴿٢﴾ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ ﴿٣﴾ تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوْحُ فِيْهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِّن كُلِّ اَمْرٍ ﴿٤﴾ سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتّٰي مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ ﴿٥﴾

Translation

Indeed, We sent it down in the Night of Decree. (1) And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree? (2) The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. (3) The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter. (4) Peace it is until the emergence of dawn. (5)

ReferenceSurah Al-Qadr 97:1-5

duas.title: Dua for Absent Muslims (Hadith)

parts.intro: Narrated from Umm Darda (RA), she said to Safwan (RA), Do you intend to perform Hajj during this year? I said: Yes. She said: Do supplicate Allah for blessings upon us, for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to say: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother at his back (in his absence) is responded so long as he makes a supplica tion for blessings for his brother and the commissioned Angel says: Amen, and says: May it be for you too.
parts.arabic: دَعْوَةُ الْمَرْءِ الْمُسْلِمِ لِأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ مَلَكٌ مُوَكَّلٌ كُلَّمَا دَعَا لِأَخِيهِ بِخَيْرٍ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ الْمُوَكَّلُ بِهِ آمِينَ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ
parts.transliteration: Da'watul-mar'il-muslimi li'akheehi bizahril-ghaybi mustajaabatun, 'inda ra'sihi malakun muwakkalun, kullamaa da'aa li'akheehi bikhayrin qaalal-malakul-muwakkalu bihi: aameen, wa laka bimithl.
parts.translation: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother in his absence is answered. At his head is an appointed angel; whenever he supplicates for his brother for good, the angel appointed to him says, "Ameen, and for you the same."

duas.title: Dua for Oppressed Person

parts.intro: Prophet (ﷺ) said,"Be afraid of the curse of an oppressed person because there is no screen between his invocation and Allah."
parts.arabic: اتَّقُوا دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُومِ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ حِجَابٌ
parts.transliteration: Ittaqoo da'watal-mazloomi, fa'innahu laysa baynahaa wa baynallaahi hijaab.
parts.translation: Fear the supplication of the oppressed, for indeed, there is no barrier between it and Allah.

duas.raw_markdown:
Prophet (ﷺ) said,"Be afraid of the curse of an oppressed person because there is no screen between his invocation and Allah."

اتَّقُوا دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُومِ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ حِجَابٌ

Ittaqoo da'watal-mazloomi, fa'innahu laysa baynahaa wa baynallaahi hijaab.

Translation

Fear the supplication of the oppressed, for indeed, there is no barrier between it and Allah.

ReferenceBukhari: 1496

duas.title: Dua of the Oppressed: Real Hadith Example

parts.intro: An example of the supplication of the oppressed being accepted is the incident of Saad (RA) with Abu Sa'dah. When asked about Saad (RA), Sa'dah said, "As you have put us under an oath; I am bound to tell you that Sa`d never went himself with the army and never distributed (the war booty) equally and never did justice in legal verdicts." (On hearing it) Sa`d said, "I pray to Allah for three things: O Allah! If this slave of yours is a liar and got up for showing off, give him a long life, increase his poverty and put him to trials." (And so it happened). Later on when that person was asked how he was, he used to reply that he was an old man in trial as the result of Sa`d's curse.
parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ عَبْدُكَ هَذَا كَاذِبًا قَامَ رِيَاءً وَسُمْعَةً فَأَطِلْ عُمْرَهُ وَأَطِلْ فَقْرَهُ وَعَرِّضْهُ لِلْفِتَنِ
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma in kaana 'abduka haadhaa kaadhiban, qaama riyaa'an wa sum'atan, fa'atil 'umrahu wa atil faqrahu wa 'arridhu lil-fitan.
parts.translation: O Allah, if this servant of Yours is a liar and stood up for show and fame, then prolong his life, prolong his poverty, and expose him to trials.
parts.note: `Abdul Malik (RA), the sub narrator, said that he had seen him afterwards and his eyebrows were overhanging his eyes owing to old age and he used to tease and assault the small girls in the way.

(And so it happened). Later on when that person was asked how he was, he used to reply that he was an old man in trial as the result of Sa`d's curse.

duas.title: Rewards of Morning & Evening Dhikr (Hadith)
duas.subcategory: Excellence of dua in the morning & evening

parts.intro: Anas (RA) said that he heard the Prophet (SAW) say: "That I sit with people remembering Almighty Allah from the morning (Fajr) prayer until sunrise is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il. That I sit with people remembering Allah from the afternoon ('Asr) prayer until the sun sets is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il."
parts.arabic: لَأَنْ أَقْعُدَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَلَأَنْ أَقْعُدَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَةً
parts.transliteration: La'an aq'uda ma'a qawmin yadhkuroonallaaha ta'aalaa min salaatil-ghadaati hattaa tatlu'ash-shamsu ahabbu ilayya min an u'tiqa arba'atan min waladi Ismaa'eel, wa la'an aq'uda ma'a qawmin yadhkuroonallaaha min salaatil-'asri ilaa an taghrubash-shamsu ahabbu ilayya min an u'tiqa arba'ah.
parts.translation: That I sit with a people who remember Allah the Exalted from the morning prayer until the sun rises is more beloved to me than that I free four from the offspring of Isma'il; and that I sit with a people who remember Allah from the Asr prayer until the sun sets is more beloved to me than that I free four.

duas.title: Morning Dua for Forgiveness & Gratitude

parts.intro: This Dua should be recited when the sun rises:
parts.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ أَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هٰذَا وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا
parts.arabic_alt: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هٰذَا وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا
parts.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhi aqaalanaa yawmanaa hadhaa wa-lam yuh-liknaa bi-dhunubinaa
parts.translation: Praise be to Allah who has pardoned us this day of ours and has not destroyed us for our sins.

duas.raw_markdown:
This Dua should be recited when the sun rises:

اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ أَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هٰذَا وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا

اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هٰذَا وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا

ReferenceMuslim: 822

duas.title: Morning Dua for Protection and Blessings

parts.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوْءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
parts.arabic_alt: اَصْبَحْنَا وَاَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، رَبِّ اَسْاَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهٗ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهٗ، رَبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوْءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
parts.transliteration: Asbahnaa wa 'asbahal-mulku lillaahi walhamdu lillaahi, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi 'as'aluka khayra maa fee haathal-yawmi wa khayra maa ba'dahu wa 'A'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haathal-yawmi wa sharri maa ba'dahu, Rabbi 'A'oodhu bika minal-kasali, wa soo'il-kibari, Rabbi 'A'oodhu bika min 'athaabin fin-naari wa 'athaabin fil-qabr.
parts.translation: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and praise be to Allah; there is no god but Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs dominion and to Him belongs praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of what is in this day and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in this day and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from torment in the Fire and torment in the grave.

اَصْبَحْنَا وَاَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، رَبِّ اَسْاَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهٗ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهٗ، رَبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوْءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ

Asbahnaa wa 'asbahal-mulku lillaahi walhamdu lillaahi, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi 'as'aluka khayra maa fee haathal-yawmi wa khayra maa ba'dahu wa 'A'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haathal-yawmi wa sharri maa ba'dahu, Rabbi 'A'oodhu bika minal-kasali, wa soo'il-kibari, Rabbi 'A'oodhu bika min 'athaabin fin-naari wa 'athaabin fil-qabr.

Translation

We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and praise be to Allah; there is no god but Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs dominion and to Him belongs praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of what is in this day and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in this day and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from torment in the Fire and torment in the grave.

duas.title: Dua Before Sleep (Ayatul Kursi)

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيمُ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ اَلْحَیُّ الْقَیُّوْمُ ۚ لَا تَاْخُذُهٗ سِنَةٌ وَّلَا نَوْمٌ ؕ لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِی الْاَرْضِ ؕ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِیْ یَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ ؕ یَعْلَمُ مَابَیْنَ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۚ وَلَا یُحِیْطُوْنَ بِشَیْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِیُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ ۚ وَلَا یَئُوْدُهٗ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِیُّ الْعَظِیْمُ ﴿۲۵۵﴾
parts.transliteration: Allahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-'ardh, man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahu 'illaa bi'idh nih, ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay'im-min 'ilmihi 'illaa bimaa shaa'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal'ardh, wa laa ya'ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul- 'Adheem
parts.translation: Allah - there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
parts.note: Whoever reads Ayatul Kursi when he lies down to sleep will have a guardian from Allah remain with him and Satan will not be able to come near him until he rises in the morning.

Allahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-'ardh, man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahu 'illaa bi'idh nih, ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay'im-min 'ilmihi 'illaa bimaa shaa'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal'ardh, wa laa ya'ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul- 'Adheem

Translation

Allah - there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

Whoever reads Ayatul Kursi when he lies down to sleep will have a guardian from Allah remain with him and Satan will not be able to come near him until he rises in the morning.

ReferenceAl-Bukhari, Fathul Bari 4/487, no. 2311

duas.title: Dua Before Going to Sleep (Surah al Baqarah Last Two Ayat)

parts.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّـهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّـهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ﴿٢٨٦﴾
parts.arabic_alt: اٰمَنَ الرَّسُوْلُ بِمَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّهٖ وَالْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ ؕ كُلٌّ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَمَلٰٓئِكَتِهٖ وَكُتُبِهٖ وَرُسُلِهٖ ۟ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَیْنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنْ رُّسُلِهٖ ۟ وَقَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَاَطَعْنَا ٭۫ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَاِلَیْكَ الْمَصِیْرُ ﴿۲۸۵﴾ لَا یُكَلِّفُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ؕ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَیْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ؕ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَاۤ اِنْ نَّسِیْنَاۤ اَوْ اَخْطَاْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَیْنَاۤ اِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهٗ عَلَی الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهٖ ۚ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا اَنْتَ مَوْلٰىنَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَی الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ ﴿۲۸۶﴾
parts.transliteration: (285) Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaa 'unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal mu'minoon, kullun 'aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa Kutubihi wa Rusulih, laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahadim-mir-Rusulih, wa qaaloo sami'naa wa 'ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa 'ilaykal-maseer. (286) Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan 'illaa wus'ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alayhaa mak-tasabat, Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa 'in naseenaa 'aw 'akhta'naa, Rabbanaa wa laa ta'hmil 'alaynaa 'isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alal-ladheena min qablinaa, Rabbanaa wa laa tu'hammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bihi, wa'fu 'annaa, waghfir lanaa war'hamnaa, 'Anta Mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen
parts.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying]: We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they said: We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the destination. (285) Allah does not burden a soul except [with that within] its capacity. For it is what it has earned, and against it is what it has incurred. Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or err. Our Lord, and do not lay upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and do not burden us with that which we have no strength to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people. (286)
parts.note: Whoever recites the last two Aayahs of Soorah al-Baqarah at night, those two Aayahs shall be sufficient for him.

duas.raw_markdown:
آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّـهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّـهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ﴿٢٨٦﴾

اٰمَنَ الرَّسُوْلُ بِمَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّهٖ وَالْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ ؕ كُلٌّ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَمَلٰٓئِكَتِهٖ وَكُتُبِهٖ وَرُسُلِهٖ ۟ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَیْنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنْ رُّسُلِهٖ ۟ وَقَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَاَطَعْنَا ٭۫ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَاِلَیْكَ الْمَصِیْرُ ﴿۲۸۵﴾ لَا یُكَلِّفُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ؕ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَیْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ؕ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَاۤ اِنْ نَّسِیْنَاۤ اَوْ اَخْطَاْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَیْنَاۤ اِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهٗ عَلَی الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهٖ ۚ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا اَنْتَ مَوْلٰىنَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَی الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ ﴿۲۸۶﴾

(285) Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaa 'unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal mu'minoon, kullun 'aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa Kutubihi wa Rusulih, laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahadim-mir-Rusulih, wa qaaloo sami'naa wa 'ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa 'ilaykal-maseer. (286) Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan 'illaa wus'ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alayhaa mak-tasabat, Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa 'in naseenaa 'aw 'akhta'naa, Rabbanaa wa laa ta'hmil 'alaynaa 'isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alal-ladheena min qablinaa, Rabbanaa wa laa tu'hammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bihi, wa'fu 'annaa, waghfir lanaa war'hamnaa, 'Anta Mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen

Translation

The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying]: We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they said: We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the destination. (285) Allah does not burden a soul except [with that within] its capacity. For it is what it has earned, and against it is what it has incurred. Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or err. Our Lord, and do not lay upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and do not burden us with that which we have no strength to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people. (286)

Whoever recites the last two Aayahs of Soorah al-Baqarah at night, those two Aayahs shall be sufficient for him.

ReferenceAl-Bukhari, Fathul Bari 9/94, Muslim 1/554, no. 807

duas.title: Dua When Wearing Clothes

parts.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِيْ هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّيْ وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
parts.arabic_alt: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ كَسَانِيْ هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِّنِّيْ وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
parts.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee kasaanee haadhaa aththawba wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlim-minnee wa laa quwwah
parts.translation: All praise is for Allah who clothed me with this garment and provided it to me without any might or strength from me.
parts.note: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone says this while wearing clothes, his previous sins will be forgiven."

duas.raw_markdown:
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِيْ هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّيْ وَلَا قُوَّةٍ

اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ كَسَانِيْ هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِّنِّيْ وَلَا قُوَّةٍ

Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee kasaanee haadhaa aththawba wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlim-minnee wa laa quwwah

Translation

All praise is for Allah who clothed me with this garment and provided it to me without any might or strength from me.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone says this while wearing clothes, his previous sins will be forgiven."

ReferenceHasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 4023

duas.title: Dua for Wearing New Clothes

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيْهِ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ اَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيْهِ اَسْاَلُكَ خَيْرَهٗ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهٗ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهٖ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهٗ
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu 'Anta kasawtaneehi, 'as'aluka khayrahu wa khayra maa suni'a lahu, wa 'a'oodhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lahu
parts.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good of that for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of that for which it was made.

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيْهِ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ

اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ اَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيْهِ اَسْاَلُكَ خَيْرَهٗ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهٗ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهٖ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهٗ

Allaahumma lakal-hamdu 'Anta kasawtaneehi, 'as'aluka khayrahu wa khayra maa suni'a lahu, wa 'a'oodhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lahu

Translation

O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good of that for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of that for which it was made.

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 1767

duas.title: Dua for Someone Wearing New Clothes

parts.arabic: تُبْلَی وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی
parts.arabic_alt: تُبْلٰی وَيُخْلِفُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰی
parts.transliteration: Tubla- wa yukhliful-laahu ta'aalaa
parts.translation: May you wear [it] out, and may Allah the Exalted replace [it].
parts.note: The Companions used to make this dua when they saw someone wearing new clothes.

duas.raw_markdown:
تُبْلَی وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی

تُبْلٰی وَيُخْلِفُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰی

Tubla- wa yukhliful-laahu ta'aalaa

Translation

May you wear [it] out, and may Allah the Exalted replace [it].

The Companions used to make this dua when they saw someone wearing new clothes.

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 4020

duas.title: Dua for leaving home

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
parts.arabic_alt: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
parts.transliteration: bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alal-laahi, laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah; there is no might and no strength except with Allah.
parts.note: Narrated Anas ibn Malik (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When a man goes out of his house and say these words, the following will be said to him at that time: "You are guided, defended and protected." The devils will go far from him and another devil will say: How can you deal with a man who has been guided, defended and protected?

duas.raw_markdown:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ

bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alal-laahi, laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah

Translation

In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah; there is no might and no strength except with Allah.

Narrated Anas ibn Malik (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When a man goes out of his house and say these words, the following will be said to him at that time: "You are guided, defended and protected." The devils will go far from him and another devil will say: How can you deal with a man who has been guided, defended and protected?

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5095

duas.title: Dua before leaving house

parts.intro: Umm Salamah (RA) narrated that: When the Prophet (ﷺ) would leave his house, he would say:
parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ اَللَّـهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نَزِلَّ أَوْ نَضِلَّ أَوْ نَظْلِمَ أَوْ نُظْلَمَ أَوْ نَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيْنَا
parts.arabic_alt: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ اَنْ نَزِلَّ اَوْ نَضِلَّ اَوْ نَظْلِمَ اَوْ نُظْلَمَ اَوْ نَجْهَلَ اَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيْنَا
parts.transliteration: Bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alal-laahi. Allaahumma, inna na`udhu bika min an nazilla aw nadilla, aw nazlima aw nuzlama, aw najhala aw yujhala 'alaina
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah. O Allah, indeed we seek refuge in You from slipping or straying, or wronging or being wronged, or acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.
parts.note: A mu'min should recite these adhkar by his/her heart whenever (Day/Night) he/she goes outside.

duas.raw_markdown:
Umm Salamah (RA) narrated that: When the Prophet (ﷺ) would leave his house, he would say:

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ اَللَّـهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نَزِلَّ أَوْ نَضِلَّ أَوْ نَظْلِمَ أَوْ نُظْلَمَ أَوْ نَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيْنَا

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ اَنْ نَزِلَّ اَوْ نَضِلَّ اَوْ نَظْلِمَ اَوْ نُظْلَمَ اَوْ نَجْهَلَ اَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيْنَا

Bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alal-laahi. Allaahumma, inna na`udhu bika min an nazilla aw nadilla, aw nazlima aw nuzlama, aw najhala aw yujhala 'alaina

Translation

In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah. O Allah, indeed we seek refuge in You from slipping or straying, or wronging or being wronged, or acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.

A mu'min should recite these adhkar by his/her heart whenever (Day/Night) he/she goes outside.

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3427

duas.title: Dua when leaving the house

parts.intro: Umm Salamah (RA) said, whenever Rasul (ﷺ) went outside my home he recite these words looking at the sky-
parts.arabic: اَللَّـهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ اَضِلَّ، اَوْ اُضَلَّ، اَوْ اَزِلَّ، اَوْ اُزَلَّ، اَوْ اَظْلِمَ، اَوْاُظْلَمَ،اَوْ اَجْهَلَ، اَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a‛oodhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw azlima aw uzlama, aw adhala aw yudhala ‛alayya
parts.translation: O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from straying or being led astray, or slipping or being caused to slip, or wronging or being wronged, or acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.

duas.raw_markdown:
Umm Salamah (RA) said, whenever Rasul (ﷺ) went outside my home he recite these words looking at the sky-

اَللَّـهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ اَضِلَّ، اَوْ اُضَلَّ، اَوْ اَزِلَّ، اَوْ اُزَلَّ، اَوْ اَظْلِمَ، اَوْاُظْلَمَ،اَوْ اَجْهَلَ، اَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ

Allaahumma innee a‛oodhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw azlima aw uzlama, aw adhala aw yudhala ‛alayya

Translation

O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from straying or being led astray, or slipping or being caused to slip, or wronging or being wronged, or acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5094

duas.title: Dua Before Entering the Toilet

parts.intro: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when he entered the toilet:
parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
parts.arabic_alt: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
parts.transliteration: Bismillaah, Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi walkhabaa'ith
parts.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.
parts.note: Ali (RA) said, Rasoolullah (ﷺ) said: When one of you goes to a secluded place by the call of nature, the covering of the genitals of the children of Adam from the eyes of the jinn is to say "Bismillah".

duas.raw_markdown:
Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when he entered the toilet:

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ

Bismillaah, Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi walkhabaa'ith

Translation

In the name of Allah. O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.

Ali (RA) said, Rasoolullah (ﷺ) said: When one of you goes to a secluded place by the call of nature, the covering of the genitals of the children of Adam from the eyes of the jinn is to say "Bismillah".

ReferenceBukhari: 142

duas.title: Dua for Leaving the Toilet

parts.intro: It is narrated on the authority of Aisha (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say when he came out of the toilet:
parts.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
parts.arabic_alt: غُفْرَانَكَ
parts.transliteration: Gufraanak
parts.translation: [I seek] Your forgiveness.
parts.note: Ayesha (RA) said that Rasoolullah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he came out of the toilet.

duas.raw_markdown:
It is narrated on the authority of Aisha (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say when he came out of the toilet:

غُفْرَانَكَ

غُفْرَانَكَ

Gufraanak

Translation

[I seek] Your forgiveness.

Ayesha (RA) said that Rasoolullah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he came out of the toilet.

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 30

duas.title: Reply of Azan (Azan Dua)

parts.intro: Narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA), he said, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the muazzin says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", Then if any of you say "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar; When the muazzin says "Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallah", If he says "Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallah"; When Muazzin says "Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar Rasoolullah, If he says "Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar Rasoolullah"; When the muazzin says "Haiya alas salah", If he says "Laa hawla wala quwwata illa billah"; When the muazzin says "Haiya alal falah", If he says "Laa hawla wala quwwata illa billah"; When the muazzin says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", If he says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", Then when the muazzin says "Laa ilaaha illallah", If he says "Laa ilaaha illallah" If he says these things from the heart, then he will go to Paradise.
parts.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
parts.translation: There is no might and no power except with Allah.

duas.raw_markdown:
Narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA), he said, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the muazzin says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", Then if any of you say "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar; When the muazzin says "Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallah", If he says "Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallah"; When Muazzin says "Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar Rasoolullah, If he says "Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar Rasoolullah"; When the muazzin says "Haiya alas salah", If he says "Laa hawla wala quwwata illa billah"; When the muazzin says "Haiya alal falah", If he says "Laa hawla wala quwwata illa billah"; When the muazzin says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", If he says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", Then when the muazzin says "Laa ilaaha illallah", If he says "Laa ilaaha illallah" If he says these things from the heart, then he will go to Paradise.

لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.

Translation

There is no might and no power except with Allah.

ReferenceMuslim: 385

duas.title: Dua after hearing Adhan (Azan dua)

parts.intro: After uttering Mu'adhdhin Tashahhud (i.e. Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar ...) the listeners will say this dhikr -
parts.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا
parts.arabic_alt: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَاَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ ، رَضِيْتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَّبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَّسُوْلًا وَّبِالْاِسْلَامِ دِيْنًا
parts.transliteration: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha ill-Allahu wa'hdahu laa shareeka lahu wa anna mu'hammadan ‛abduhu wa rasooluhu, radeetu billaahi rabban wa bimu'hammadin rasoolan wa bil -islaami deen-an
parts.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as messenger, and with Islam as religion.
parts.note: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever hears Mu'adhzin and utters these words, all his sins will be forgiven."

duas.raw_markdown:
After uttering Mu'adhdhin Tashahhud (i.e. Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar ...) the listeners will say this dhikr -

أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا

اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَاَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ ، رَضِيْتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَّبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَّسُوْلًا وَّبِالْاِسْلَامِ دِيْنًا

Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha ill-Allahu wa'hdahu laa shareeka lahu wa anna mu'hammadan ‛abduhu wa rasooluhu, radeetu billaahi rabban wa bimu'hammadin rasoolan wa bil -islaami deen-an

Translation

I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as messenger, and with Islam as religion.

Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever hears Mu'adhzin and utters these words, all his sins will be forgiven."

ReferenceMuslim: 386

duas.title: Dua After Adhan (Durood Sharif)

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلٰى اٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ، اِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ، اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلٰى اٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ، اِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَجِيْدٌ
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Mu'hammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Mu'hammadin, kamaa sallayta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Mu'hammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Mu'hammadin, kamaa baarakta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed
parts.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
parts.note: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you hear the Mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says, then invoke a blessing on me, for everyone who invokes a blessing on me will receive ten blessings from Allah; then beg from Allah al-Wasila for me, which is a rank in Paradise fitting for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I may be that one. If anyone who asks that I be given the Wasila, he will be assured of my intercession.

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلٰى اٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ، اِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ، اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلٰى اٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ، اِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَجِيْدٌ

Allaahumma salli 'alaa Mu'hammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Mu'hammadin, kamaa sallayta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Mu'hammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Mu'hammadin, kamaa baarakta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed

Translation

O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you hear the Mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says, then invoke a blessing on me, for everyone who invokes a blessing on me will receive ten blessings from Allah; then beg from Allah al-Wasila for me, which is a rank in Paradise fitting for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I may be that one. If anyone who asks that I be given the Wasila, he will be assured of my intercession.

ReferenceMuslim: 384

duas.title: Dua Before Wudu (Ablution Dua)

parts.intro: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that, whoever doesn't say Bismillaah, his ablution will be invalidated.
parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
parts.arabic_alt: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ
parts.transliteration: Bismillaah
parts.translation: In the name of Allah.

duas.raw_markdown:
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that, whoever doesn't say Bismillaah, his ablution will be invalidated.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ

Bismillaah

Translation

In the name of Allah.

ReferenceIrwa'ul-Ghalil 1/122 ,Ibn Majah No. 397

duas.title: Dua After Wudu (Ablution)

parts.intro: After doing ablution well, one should say:
parts.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ
parts.arabic_alt: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ
parts.transliteration: Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluhu
parts.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.
parts.note: Uqba bin 'Amir (RA) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: If any Muslim performs ablution well, then stands and prays two rak'ahs setting about them with his heart as well as his face, Paradise would be guaranteed to him.

duas.raw_markdown:
After doing ablution well, one should say:

أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ

اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ

Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluhu

Translation

I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.

Uqba bin 'Amir (RA) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: If any Muslim performs ablution well, then stands and prays two rak'ahs setting about them with his heart as well as his face, Paradise would be guaranteed to him.

ReferenceMuslim: 234 , 576

duas.title: After Wudu Dua (Ablution)

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ
parts.transliteration: Allaahummaj'alnee minat-tawwaabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen
parts.translation: O Allah, make me of the repentant and make me of those who purify themselves.
parts.note: It has been narrated in Sahih Hadith that the dua should be recited after the previous dhikr. The eight gates of Paradise will be opened for the one who recites these two duas; He will enter (Paradise) through whichever door he wishes.

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ

اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ

Allaahummaj'alnee minat-tawwaabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen

Translation

O Allah, make me of the repentant and make me of those who purify themselves.

It has been narrated in Sahih Hadith that the dua should be recited after the previous dhikr. The eight gates of Paradise will be opened for the one who recites these two duas; He will enter (Paradise) through whichever door he wishes.

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 55

duas.title: Dua for going to the Mosque (Dua e noor)

parts.intro: When the Mu'adhdhin gave the call to prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to go out for the prayer while reciting this supplication -
parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِيْ نُوْرًا وَّفِي لِسَانِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِي سَمْعِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِي بَصَرِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلْفِي نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ أَمَامِيْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِىْ نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ تَحْتِىْ نُوْرًا اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِىْ نُوْرًا
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِىْ قَلْبِىْ نُوْرًا وَّفِىْ لِسَانِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِىْ سَمْعِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِىْ بَصَرِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلْفِىْ نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ اَمَامِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِىْ نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ تَحْتِىْ نُوْرًا اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِنِىْ نُوْرًا
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma-j‛al fee qalbee noor-an, wa fee lisaanee noor-an, waj‛al fee sam‛ee noor-an, waj‛al fee basaree noor-an, waj‛al min khalfee noor-an, wamin amaamee noor-an, waj‛al min fawqee noor-an, wa min t'ahtee noor-an, Allaahumma a‛tinee noor-an
parts.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, and light on my tongue, and place light in my hearing, and place light in my sight, and place light behind me, and light in front of me, and place light above me, and light below me. O Allah, grant me light.

duas.raw_markdown:
When the Mu'adhdhin gave the call to prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to go out for the prayer while reciting this supplication -

اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِيْ نُوْرًا وَّفِي لِسَانِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِي سَمْعِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِي بَصَرِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلْفِي نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ أَمَامِيْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِىْ نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ تَحْتِىْ نُوْرًا اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِىْ نُوْرًا

اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِىْ قَلْبِىْ نُوْرًا وَّفِىْ لِسَانِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِىْ سَمْعِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِىْ بَصَرِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلْفِىْ نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ اَمَامِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِىْ نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ تَحْتِىْ نُوْرًا اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِنِىْ نُوْرًا

Allaahumma-j‛al fee qalbee noor-an, wa fee lisaanee noor-an, waj‛al fee sam‛ee noor-an, waj‛al fee basaree noor-an, waj‛al min khalfee noor-an, wamin amaamee noor-an, waj‛al min fawqee noor-an, wa min t'ahtee noor-an, Allaahumma a‛tinee noor-an

Translation

O Allah, place light in my heart, and light on my tongue, and place light in my hearing, and place light in my sight, and place light behind me, and light in front of me, and place light above me, and light below me. O Allah, grant me light.

duas.title: Dua For Going To The Masjid

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا، اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ لِسَانِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ سَمْعِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ بَصَرِيْ نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِيْ نُوْرًا، وَعَنْ يَّمِيْنِيْ نُوْرًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِيْ نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ اَمَامِيْ نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِيْ نَفْسِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاَعْظِمْ لِيْ نُوْرًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْنِيْ نُوْرًا، اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِنِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِيْ عَصَبِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ لَحْمِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ دَمِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِي شَعْرِيْ نُورًا، وَفِيْ بَشَرِيْ نُوْرًا
parts.transliteration: Allaahummaj'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran, waj'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'adhdhim lee nooran, waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran, Allaahumma 'a'tinee nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wafee lahmee nooran, wafee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.
parts.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, and light on my tongue, and light in my hearing, and light in my sight, and light above me, and light below me, and light on my right, and light on my left, and light in front of me, and light behind me, and place light within myself, and make light great for me, and make light immense for me, and make light for me, and make me light. O Allah, grant me light, and place light in my nerves, and light in my flesh, and light in my blood, and light in my hair, and light in my skin.

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا، اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا

اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ لِسَانِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ سَمْعِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ بَصَرِيْ نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِيْ نُوْرًا، وَعَنْ يَّمِيْنِيْ نُوْرًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِيْ نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ اَمَامِيْ نُوْرًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِيْ نَفْسِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاَعْظِمْ لِيْ نُوْرًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْنِيْ نُوْرًا، اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِنِيْ نُوْرًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِيْ عَصَبِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ لَحْمِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِيْ دَمِيْ نُوْرًا، وَفِي شَعْرِيْ نُورًا، وَفِيْ بَشَرِيْ نُوْرًا

Allaahummaj'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran, waj'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'adhdhim lee nooran, waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran, Allaahumma 'a'tinee nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wafee lahmee nooran, wafee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.

Translation

O Allah, place light in my heart, and light on my tongue, and light in my hearing, and light in my sight, and light above me, and light below me, and light on my right, and light on my left, and light in front of me, and light behind me, and place light within myself, and make light great for me, and make light immense for me, and make light for me, and make me light. O Allah, grant me light, and place light in my nerves, and light in my flesh, and light in my blood, and light in my hair, and light in my skin.

duas.title: Dua When Entering Masjid (Wassalatu Wassalamu)

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
parts.arabic_alt: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلٰى رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ اَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
parts.transliteration: Bismillaahi, Wassalaatu Wassalaamu 'alaa Rasoolillaah. Allahum-maftah lee 'abwaaba rahmatik.
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

duas.raw_markdown:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلٰى رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ اَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ

Bismillaahi, Wassalaatu Wassalaamu 'alaa Rasoolillaah. Allahum-maftah lee 'abwaaba rahmatik.

Translation

In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

duas.title: Dua for Salah (At the beginning of the prayer)

parts.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَـدَيْكَ، وَالشَّـرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْـكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ
parts.arabic_alt: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِىْ فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضَ حَنِيْفًا وَّمَا اَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ، اِنَّ صَلَاتِىْ، وَنُسُكِىْ، وَمَحْيَاىَ، وَمَمَاتِىْ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَبِذَلِكَ اُمِرْتُ وَاَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، اَنْتَ رَبِّىْ وَاَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِىْ وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْۢبِىْ فَاغْفِرْ لِىْ ذُنُوْبِىْ جَمِيْعًا اِنَّهٗ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِىْ لِاَحْسَنِ الْاَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِىْ لِاَحْسَنِهَا اِلَّا اَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّىْ سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّىْ سَيِّئَهَا اِلَّا اَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهٗ بِيَدَيْكَ، وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ اِلَيْكَ، اَنَا بِكَ وَاِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَاَتوبُ اِلَيْكَ
parts.transliteration: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhee fataras-samawaati wal-arda haneefan wa maa ana minal-mushrikeen, inna salaatee wa nusukee wa mahyaaya wa mamaatee lillaahi rabbil-'alameen, laa shareeka lahu wabi dhaalika umirtu wa-ana minal-muslimeen. Allaahumma antal-maliku laa ilaaha illaa anta. anta rabbee wa-anaa 'abduka, dhalamtu nafsee wa'taraftu bidhanbee faghfir lee dhunoobee jamee'an innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa anta. wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaaqi laa yahdee li-ahsaniha illaa anta, wasrif 'annee sayyiaha laa yasrifu 'annee sayyiaha illaa anta, Labbayka wa sa'dayka, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadayka, washsharru laysa ilayka, ana bika wa-ilayka, tabarakta wa ta'alayta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk
parts.translation: I have turned my face toward Him who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of the polytheists. Indeed, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. And of that I have been commanded, and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the King, there is no god but You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant. I have wronged myself and I have confessed my sin, so forgive me all my sins; indeed, none forgives sins except You. And guide me to the best of manners; none guides to the best of them except You. And turn away from me the bad of them; none turns away from me the bad of them except You. Here I am at Your service and at Your pleasure, and all good is in Your hands, and evil is not [attributed] to You. I am by You and to You. Blessed are You and Exalted. I ask Your forgiveness and I repent to You.

وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَـدَيْكَ، وَالشَّـرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْـكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ

وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِىْ فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضَ حَنِيْفًا وَّمَا اَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ، اِنَّ صَلَاتِىْ، وَنُسُكِىْ، وَمَحْيَاىَ، وَمَمَاتِىْ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَبِذَلِكَ اُمِرْتُ وَاَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، اَنْتَ رَبِّىْ وَاَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِىْ وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْۢبِىْ فَاغْفِرْ لِىْ ذُنُوْبِىْ جَمِيْعًا اِنَّهٗ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِىْ لِاَحْسَنِ الْاَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِىْ لِاَحْسَنِهَا اِلَّا اَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّىْ سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّىْ سَيِّئَهَا اِلَّا اَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهٗ بِيَدَيْكَ، وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ اِلَيْكَ، اَنَا بِكَ وَاِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَاَتوبُ اِلَيْكَ

Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhee fataras-samawaati wal-arda haneefan wa maa ana minal-mushrikeen, inna salaatee wa nusukee wa mahyaaya wa mamaatee lillaahi rabbil-'alameen, laa shareeka lahu wabi dhaalika umirtu wa-ana minal-muslimeen. Allaahumma antal-maliku laa ilaaha illaa anta. anta rabbee wa-anaa 'abduka, dhalamtu nafsee wa'taraftu bidhanbee faghfir lee dhunoobee jamee'an innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa anta. wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaaqi laa yahdee li-ahsaniha illaa anta, wasrif 'annee sayyiaha laa yasrifu 'annee sayyiaha illaa anta, Labbayka wa sa'dayka, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadayka, washsharru laysa ilayka, ana bika wa-ilayka, tabarakta wa ta'alayta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk

Translation

I have turned my face toward Him who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of the polytheists. Indeed, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. And of that I have been commanded, and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the King, there is no god but You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant. I have wronged myself and I have confessed my sin, so forgive me all my sins; indeed, none forgives sins except You. And guide me to the best of manners; none guides to the best of them except You. And turn away from me the bad of them; none turns away from me the bad of them except You. Here I am at Your service and at Your pleasure, and all good is in Your hands, and evil is not [attributed] to You. I am by You and to You. Blessed are You and Exalted. I ask Your forgiveness and I repent to You.

ReferenceMuslim: 771

duas.title: Dua after Takbeer in Salah

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اَللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِيْ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِىْ وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ نَقِّنِىْ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْاَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَاىَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma baa'id baynee wa bayna khataayaaya kamaa baa'adta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, Allaahumma naqqinee minal khataayaa kamaa yunaqqath-thawbul-'abyadhu minad-danas, Allaahummaghsil khataayaaya, bil maa'i wath-thalji wal-barad
parts.translation: O Allah, distance between me and my sins as You have distanced between the east and the west. O Allah, cleanse me of sins as the white garment is cleansed of filth. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow, and hail.
parts.note: Narrated by Abu Huraira (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to keep silent between the Takbir and the recitation of Qur'an and that interval of silence used to be a short one. I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "May my parents be sacrificed for you! What do you say in the pause between Takbir and recitation?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I say, (The dua is Mentioned above)

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اَللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِيْ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ

اَللّٰهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِىْ وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ نَقِّنِىْ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْاَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَاىَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ

Allaahumma baa'id baynee wa bayna khataayaaya kamaa baa'adta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, Allaahumma naqqinee minal khataayaa kamaa yunaqqath-thawbul-'abyadhu minad-danas, Allaahummaghsil khataayaaya, bil maa'i wath-thalji wal-barad

I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "May my parents be sacrificed for you! What do you say in the pause between Takbir and recitation?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I say, (The dua is Mentioned above)

duas.title: Dua When Starting Tahajjud Prayer

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيْلَ وَمِيْكَائِيْلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اِهْدِنِيْ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيْلَ وَمِيْكَائِيْلَ وَاِسْرَافِيْلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ اَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيْمَا كَانُوا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ اِهْدِنِيْ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِاِذْنِكَ اِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاءُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma rabba jibraa-eel, wameekaa-eel, wa-israafeel faatiras-samawaati wal-ardi, 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdee man tasha-o ilaa siratin mustaqeem
parts.translation: O Allah, Lord of Jibra'il, Mika'il, and Israfil, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants concerning that wherein they used to differ. Guide me by Your permission to the truth concerning that wherein there has been difference. Indeed, You guide whom You will to a straight path.
parts.note: Ayesha said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite this dua at the beginning of the night (tahajjud) prayer.

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيْلَ وَمِيْكَائِيْلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اِهْدِنِيْ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ

اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيْلَ وَمِيْكَائِيْلَ وَاِسْرَافِيْلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ اَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيْمَا كَانُوا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ اِهْدِنِيْ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِاِذْنِكَ اِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاءُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ

Allaahumma rabba jibraa-eel, wameekaa-eel, wa-israafeel faatiras-samawaati wal-ardi, 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdee man tasha-o ilaa siratin mustaqeem

O Allah, Lord of Jibra'il, Mika'il, and Israfil, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants concerning that wherein they used to differ. Guide me by Your permission to the truth concerning that wherein there has been difference. Indeed, You guide whom You will to a straight path.

duas.title: Dua For Starting Tahajjud Prayer (Subhanaka Allahumma)

parts.intro: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to stand at night (in prayer) and recite this supplication after saying 'Allahu Akbar':
parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
parts.arabic_alt: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالٰى جَدُّكَ وَلَا اِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
parts.transliteration: Subhanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaraka 'smuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa laa 'ilahaa ghayruk
parts.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You, and blessed is Your name, and exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god other than You.

parts.intro: Then he said this for three times -
parts.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
parts.arabic_alt: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ
parts.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllah
parts.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.

parts.intro: Then he said this for three times -
parts.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ كَبِيْرًا
parts.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar Kabiran
parts.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Most Great.

parts.intro: Then he would say -
parts.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيْعِ الْعَلِيْمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ
parts.arabic_alt: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ السَّمِيْعِ الْعَلِيْمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهٖ وَنَفْخِهٖ وَنَفْثِهٖ
parts.transliteration: A‛oodhu Billaahis Sami'il-Alimi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem, min Hamzihi Wa Nafkhihi wa Nafthih
parts.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing and the All-Knowing from the accursed devil, from his madness or evil suggestion (Hamz), from his puffing up (Nafkh), and from his witchcraft (Nafth).

duas.raw_markdown:
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to stand at night (in prayer) and recite this supplication after saying 'Allahu Akbar':

سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ

سُبْحَانَكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالٰى جَدُّكَ وَلَا اِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ

Subhanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaraka 'smuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa laa 'ilahaa ghayruk

Translation

Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You, and blessed is Your name, and exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god other than You.

* * *

Then he said this for three times -

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ

Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllah

Translation

There is none worthy of worship but Allah.

* * *

Then he said this for three times -

اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا

اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ كَبِيْرًا

Allahu 'Akbar Kabiran

Translation

Allah is the Greatest, Most Great.

* * *

Then he would say -

أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيْعِ الْعَلِيْمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ

اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ السَّمِيْعِ الْعَلِيْمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهٖ وَنَفْخِهٖ وَنَفْثِهٖ

A‛oodhu Billaahis Sami'il-Alimi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem, min Hamzihi Wa Nafkhihi wa Nafthih

Translation

I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing and the All-Knowing from the accursed devil, from his madness or evil suggestion (Hamz), from his puffing up (Nafkh), and from his witchcraft (Nafth).

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 775

duas.title: Dua for the deceased
duas.subcategory: Things to do for the dead

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهٗ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهٗ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّيْنَ، وَاخْلُفْهٗ فِيْ عَقِبِهٖ فِيْ الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهٗ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِيْ قَبْرِهٖ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهٗ فِيْهِ
parts.transliteration: Alla-humma'gfir lahu (person's name), warfa'a darajatahu fil mahdiyin, wa'khlufhu fi 'aqibihi fil ga-birin, wagfir lana wa lahu ya rabbal' a-lamin, wafsa'ah lahu fi qabrihi, wa nau-wir lahu fihi
parts.translation: O Allah, forgive him, and raise his rank among the guided, and be his successor among his offspring who remain behind, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds, and make his grave spacious for him, and illuminate it for him.
parts.note: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Abu Salama (RA) (as he died). His eyes were fixedly open. Rasoolullah (ﷺ) closed them, and then said: When the soul is taken away the sight follows it. Some of the people of his family wept and wailed. So he said: Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for angels say "Amen" to what you say. He then said- (The dua is mentioned above)

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ

اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهٗ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهٗ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّيْنَ، وَاخْلُفْهٗ فِيْ عَقِبِهٖ فِيْ الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهٗ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِيْ قَبْرِهٖ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهٗ فِيْهِ

Alla-humma'gfir lahu (person's name), warfa'a darajatahu fil mahdiyin, wa'khlufhu fi 'aqibihi fil ga-birin, wagfir lana wa lahu ya rabbal' a-lamin, wafsa'ah lahu fi qabrihi, wa nau-wir lahu fihi

Translation

O Allah, forgive him, and raise his rank among the guided, and be his successor among his offspring who remain behind, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds, and make his grave spacious for him, and illuminate it for him.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Abu Salama (RA) (as he died). His eyes were fixedly open. Rasoolullah (ﷺ) closed them, and then said: When the soul is taken away the sight follows it. Some of the people of his family wept and wailed. So he said: Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for angels say "Amen" to what you say. He then said- (The dua is mentioned above)

ReferenceMuslim: 920

duas.title: Dua and Sunnah After Janaza Prayer (Hadith)

parts.intro: It is narrated in Sahih Hadith that after burying the dead, it is Sunnah for those present to throw soil three times with both hands. Abu Hurairah (RA) said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a janaza prayer. Then he went to the grave of the dead man and threw soil on him three times from the side of his head."
parts.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ ثُمَّ أَتَى قَبْرَ الْمَيِّتِ فَحَثَى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ قِبَلِ رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثًا
parts.transliteration: Anna Rasoolallaahi sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam sallaa 'alaa janaazatin, thumma ataa qabral-mayyiti fahathaa 'alayhi min qibali ra'sihi thalaathan
parts.translation: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed over a funeral, then came to the grave of the deceased and poured [earth] over him from the direction of his head three times.

duas.title: Dua when placing the deceased in Grave

parts.intro: Ibn 'Umar (RA) said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he put the dead body in the grave:
parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ (ﷺ)
parts.arabic_alt: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلٰى سُنَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰه (ﷺ)
parts.transliteration: Bismillaahi wa 'alaa sunnati Rasulillaah
parts.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).

duas.raw_markdown:
Ibn 'Umar (RA) said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he put the dead body in the grave:

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ (ﷺ)

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلٰى سُنَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰه (ﷺ)

Bismillaahi wa 'alaa sunnati Rasulillaah

Translation

In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3213

duas.title: Laylatul Qadr Dua (Allahumma Innaka Afuwwun Karim Dua)
duas.subcategory: Duas to be recited in Ramadan

parts.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ (كَرِيْمٌ) تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
parts.arabic_alt: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ (كَرِيْمٌ) تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّىْ
parts.transliteration: Allaahumma innaka `Afuwwun [Karimun], tu'hibbul-`afwa fa`fu `annī.
parts.translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, (Generous), You love pardon, so pardon me.
parts.note: Ayesha (RA) said, "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), should I make du'a on Lailatul Qadr?" Then he (ﷺ) taught me this du'a. This du'aa 'can be recited in the prostration of Salat on Laylat al-Qadr, before Salam, after salaam and on all other days and nights in all Salats and at normal times.

duas.raw_markdown:
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ (كَرِيْمٌ) تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ (كَرِيْمٌ) تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّىْ

Allaahumma innaka `Afuwwun [Karimun], tu'hibbul-`afwa fa`fu `annī.

Translation

O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, (Generous), You love pardon, so pardon me.

Ayesha (RA) said, "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), should I make du'a on Lailatul Qadr?" Then he (ﷺ) taught me this du'a. This du'aa 'can be recited in the prostration of Salat on Laylat al-Qadr, before Salam, after salaam and on all other days and nights in all Salats and at normal times.

ReferenceSahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3513

duas.title: Dua of the beginning of fasting
duas.subcategory: Duas to be recited in Ramadan

parts.intro: There is no masnun dua at the beginning of fasting. However, it is important to make the intention for fasting the night before the start of fasting. The conscious purpose in the mind is called intention. This is the intention of the believer to fast before fasting, before going to bed at night or during sahri. It is not Sunnah to say "Nawaituan" or to do so in any other way.
