(Surah Yunus 10:49)قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًا ۚTranslation: 'Who then could possess anything for you against Allah if He intended harm for you or intended benefit for you?' (Surah Al-Fath 48:11)وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖTranslation: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. (Surah Al-An'am 6:17)إِن يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ ﴿٢٣﴾Translation: 'If the Most Merciful should intend for me any harm, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me.' (Surah Ya-Sin 36:23)If someone believes in this pure and pristine teaching of the Holy Qur'an that the power to benefit and harm is in the hands of Allah Almighty alone, and if this belief becomes deeply rooted in their heart, then all fears regarding jinn, humans, and all creation will be removed from them.For this reason, the Qur'an calls upon us in various verses to fear Allah Almighty alone.Allah Almighty says:إِنَّمَا ذَٰلِكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ﴿١٧٥﴾Translation: That is only Shaytan; he frightens you of his allies. So do not fear them, but fear Me, if you are believers. (Surah Ali 'Imran 3:175)فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَوْهُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَTranslation: Allah is more worthy for you to fear Him, if you are believers. (Surah At-Tawbah 9:13)وَأَوْفُوا بِعَهْدِي أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِTranslation: Fulfill My covenant that I may fulfill your covenant, and fear only Me. (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:40)For this reason, scholars and jurists have said that fearing anyone other than Allah is a type of shirk, which is completely forbidden in the light of the Qur'an and Hadith.Muslims recite the Kalimah "La ilaha illallah" every day, so they should realize that this Kalimah has an impact on all the fears they face surrounding the creations of Allah.One who believes in Tawhid and is aware of its purpose and outcome can never fear anyone other than Allah, because whenever they say, La ilaha illallah--there is no deity or god worthy of worship except Allah--they realize at that very moment that there is no source of solace except Allah, no one can be relied upon except Him, no refuge can be sought from anyone else, He is the sole Sovereign, He alone must be obeyed, protection cannot be sought from anyone other than Him, He is the sole Ruler, and no one other than Allah can be worshipped. If there is even the slightest deviation or departure from this declaration and this belief, it will be considered shirk. And this shirk is completely forbidden in the light of the Qur'an and Hadith, even if someone regularly performs salah and fasts.Until one completely surrenders oneself to Allah in worship ('ubudiyyah), fears Him alone, and frees oneself from the fear of jinn, humans, or any other created being, one cannot place true faith in Tawhid.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Treatment of People's Irrational Fear of Jinn
ruqyah_articles.text: Allah Almighty says:إِنَّ كَيْدَ الشَّيْطَانِ كَانَ ضَعِيفًاTranslation: Indeed, the plot of Shaytan is weak. (Surah An-Nisa 4:76)Regarding this, a hadith has been narrated, and there is consensus regarding the authenticity of the hadith; narrated from Abu Qatadah (RA), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Shaytan. If anyone sees something unpleasant in a dream, let him spit three times to his left and pray to Allah for protection from the hand of Shaytan, then it will no longer be able to harm him at all." [Sahih al-Bukhari 3292, 5747, 6986, 6995, Sahih Muslim 2261]At-Tabari (rahimahullah) said: According to this hadith, spitting three times to the left means expressing hatred towards Shaytan, because whenever we see a dirty object or think of it, we spit, and there is nothing more vile than Shaytan. Therefore, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) instructed to spit towards Shaytan as soon as a bad dream comes to mind. The reason for mentioning the left side instead of the right side for spitting may be like this: the direction from which people are called to evil deeds, Shaytan approaches the children of Adam from that very direction.Al-Hakim al-Tirmidhi (rahimahullah) said: This spit falls upon the face of Shaytan and leaves a mark like a blister there. When you spit to the left and at the same time seek refuge with Allah from the hand of Shaytan, the waswasah brought by Shaytan will be nullified for you. Narrated from Rabi' bin Khuthaym (rahimahullah), he said, someone came to him and said: I saw in a dream someone saying to me, go tell Rabi' that he is a dweller of Hellfire. Hearing this, Rabi' immediately spat three times to his left and said, I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Shaytan.The following night, he saw in a dream that a man brought a dog and made it stand before him, with a rope tied around the dog's neck, and a blister on its forehead. That man said: This is that Shaytan who showed al-Rabi' in your dream, and the blisters you see on its forehead are the result of al-Rabi' spitting three times to the left. [Masa'ib al-Insan min Maka'id ash-Shaytan, p. 142]Umar bin Khattab (RA) was such that as soon as Shaytan saw his shadow, it would flee, and whenever it encountered him on the streets, Shaytan would become terrified. In such situations, Umar (RA) never took another path; rather, Shaytan itself became afraid and took a different path. Narrated from Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA), he said: One night a man went outside, and on the way he met a jinn.The jinn said to him: "Will you wrestle with me?" Hearing this, the man grabbed the jinn and threw him to the ground, then he said: "I see that you are very small and you have four arms like a dog; do all jinn look like you? Or do you look like them?" It said: "Do you recite Ayat al-Kursi?" Because when someone recites Ayat al-Kursi upon entering his house, Shaytan exits the house before his entry, braying like a donkey. At that time, Abdullah bin Mas'ud was asked: Was that man Umar bin Khattab (RA)? He said: "Who else could it be except Umar (RA)?" [Ibid., p. 56]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Treatment of People's Irrational Fear of Jinn
ruqyah_articles.text: Not all jinn are ugly and black in appearance, the way they are presented in various stories and used to instill fear. There are some jinn who perform more good deeds than humans, and among some jinn there is also an excellent record of faith, kindness, and calling others to the path of Allah, just as it is mentioned at the beginning of Surah Al-Jinn that a group of jinn listened attentively to the sweet recitation of the Qur'an by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went back and warned his people. Allah Almighty says:قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا ﴿١﴾ يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا ﴿٢﴾Translation: Say, 'It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened attentively. Then they said, "Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an, which guides to the truth; so we have believed in it. And we will never associate anyone with our Lord."' (Surah Al-Jinn 72:1-2)وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوا أَنصِتُوا ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ ﴿٢٩﴾Translation: And [mention] when We directed a group of the jinn towards you. They were listening to the recitation of the Qur'an. When they attended it, they said, 'Listen quietly.' Then when the recitation was completed, they returned to their people as warners. (Surah Al-Ahqaf 46:29)Some jinn are more Allah-fearing and faithful than humans. Some jinn call others to the path of Allah, and some jinn have extensive knowledge regarding the hadiths of the Messenger (ﷺ). Shaykh al-Islam Taqi al-Din Ibn Taymiyyah (rahimahullah) stated this in his book Al-Furqan al-Kabir.A king or governor of a distant region, or a disbeliever who has lost his way and become thirsty, intensely fearing death--at that time a jinn will come to that person taking the form of a human. It will come and give him water to drink, and invite him to the path of Islam. Consequently, that person will become a Muslim and say to that jinn in human form: "Who are you?" In reply, it will say: "I am so-and-so."In support of this narration, he mentions another story that occurred during his own lifetime. He says:An incident just like this occurred in the Citadel. While I was in the Citadel, such a thing happened in the life of a Turkish prince in the eastern region. A person came and said to the prince: I am Ibn Taymiyyah, and the prince did not doubt his words in the slightest. When the king of Mardin was informed of this, he sent this news to Egypt, while at that time I was imprisoned in a well. The people of Egypt were overwhelmed with astonishment upon hearing this, because they had not seen me come out of the well. In reality, that person was a jinn; he loved us, and for that very reason, whatever I used to do for the Turks, he too would do.When they came to Damascus, I would invite them to Islam, and if any of them uttered the Shahadatayn, we would try to feed him everything within our means. Whatever I did, that jinn also did the exact same. Many people came and said to me: Could it not be that that person was actually an angel? I said: No, because an angel can never tell a lie, but that jinn indeed said 'I am Ibn Taymiyyah'--he said this even knowing it to be a lie. [Ibn Muflih al-Hanbali, Masa'ib al-Insan min Maka'id ash-Shaytan, 132-133]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Treatment of People's Irrational Fear of Jinn
ruqyah_articles.text: Muslims should understand that compared to humans, the position of the jinn is lower and less honorable, even if the jinn is Allah-fearing. Shaykh Abu Bakr al-Jaza'iri (rahimahullah) says: Even Allah-fearing and righteous jinn are in a lower position than humans in terms of status, because the Creator Himself has said that humans are the best and honored creation. In this regard, Allah Ta'ala says in a verse of the Holy Qur'an:وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِي آدَمَ وَحَمَلْنَاهُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَاهُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا ﴿٧٠﴾Translation: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference. (Al-Isra 17:70)In no other Book revealed by Allah or through the lips of any Messenger did Allah show such honor to the jinn as He has given to humans. Therefore, it is clear that in terms of status, the position of humans is above the jinn. This is certainly evident from the jinn's own feelings as well; it is also clear from their sense of low status and their weakness before humans. When humans seek refuge with them, they feel pride and consider themselves superior, because this means that they are being honored and respected, although in reality they are not worthy of it; as a result, the extent of their (humans') sin and transgression greatly increases, and falsehood and disbelief multiply among them. From this too, the low status of the jinn becomes clear.Allah Ta'ala says:وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا ﴿٦﴾Translation: And indeed, there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they increased them in arrogance. (Al-Jinn 72:6)When any human seeks help from the jinn or seeks assistance by mentioning the names of their leaders, they respond to that person's call and fulfill his need. It is from this incident that this concept is conveyed in the above verse.These incidents occur precisely because the jinn consider themselves weak and insignificant before the children of Adam whom Allah has honored. And Allah has honored the children of Adam for these reasons: Adam believed in Allah and worshipped Him, declared His Oneness and Lordship, worshipped Him alone, and proclaimed His Names and Attributes. But if this faith is not present among humans, then the Allah-fearing and righteous jinn will attain a higher status than those among the children of Adam who are disbelievers and polytheists. [Abu Bakr Jabir al-Jaza'iri (rahimahullah), Aqidat al-Mu'min, p. 228]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Treatment of People's Irrational Fear of Jinn
ruqyah_articles.text: We must be careful regarding the propagation or spreading of stories related to jinn to others. It is better not to speak about these matters at all; in particular, these stories must not be told among common people, women, and children, because these stories are about a world that is not visible to us. Jinn also tell many lies, so we cannot be certain whether the jinn is actually telling the truth or lying. Therefore, it is better not to spread these stories among people. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also forbade anyone from telling how Shaytan plays with a person in their dreams.Narrated from Jabir bin Abdullah (RA), once a Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)! I saw in a dream that my head was severed and rolled onto the ground, and I was running after my head. Hearing this, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to the Bedouin:"Do not disclose to anyone how Shaytan played with you in this dream of yours."And he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say in a sermon that,"Never tell others how Shaytan plays with you in dreams." [Sahih Muslim, 2268]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Treatment of People's Irrational Fear of Jinn
ruqyah_articles.text: Muslims should further realize that Allah Ta'ala has appointed angels as guardians for human protection. These angels guard humans constantly day and night, providing protection from the evil of the jinn and any other kind of harm invisible to humans. In this regard, Allah Ta'ala says:لَهُ مُعَقِّبَاتٌ مِّن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِTranslation: For each one there are successive [angels] before and behind him, who protect him by the command of Allah. (Ar-Ra'd 13:11)Regarding this guarding, scholars have two opinions:The first opinion is that Allah Ta'ala, out of His immense mercy, has appointed angels for every human; the task of these angels is to provide protection to humans from wild animals, beasts, and harmful things.The second opinion is that they protect humans from the evil of the jinn. Ad-Dahhak (rahimahullah) says: They protect humans from the jinn, unless a decree has been issued against him.Ka'b (rahimahullah) says: If Allah had not provided protection for you in your food, your drink, and your arwah, the jinn would have caused you great harm. [Al-Qurtubi, 9/192-193]Allah Ta'ala says:وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةًTranslation: And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardians. (Al-An'am 6:61)In this verse, it is stated that Allah has appointed separate angels for humans during the day and night; they record human deeds and protect humans from harm. [Al-Qurtubi, 7/6]Allah Ta'ala further says in the Holy Qur'an:إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ ﴿٤﴾Translation: There is a protector over every soul. (At-Tariq 86:4)Abu Umamah (RA) says: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"One hundred and sixty angels are appointed by Allah for a believer; their task is to protect him from matters that have not yet been decreed for him. For example, seven angels guard one eye of a believer, just as bees guard honey in a beehive. If anyone were left to his own schemes or plans for a few moments, Shaytan would cause him great harm." [Tafsir Qurtubi, 20/4]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: How to Expel Jinn from the House?
ruqyah_articles.text: Shaykh Wahid Bali says: If you are certain that there really is a jinn in the house and that this is not someone's trick, then the way to expel the jinn will be as follows:1. You will go to that house with two people and say: "I call upon you to leave my house under the covenant that Sulayman took from you. I adjure you by Allah to leave and not to harm anyone." You will say these words three times.2. After this, if you sense anything inside the house, then take water in a vessel and recite that du'a which al-Muharibi wrote to Abu an-Nadr. After reciting the du'a, sprinkle water in every corner of the house and leave some water in every corner; then they will flee from the house by the command of Allah.3. Then, start reciting the Qur'an sitting in that house, especially reciting Surah Al-Baqarah, and perform nafl salah, and perform qiyam in that house at night.4. Purify that house by removing everything associated with disobedience to Allah. [Wiqayatul Insan]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Reasons Why Jinn Can Overpower Humans
ruqyah_articles.text: It should be known that it is not an easy task for the jinn to harm a human or possess him, because as soon as it attempts to do so, it faces the punishment of the Qur'an; this punishment is because it becomes trapped inside the human body. And when a jinn appears in another form or guise, it faces destruction and death, because it then becomes subject to the rules and regulations that apply to the guise it has assumed. For example, if a jinn appears in the form of a cat, and you then kill it with a spear or lance, that jinn will be killed. An incident like this has been narrated through an Ansari youth, which is mentioned in Sahih Muslim.Therefore, a jinn does not harm any human until it can be certain that the person has turned away from the remembrance of Allah; and once this is ascertained--that is, when a human turns away from Allah--only then can the jinn harm him.Before discussing that jinn can harm humans, I will warn you against doing any of the following things, because Allah may also test you with illness. In such cases, patience alone will be your only weapon, and the remedies or healing measures prescribed in Islam will be your only provision.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Reasons Why Jinn Can Overpower Humans
ruqyah_articles.text: During its lifetime, the jinn gains immense power over the witch doctor and sorcerer. They make many magicians sick and even kill many; then the jinn possesses the offspring of that sorcerer and subdues them as well, because the jinn know very well that they have no power.Evil jinn only work on behalf of the sorcerer and grant some of his requests; the reason for fulfilling these requests is that the magician or witch doctor has disbelieved in Allah through his words or his recited incantations, there was something in his incantations that associates another entity as a partner with Allah, or he showed disrespect toward the Word of Allah through his actions. It is for these reasons that the jinn work for him and also fulfill some of his requests. On the other hand, the witch doctor fulfills all the desires of the jinn; he has to do this, because in this regard his position is one of humiliation, and he has no personal choice here.Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah (rahimahullah) said:If a person recites ruqyah and seeks only healing or a cure through it, he does not transgress the limits regarding the jinn; likewise, when a magician tells the jinn to kill someone whose killing is not permitted, or requests to detain someone who does not need to be detained. In this case, the jinn may target the magician solely because of his transgression, and this transgression is killing someone, making someone sick, or harming someone's family, children, or livestock. [Majmu' al-Fatawa, Volume 19]The witch doctors to whom people repeatedly turn are major devils. By using them, the jinn fulfill their desires and impose several conditions on the witch doctors, and the witch doctors in turn spread these conditions among the people who frequently visit them--such as slaughtering a bird in a specific manner, eating certain foods, or staying in a specific dark room for a period of time, etc. In this regard, the lower the witch doctor falls in terms of dignity, the more the evil of the malevolent jinn increases and the more terrifying it becomes, and despite fulfilling all the conditions of the jinn, none of that witch doctor's desires are fulfilled. Allah Ta'ala has revealed the truth regarding this:وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا ﴿٦﴾Translation: And indeed, there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they increased them in arrogance. (Surah Al-Jinn 72:6)

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Reasons Why Jinn Can Overpower Humans
ruqyah_articles.text: The jinn and devils also easily gain authority over those who frequently organize Zar circles and harm them in various ways; those who participate in these circles also become victims of severe harm. Such gatherings are organized primarily in the name of curing illness; women gather in one place, and then the jinn present their demands to the organizers of the Zar circles, such as--adorning the women with ornaments and beautiful clothes, making them wear their finest jewelry, slaughtering certain birds, applying a coating of blood on the women's faces, lighting candles, beating drums, and making the woman concerned dance to the rhythm of these drums in such a frenzy that pleases Shaytan. In many cases, this dancing woman is not ill at all, but because of sitting and dancing in the gathering, a jinn comes and takes possession of her body.In the midst of these tense situations, those poor dancing women think that their illness has been cured, but the jinn will then begin to present even more demands. And the number of times that woman's honor is violated in this gathering is what constitutes the Zar circle.Before me is a letter that came from Morocco, sent by a person who organized Zar circles; from this letter, I will briefly quote something here. I mention it here for those who take their women to such circles, my objective being to teach them something from it.The author of the letter says:I have written this letter motivated by the pain and suffering I have endured since 1984. And to speak openly, the sole reason for it was my negligence. Although I am a teacher, an educated person, able to speak Arabic and French fluently without any hesitation, despite that, I became addicted to alcohol, engaged in illicit relationships with women, and did not perform salah. From very early childhood, I saw Zar circles being organized in my house; my parents used to do this. In 1974, I divorced my first wife, who had given birth to a daughter of mine. From then on, I developed illicit relationships with other women; these women used to come to my mother for treatment. My job was to procure birds for them and slaughter them, write on candles for them, and prepare ta'weez.Ten years after this--in 1984--I began to suffer from waswasa. Whenever I saw two people talking together, I thought they were talking about me, and naturally, I would confront them without any reason and engage in quarrels. In 1985, I remarried, gave up drinking alcohol, and began to perform salah. But just then, something abnormal happened in my life. While staying in my home, I would often hear my neighbor's voice; my neighbor was hurling abuses at me, insulting me, and I also began to hear the voices of his wife and daughters. In this way, I began to hear the voices of all the neighbors living in that area; every one of them was verbally abusing me in the most foul and obscene manner possible, and when my patience could no longer hold, I would go and quarrel with them. I fell into great confusion, could not sleep, and at one point, I became mentally devastated. My neighbor and his wife even swore that they had never said such things to me. But even so, I could still hear their voices; even when they were not at home, I would still hear their voices.A few days later, I divorced my second wife; she too was carrying a child of mine. Once again, I became addicted to alcohol and began reciting magical incantations.Fifteen days later, I began to hear voices that no one else could hear, even when they were close to me. As a result, finding no other way, I turned to magicians. I spent a great deal of money on them, but gained no relief or cure. Some of these magicians set a schedule for me to burn incense, while another advised me to buy camel hair and burn it with incense, but all of these were futile efforts. My appearance became very hideous, I was constantly anxious, I had nightmares at night, I heard different voices, and I found no taste in food.Some time after this, we sold the house and moved elsewhere, but the situation was the same there as well. Those strange voices did not leave me. Sometimes those voices threatened me, and sometimes they told me to engage in immoral acts. During this time, my friends informed me of another magician. I went to him hoping that perhaps there was a cure for me with him. He gave me some names and advised me to recite them after every salah. Following his advice, I did everything, but all of it was futile. [Taken from a letter sent from Morocco to Shaykh Wahid Bali]Have you not seen what kind of immoral and evil acts take place in these gatherings, and how the jinn gained control over the author of this letter, as this man too used to organize such Zar circles? Therefore, beware of taking women to these gatherings.To the author of the letter, I say: You now need to do the following:1. Repent quickly for the immoral deeds you have committed, and shed tears over your sins.2. Go to a person who treats through the Noble Qur'an, as outlined in the previous section, so that he may treat you using the Qur'anic method, and beware of magicians.3. Regularly go to the mosque and perform salah in congregation.4. Recite the morning and evening adhkar, and recite the authentic du'as mentioned at the end of this book.5. Recite a portion of the Qur'an every day, and recite Surah Al-Baqarah at home every three days.6. Give charity (sadaqah) as much as possible.7. Perform voluntary acts of worship (nafl 'ibadah), such as staying awake at night for Qiyam or salah, observing voluntary fasts, etc. Perform these abundantly.8. Turn to Allah, make du'a abundantly, and seek out the times when du'a is accepted.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Reasons Why Jinn Can Overpower Humans
ruqyah_articles.text: Another reason for the jinn to gain authority over humans is practicing innovated adhkar, for which Allah has sent down no guidance.Some people sit alone in the seclusion of a dark room and continuously repeat certain verses or the names of Allah in an innovated manner, reciting them for a specific period of time, reciting them a specific number of times, and they believe that these verses or these names have a servant; so they seek help from this servant and keep calling upon him, and they do not stand up from that place until Shaytan comes and takes possession.Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah (rahimahullah) said:Lastly, I would say, the misguided people and those involved in innovation are those who practice asceticism and worship outside the Shari'ah, who sometimes try to make predictions and seek to exert influence through this, and frequently visit places where devils or evil jinn roam or gatherings of this kind where performing salah is forbidden, because the evil jinn come here and speak to them about certain matters, just as they speak to soothsayers. [Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmu' al-Fatawa, 19/41]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Reasons Why Jinn Can Overpower Humans
ruqyah_articles.text: A Jinn Targeting the Wrong PersonSometimes a jinn may target the wrong person without any purpose, just as foolish people do.A Jinn Falling in Love with a HumanSometimes a jinn may fall in love with a human and even desire to have them, just as happens among humans; therefore, for this reason as well, a jinn can exert influence over a human.A Jinn Punishing a HumanMany times, a person may harm a jinn without realizing it, such as falling on a jinn, throwing a stone at a jinn, urinating on a jinn, or pouring hot water onto a jinn's body. For these reasons, the jinn punishes the person far beyond what they deserve.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Verses That Punish the Jinn
ruqyah_articles.text: 1. Surah Al-Fatihah (1:1-7)بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿١﴾ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿٢﴾ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿٣﴾ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ﴿٤﴾ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ﴿٥﴾ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ﴿٦﴾ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ ﴿٧﴾Translation: (1) In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (2) All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. (3) The Most Gracious, the Especially Merciful, the Entirely Merciful, the Most Merciful. (4) Master of the Day of Judgment. (5) It is You we worship and You we ask for help. (6) Guide us to the straight path. Grant us guidance to the path. (7) The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor. Whom You have blessed. Not of those upon whom [Your] wrath has fallen, nor of those who are astray.2. Ayat al-Kursi (Al-Baqarah 2:255)اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾Translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him. He is the Self-Sufficient, the Ever-Sustaining, the Sustainer of everything. Neither drowsiness nor sleep touches Him. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is His. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows all that is before them and all that is behind them. Except for what He wills, they cannot encompass anything of His knowledge. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and the preservation of both does not fatigue Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.3. An-Nisa (4:167-173)إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا ضَلَالًا بَعِيدًا ﴿١٦٧﴾ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَظَلَمُوا لَمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ طَرِيقًا ﴿١٦٨﴾ إِلَّا طَرِيقَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا ﴿١٦٩﴾ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الرَّسُولُ بِالْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَآمِنُوا خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَكْفُرُوا فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا ﴿١٧٠﴾ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا تَغْلُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ ۚ إِنَّمَا الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ۖ وَلَا تَقُولُوا ثَلَاثَةٌ ۚ انتَهُوا خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّمَا اللَّهُ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ سُبْحَانَهُ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ ۘ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا ﴿١٧١﴾ لَّن يَسْتَنكِفَ الْمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبْدًا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَسْتَنكِفْ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَيَسْتَكْبِرْ فَسَيَحْشُرُهُمْ إِلَيْهِ جَمِيعًا ﴿١٧٢﴾ فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۖ وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اسْتَنكَفُوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فَيُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا ﴿١٧٣﴾Translation: (167) Indeed, those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the path of Allah have certainly gone far astray. (168) Indeed, those who disbelieve and commit injustice, Allah will not forgive them, nor will He guide them to any path, (169) except the path of Hell, wherein they will abide forever; and that is easy for Allah. (170) O mankind, the Messenger has certainly come to you with the truth from your Lord, so believe; it is better for you. But if you disbelieve, then indeed, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Ever-Knowing and Wise. (171) O People of the Scripture, do not commit excess in your religion and do not say about Allah except the truth. The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, was only a messenger of Allah and His word which He directed to Mary and a soul from Him. So believe in Allah and His messengers and do not say, 'Three'. Desist; it is better for you. Allah is only one God; He is exalted above having a son. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs. (172) Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allah, nor would the angels brought near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant, He will gather them all to Himself soon. (173) But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full and increase them out of His bounty. And as for those who disdained and were arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector or helper.4. Al-Ma'idah (5:33-34)إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ الَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا أَن يُقَتَّلُوا أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوا أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ أَوْ يُنفَوْا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لَهُمْ خِزْيٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ ﴿٣٣﴾ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ ﴿٣٤﴾Translation: (33) The punishment of those who wage war against Allah and His Messenger and strive to spread corruption on the earth is only that they be killed, or crucified, or their hands and feet be cut off from opposite sides, or they be expelled from the land. This is a disgrace for them in this world, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment. (34) Except for those who repent before you gain control over them; so know that Allah is Forgiving, Most Merciful.5. Al-An'am (6:93)وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَاسِطُو أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوا أَنفُسَكُمُ ۖ الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهِ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ﴿٩٣﴾Translation: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or says, "Revelation has been sent down to me," while nothing was revealed to him, and one who says, "I will send down the like of what Allah has sent down"? And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the agonies of death while the angels stretch forth their hands, [saying], "Deliver your souls! Today you will be recompensed with the punishment of humiliation because you used to say against Allah what was not true, and you were arrogant toward His verses."6. Al-A'raf (7:44-51)وَنَادَىٰ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ أَن قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدتُّم مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا ۖ قَالُوا نَعَمْ ۚ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن لَّعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ ﴿٤٤﴾ الَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ كَافِرُونَ ﴿٤٥﴾ وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ ۚ وَعَلَى الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَعْرِفُونَ كُلًّا بِسِيمَاهُمْ ۚ وَنَادَوْا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَن سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ ﴿٤٦﴾ وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَارُهُمْ تِلْقَاءَ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ﴿٤٧﴾ وَنَادَىٰ أَصْحَابُ الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُم بِسِيمَاهُمْ قَالُوا مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ﴿٤٨﴾ أَهَٰؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ۚ ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ ﴿٤٩﴾ وَنَادَىٰ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَفِيضُوا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ أَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ ۚ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ ﴿٥٠﴾ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَلَعِبًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚ فَالْيَوْمَ نَنسَاهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوا لِقَاءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَمَا كَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ ﴿٥١﴾Translation: (44) And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire (mockingly): "We have found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you also found what your Lord promised to be true and real?" They will say, "Yes, we have." Then an announcer will announce: "The curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers (45) who averted [people] from the path of Allah and sought to make it crooked, and were disbelievers in the Hereafter." (46) And between them will be a partition, and on the heights (Al-A'raf) are men who recognize each by their mark. And they will call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not yet entered it, but they hope. (47) And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they will say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people." (48) And the companions of the heights will call to men whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Your multitude and that in which you used to take pride have not availed you. (49) Are these the ones whom you swore that Allah would not include in His mercy? 'Enter Paradise, no fear shall be upon you, nor will you grieve.'" (50) And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever provision Allah has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allah has forbidden both to the disbelievers (51) who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today I will abandon them (in Hell) just as they abandoned working for the meeting of this Day of theirs and (just as) they used to deny My verses.7. Al-Anfal (8:12-13)إِذْ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ سَأُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعْبَ فَاضْرِبُوا فَوْقَ الْأَعْنَاقِ وَاضْرِبُوا مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ ﴿١٢﴾ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ ﴿١٣﴾Translation: (12) [Remember] when your Lord inspired the angels, "Indeed, I am with you, so keep firm those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike every fingertip of theirs." (13) That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.8. At-Tawbah (9:7)كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَعِندَ رَسُولِهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدتُّمْ عِندَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ۖ فَمَا اسْتَقَامُوا لَكُمْ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ ﴿٧﴾Translation: How can there be a treaty with Allah and His Messenger for the polytheists, except those with whom you made a treaty at Al-Masjid Al-Haram? So as long as they are true to you, be true to them. Indeed, Allah loves the righteous (muttaqeen).9. Surah Ibrahim (14:15-17)وَاسْتَفْتَحُوا وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ ﴿١٥﴾ مِّن وَرَائِهِ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّاءٍ صَدِيدٍ ﴿١٦﴾ يَتَجَرَّعُهُ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُ وَيَأْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ ۖ وَمِن وَرَائِهِ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ ﴿١٧﴾Translation: (15) And they sought victory, and disappointed was every obstinate tyrant. (16) Before him is Hell, and he will be given to drink of festering fluid. (17) He will try to swallow it and can hardly swallow it easily. And death will come to him from every side, yet he will not die. And beyond that is a severe punishment.10. Al-Hijr (15:17-18)وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ ﴿١٧﴾ إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ ﴿١٨﴾Translation: (17) And I have protected it from every expelled devil (Shaytan). (18) Except one who steals a hearing, then immediately a clear burning flame pursues him.11. Al-Isra (17:110-111)قُلِ ادْعُوا اللَّهَ أَوِ ادْعُوا الرَّحْمَٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا فَلَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا ﴿١١٠﴾ وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا ﴿١١١﴾Translation: (110) Say, "Call upon (your Lord as) 'Allah' or call upon 'Ar-Rahman' (the Most Merciful). Whichever name you call upon, to Him belong the best names." And do not be loud in your prayer, nor be too quiet in it, but seek an intermediate path between that. (111) And say, "All praise is for Allah, who has not taken a son, has no partner in [His] dominion, and needs no protector against humiliation." So declare His greatness completely.12. Al-Anbiya (21:70)وَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَخْسَرِينَ ﴿٧٠﴾Translation: And they intended a plot against him, but We made them the greatest losers.13. Ad-Dukhan (44:43-52)إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ ﴿٤٣﴾ طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ ﴿٤٤﴾ كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ ﴿٤٥﴾ كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ ﴿٤٦﴾ خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ ﴿٤٧﴾ ثُمَّ صُبُّوا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ ﴿٤٨﴾ ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ ﴿٤٩﴾ إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ ﴿٥٠﴾ إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ ﴿٥١﴾ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ﴿٥٢﴾Translation: (43) Indeed, the tree of Zaqqum (44) Is food for the sinner; (45) Like molten copper, it will boil in bellies (46) Like boiling water. (47) (It will be said), "Seize him, then drag him into the midst of Hell." (48) "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water." (49) (It will be said), "Taste [this]! Indeed, you were the honored, the noble." (50) "Indeed, this is what you used to doubt." (51) Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place, (52) Among gardens and springs.14. Al-Ahqaf (46:29-34)وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوا أَنصِتُوا ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ ﴿٢٩﴾ قَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنزِلَ مِن بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ﴿٣٠﴾ يَا قَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَآمِنُوا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ﴿٣١﴾ وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ ﴿٣٢﴾ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰ إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ﴿٣٣﴾ وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَى النَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ ﴿٣٤﴾Translation: (29) And [mention] when We directed toward you a party of the jinn, listening to the Qur'an. When they attended it, they said, "Listen quietly." Then when it was concluded, they returned to their people as warners. (30) They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a Book revealed after Moses, confirming what came before it, guiding to the truth and to a straight path." (31) "O our people, respond to the caller of Allah and believe in him; Allah will forgive your sins and protect you from a painful torment." (32) And whoever does not respond to the caller of Allah cannot escape [Him] on earth, and he will have no protectors besides Him. Those are in clear error. (33) Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and was not weary with their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes, indeed, He is competent over all things. (34) And the Day those who disbelieved are presented to Hell [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."15. Al-Hajj (22:19-22)هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوا فِي رَبِّهِمْ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّن نَّارٍ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الْحَمِيمُ ﴿١٩﴾ يُصْهَرُ بِهِ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُ ﴿٢٠﴾ وَلَهُم مَّقَامِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ﴿٢١﴾ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَن يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ ﴿٢٢﴾Translation: (19) These are two opposing parties who dispute concerning their Lord. But for those who disbelieve, garments of fire have been prepared. Scalding water will be poured over their heads. (20) By which whatever is inside their bellies and their skins will be melted. (21) And for them will be iron maces. (22) Whenever they want to get out of it from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the torment of the Burning Fire!"16. Maryam (19:68-72)فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا ﴿٦٨﴾ ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّا ﴿٦٩﴾ ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا ﴿٧٠﴾ وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا ﴿٧١﴾ ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا ﴿٧٢﴾Translation: (68) So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them around Hell on their knees. (69) Then We will surely drag out from every sect those of them who were most rebellious against the Most Merciful. (70) Furthermore, We know best of those who are most worthy of burning therein. (71) And there is not one of you but will pass over it; this is a final decree from your Lord. (72) Then We will save those who had taqwa (feared Allah), and leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees.17. Al-Mulk (67:5-11)وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَاطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ ﴿٥﴾ وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ ﴿٦﴾ إِذَا أُلْقُوا فِيهَا سَمِعُوا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ ﴿٧﴾ تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ ﴿٨﴾ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ ﴿٩﴾ وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ ﴿١٠﴾ فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ ﴿١١﴾Translation: (5) And We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and have made them missiles against the devils, and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze. (6) And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination. (7) When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a dreadful roaring while it boils up. (8) It almost bursts with rage. Every time a group is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?" (9) They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not revealed anything; you are not but in great error.'" (10) And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze." (11) And they will confess their sins, so destruction is for the companions of the Blaze.If the jinn is very cunning and refuses to leave and attempts to resist, then the raqi's method of nasal drops made from the Indian costus (an aromatic tree) plant can be followed.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Introduction
ruqyah_articles.text: The raqi will recite Ruqyah for the patient. In this case, the raqi's fear of Allah (taqwa) and closeness to Allah play the primary role in exerting influence over the jinn due to whose harm the illness was caused. Ibn Muflih al-Hanbali (rahimahullah) mentioned in his book Masa'ib al-Insan min Maka'id ash-Shaytan that, like humans, Shaytan also has seizures (abnormal heart palpitations, violent shaking in the body) when he comes near the heart of a person filled with the consciousness of faith. He further says:The heart that is filled with the consciousness of faith is always illuminated; there is heat in it; whenever any satanic whispering (waswasa) comes near this heart, it is turned to ashes. It is narrated that when the remembrance of Allah is firmly established in a person's heart, then if any devil or evil jinn comes near it, that devil also has a seizure (violent shaking in the body) like a human. At that moment, all the devils surround that devil from all sides and say, "What has happened to him?" Then it is said, "A human has overcome him." [Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmu' al-Fatawa, 19/41]It is noteworthy here that in the case of harm by jinn, the reciter's power of faith has an important impact. A weapon works well in the hands of its owner.The verses of the Qur'an that must be recited for the patient:After reciting Ruqyah, the following results may occur:1. The patient will feel a shaking (seizure) and the jinn will start speaking.2. The patient will not feel any seizure, but some other symptoms will manifest by which it will be understood that this problem occurred due to jinn.3. And if the problem is related to medical science or psychological, then nothing will happen.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: If the Patient Experiences Shaking and the Jinn Speaks
ruqyah_articles.text: So what needs to be asked in this case:1. The name of the jinn2. Its religion3. The reason why it possessed the human.If the reason for possessing the human body is for some evil purpose that Allah Almighty has prohibited, then it must be told that this is haram and whatever evidence there is against it must be established. It must further be told that it, like humans, is subject to the rules of Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ); Allah Almighty sent the Messenger (ﷺ) for both the human and jinn races.And if the jinn has done this to punish the person or settle an old score, that is, to take revenge, then it must be told that what this person did was done unwittingly and this person did not deliberately cause this harm, as a result of which he does not deserve to be punished. And if that person committed this flawed or harmful act to the jinn while sitting in his own house or on his own property, then in that case the jinn must be told: this is the human's own property, so he has the right to act in any permissible way in his own house; rather, you have no right to stay in a human's house or dwelling without permission. The raqi must remain firm in conveying the rules and principles of Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ), establish proof against them, and command them to do good and forbid them from evil. Allah Almighty says:وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًاTranslation: And We never punish until We have sent a messenger. (Surah Al-Isra 17:15)يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِي وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَاTranslation: 'O company of jinn and mankind, did there not come to you messengers from among you, reciting to you My verses and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?' (Surah Al-An'am 6:130)The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade killing any snake found in a dwelling house; after telling it three times to leave, the snake leaves the house; the hadith is narrated in Sahih Muslim, because just as unlawfully killing a human is not lawful in Islam, unlawfully killing a jinn is also not permissible. Evil deeds are haram in all cases; doing any kind of evil deed or wrongdoing against anyone is not permissible, even if he is a disbeliever.If the jinn responds to the raqi's earnest request, then well and good; and if it does not respond, then the raqi will rebuke the jinn, threaten it, curse it, and humiliate it, as narrated in Sahih Muslim on the authority of Abu Darda (RA). He said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up, and we heard him say:أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْكَ"I seek refuge in Allah to be saved from your hand."Then he said:"I curse you with the curse of Allah"After saying this three times, he stretched out his hand as if taking something. When the prayer was over, we said: O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we heard you say something that we had never heard before, and we saw you stretch out your hand.He said: "The enemy of Allah, Iblis, brought a brand of fire to throw into my face, and seeing this I said, 'I seek refuge in Allah to be saved from your hand'; after saying this three times I stretched out my hand intending to seize him, but by Allah, were it not for the supplication of my brother Sulayman, I would have bound him this morning, and the children of Madinah would be playing with him." [Agreed upon. Shaykh al-Albani (rahimahullah), Sahih al-Jami', Hadith no. 3108]In this hadith it was seen that one may seek refuge in Allah to be saved from Shaytan and may also curse him with the curse of Allah.If the jinn is expelled by reciting the Qur'an, commanding good and forbidding evil, rebuking, and cursing, then the objective will be achieved. And if because of this, that jinn falls ill or dies, it will only be due to its own fault, and the raqi will rather be rewarded for it. Because through this, the distress of a person who was wronged has been removed. In Islam, it is enjoined to help the wronged person as much as possible, and this is a recommended act. In the Sahihayn, it is narrated from al-Bara' bin 'Azib (RA),The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to do seven things and forbade us from seven things. He commanded us to visit the sick, attend funerals, say Yarhamukallah to the one who sneezes, fulfill oaths, extend a helping hand to a person who has been wronged, accept invitations, and give salam.And he forbade us from wearing gold rings, drinking from silver vessels, using horse saddles made of silk, wearing Qassi garments, and wearing silk garments embroidered with silk, gold, and silver, and patterned silk garments.It is narrated in As-Sahih that Anas (RA) said, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or he is oppressed."I said: "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we know how to help someone if injustice or wrong is done to him, but if he himself commits a vile and unjust act, how should we help him?" He said: "Restrain him from wrongdoing. That is the way to help him." Expelling the jinn relieves the pain of the person who is a victim of injustice or wrongdoing. It is narrated in Sahih Muslim from Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Whoever relieves a believer of a distress from the distresses of this world, Allah will relieve him of a distress on the Day of Resurrection. And whoever treats a person facing hardship with ease, Allah will make things easy for him in this world and the Hereafter. Whoever conceals the faults of a Muslim brother, Allah will conceal his faults in this world and the Hereafter. Allah continues to help a servant as long as that servant helps his Muslim brother." [Muslim 2699]It is narrated in Sahih Muslim from Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (RA), he said, when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about reciting ruqyah, he said,"Whoever among you can benefit his brother, let him do so." [Muslim 2199]These discussions and narrations are meant to encourage the raqi; however, the raqi should not keep asking the jinn purposeless questions, nor should he engage in prolonged discussions with the jinn. He must not deviate from his objective. This should not be done for the following reasons:1. Due to excessive questioning, the raqi may fall into the trap of Shaytan, and pride and arrogance may arise within himself.2. Due to unnecessary and excessive questioning, the jinn may think that the raqi lacks experience, as a result of which the jinn may become more cunning and refuse to manifest.3. Due to the longer duration of the seizure, the patient may become physically exhausted after regaining consciousness.Even after these efforts, if the jinn cannot be persuaded to manifest, then the raqi can recite those verses that punish the jinn; as a result, it will have an effect on the jinn, and these verses will punish the jinn and inflict severe pain upon it. The entire Qur'an is a healing and mercy for mankind. Allah says:وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًاTranslation: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss. (Surah Al-Isra 17:82)

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: What the Patient Must Do Alongside Ruqyah
ruqyah_articles.text: 1. The patient should consider himself strong, remain patient, and not sink into despair. The sick person must understand that observing patience during calamity is an essential requirement of faith in Allah's will and decree. And this belief in Allah's will and decree is one of the six pillars of faith.He must also realize that the calamity that has befallen him has occurred with Allah's knowledge, and it was decreed or commanded fifty thousand years before the creation of the heavens and the earth.Allah Almighty says:أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِي كِتَابٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ ﴿٧٠﴾Translation: Do you not know that Allah knows whatever is in the heaven and the earth? Indeed, that is in a Book. Surely, that is very easy for Allah. (Surah Al-Hajj 22:70)مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ ﴿٢٢﴾ لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا بِمَا آتَاكُمْTranslation: No calamity strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is recorded in a Book before We bring it into being. Indeed, that is very easy for Allah. In order that you not grieve over what has eluded you and not exult over what He has given you. (Surah Al-Hadid: 22-23)Once a patient understands that the calamity that has befallen him occurred with the knowledge of Allah and as a result of Allah Almighty's decree, then faith is surely within him, and in this condition he must observe patience, welcome this calamity with grace, and surrender himself to Allah. And once firm faith is formed within him, Allah will guide him, grant him contentment, make him worthy of reward, grant him the ability to bear calamity with patience, and above all, give him the capacity to express gratitude. And whoever receives guidance to the right path from Allah, he alone will attain peace of mind. Allah Almighty says:مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ﴿١١﴾ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ ﴿١٢﴾Translation: No calamity strikes except by the permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah, He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things. Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away, then the duty of My Messenger is only to convey the message clearly. (Surah At-Taghabun 64:11-12)From complete faith in Allah's will and decree, a person understands one thing: that he has no control over the various matters of this daily life, no control even over his deeply personal affairs, no control over his sustenance or his lifespan, nor any control over whether he will receive Allah's mercy or be cursed.Narrated from Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The first forty days of your creation process are spent in the mother's womb, then this embryo turns into an 'alaqah (a clinging clot of blood); then after the same period of time passes, this clot of blood becomes a chewed lump of flesh. Thereafter, Allah Almighty sends an angel who is appointed to record four matters of the human being in the mother's womb: his sustenance, the span of his life, his deeds, and whether that person will be cast into Hell or receive the fragrance of Paradise. By Allah, besides Whom there is no partner, then one of you may perform righteous deeds like the people of Paradise until the distance between you and Paradise is eighteen to twenty-two inches, then a decree may be issued and overtake you, and after that you will begin doing vile deeds like the dwellers of Hell and ultimately enter Hell. And the opposite of this can also happen: if one of you begins doing the deeds of the dwellers of Hell, until at one point the distance between you and Hell stands at merely eighteen to twenty-two inches, at that moment Allah's decree is issued and overtakes you. From then on, you will begin doing the deeds of the people of Paradise and finally enter Paradise." [Sahih Hadith, see: Sahih al-Jami' by Shaykh al-Albani (rahimahullah), Hadith no. 1543]Those who have faced disaster or calamity in life will understand that good outcomes come after enduring with patience for a long time, and behind this relief lies intense pain, while severe calamity comes very easily. Narrated from Ibn Abbas (RA), he said, once I was behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said to me: "O young man, I will give you some advice. Remember Allah, and you will find Him before you. When you ask for anything, let it be asking of Allah; when you seek help, seek Allah's help.Know that if the entire nation were to gather to benefit you in something, they would only be able to do for you what Allah has already decreed for you; likewise, if the entire nation were to gather to cause you harm, they would only be able to harm you with what Allah has decreed. The pens have been lifted and the pages have dried." [Sahih Hadith, see: Sahih al-Jami' by Shaykh al-Albani (rahimahullah), Hadith no. 1957, Sahih Muslim, Jami' at-Tirmidhi]It is mentioned in some hadiths: "Remember Allah in your days of happiness and ease, Allah will remember you in your days of hardship. You have to realize that what you grieved over or what you missed was never going to happen in your life, and what will happen in your life, you have never grieved for it. A good outcome comes after enduring with patience for a long time, and behind this relief lies intense pain, while severe calamity comes very easily."A person who has faced calamity in life must remember Allah's promises, and the promises are: an excellent reward, and the one who bears calamity with patience will attain a high status. In this regard, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said,"A person may attain a high status before Allah which he could not attain through performing righteous deeds; Allah continues to test him with what he dislikes until that person reaches that high status." [Hasan, Sahih al-Jami' of Shaykh al-Albani (rahimahullah), Hadith no. 1625]2. The patient must be certain that Allah Almighty alone is the Healer of diseases. And ruqyah is one of the Shariah-prescribed methods of seeking healing. That which is recited in ruqyah is the speech of Allah Himself. Allah Almighty says,وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَTranslation: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers. (Surah Al-Isra 17:82)The bottom line is, what matters regarding ruqyah is what has been recited in it, not who has recited it; therefore, we must not attach our hearts to any person.3. The patient should turn to Allah abundantly and make du'a. This is the best way to repel anything disliked and harmful, and the most effective means of healing from illness. When du'a is made fulfilling all necessary conditions, it becomes the prime enemy of disaster or calamity; this du'a repels calamity, alleviates the pain of calamity, prevents being afflicted by calamity, and if calamity does strike, it provides a means of cure from it. The believer's only weapon is du'a.Constantly making du'a and remaining steadfast in du'a is a great weapon; this weapon prevents illness from occurring, and if an illness occurs, it repels it. Al-Hakim narrated it in his Sahih book, narrated from 'A'ishah (RA), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Precaution is of no avail against the decree coming from Allah, but du'a is beneficial for the calamity or illness that has occurred, and it is also effective for that which has not yet occurred. Calamity or disaster may strike, and it is confronted with du'a. Calamity and du'a will remain engaged in battle with each other until the Day of Resurrection." [Hasan Hadith. See: Sahih al-Jami' of al-Albani (rahimahullah), Hadith no. 1625]Therefore, Muslims must make du'a with full attention and not with a distracted mind; that is, du'a should not be made feebly, so as not to seem as though it is being made from the heart of a weak-spirited person, like a loose bow from which an arrow shoots out very weakly.Narrated from Thawban (RA), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:لَا يَرُدُّ الْقَدَرَ إِلاَّ الدُّعَاءُ، وَلَا يَزِيْدُ فِي الْعُمُرِ إِلاَّ الْبِرُّ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُحْرَمُ الرِّزْقَ، بِالذَّنْبِ يُصِيْبُهُ"Nothing can change the decree of Allah except du'a; only righteous deeds can increase a person's lifespan; and a person may be deprived of sustenance due to the misdeeds he commits." [Weak Hadith. al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami', 1453]Likewise, one should not be hasty in getting an answer to du'a, nor abandon making du'a saying, 'I made du'a, but I received no response.' Narrated in Sahih al-Bukhari from Abu Hurairah (RA), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said,"You will be answered in your du'a as long as you are not hasty in this matter and say, 'I prayed, yet I received no response.'"It is mentioned in Sahih Muslim, "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), what causes a person to be hasty?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said,"When someone says, 'I have made du'a, I have made du'a, but I received no response,' and then he feels very despondent and abandons making du'a."Whoever raises his hands towards Allah to make du'a must verify what is halal and what is haram among his food, drink, and clothing. Imam Muslim (rahimahullah) narrated in his book, narrated from Abu Hurairah (RA), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"O people, know that Allah is Good, so He accepts only that which is good. Allah commands His servants with the very things He commanded His Messengers."Allah Almighty says:يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُلُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْTranslation: O you who have believed, eat from the lawful things which We have provided for you. (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:172)Then he mentioned a man who had set out on a long journey, disheveled and dusty from the exhaustion of travel. He raised both his hands toward the sky saying, "O my Lord, O Lord," but his food was haram, his clothing was haram, and he was nourished with haram; so how could his prayer be answered?He should choose six times for du'a to be accepted:1. The last third of the night.2. When the adhan is called.3. The time between the adhan and the iqamah.4. After performing the obligatory prayers.5. On Friday, from the time the Imam ascends the minbar until all prayers of that day are concluded.6. The last hour after Asr prayer on Friday.Above all, du'a should come from a humble heart, a heart bowed before Allah, a heart surrendered solely to Him, a heart earnestly pleading to Allah with humility; and du'a must be made by raising the hands, facing the Qiblah, and using appropriate words. The du'a of a guided person is accepted. For this, the supplicant must be in a state of purity.Du'a must be started by praising Allah and describing His greatness, then reciting blessings and peace upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), then he should draw Allah's attention by remembering Allah's beautiful names and attributes. After that, he should continue asking Allah with humility, weeping bowed before Him, calling upon Him with hope and fear, and thinking positively of Allah; in this manner, du'a should be made abundantly. In addition, before making du'a, one should give in charity halal and good things from one's most beloved wealth.When du'a is made in this manner, it is rarely rejected, and if someone makes du'a in the way the Messenger (ﷺ) described, then the likelihood of that du'a being answered is very high; du'a must be made by mentioning the names of Allah.To those who are distressed, the sick, and indeed to all Muslims, I would say: Who among us does not possess this effective weapon called du'a? Therefore, make du'a and use this powerful weapon. You have an excellent example to follow in the best of creation, our beloved Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ). He would supplicate earnestly to Allah until the whiteness of his armpits was visible and until the cloak fell from his shoulders, and even though he was above error, he would supplicate until his past and future sins were forgiven.4. The patient must seek forgiveness abundantly and repent. He should say:إِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَTransliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon.Translation: "Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed, to Him we shall return."لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِTransliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.Translation: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُTransliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni'mal-wakeel.Translation: "Allah alone is sufficient for us, and He is our excellent guardian."5. The patient should recite his dhikr and the Qur'an daily, and recite Surah Al-Baqarah at least once every three days.6. The patient must recite his adhkar every day in the morning and evening.7. He must perform voluntary acts of worship, salah, and fasting abundantly.8. He must maintain wudu as much as possible.9. He should not begin any task without the name of Allah, especially when eating and drinking.10. He must use various methods prescribed by the Shariah that will aid him in curing his illness, such as drinking water and washing with water over which the Qur'an has been recited. He should massage the body, the site of pain, and the chest with olive oil that has been blown upon after reciting verses of the Qur'an.Regarding whether reciting Quranic verses and blowing onto oil and water for a sick patient is a method prescribed in Islam, I asked Shaykh Abdullah al-Jibreen and Shaykh Muhammad bin Salih al-Uthaymeen, and they answered as follows: This is a method prescribed in Islam and there is no harm in it; it is narrated that many of the Salaf also did this.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Evidence of the Existence of Jinn and Demons
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionThe relationship between Jinn and sihr is a strong one; for the Jinn and demons are the driving force behind sihr. Some people deny the existence of Jinn and, therefore, sihr. Below is a brief list of the evidence on the existence of Jinn and demons:

* * *

Evidence from the Qur'an إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ ﴿٢٩﴾ Translation: And We turned to thee a company of Jinn giving ear to the Qur'an. (36:29) يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ Translation: Company of Jinn and mankind, did not Messengers come to you from among you, relating to you My signs and warning you of the encounter of this your day? (6:130) وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ ﴿٣٣﴾ Translation: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.Evidence from the Qur'an of the existence of Jinn and demons is numerous and known. Suffice it to say that there is one whole chapter on the Jinn (Chapter 62), and that statistically, the words Jinn occurs twenty two times, jan (another variant of Jinn) occurs seven times, Satan occurs sixty eight times, and Satans (demons) occurs seventeen times.

* * *

Evidence from the SunnahA'isha (RA) reported: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Angels were created out of light, Jinn were created from fire and Ādam was created out of what has been described to you." [Reported by Imam Ahmad (6/153-68) and Muslim (in Sharh An-Nawawi, 18/123)]Saffiyya bintu Huyay (RA) narrated : "The Prophet (ﷺ) circulates in the body of mankind like blood." [Reported by Al-Bukhari (4/282, in Fath Al-Bari) and Muslim (14/155, in Sharh An-Nawawi)]'Abdullah Ibn 'Umar (RA) reported: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'When you eat, use you right hand, and when you drink, use your right hand, because Satan eats and drinks with his left hand." [Reported by Muslim (13/191, in Sharh An-Nawawi)]Abu Hurayra (RA) reported: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Any newborn at the time of delivery is kicked by Satan, and cries as a result, except the son of Mariam (Jesus) and his mother." [Reported by Al-Bukhari (8/212) and Muslim (15/120, in Sharh An-Nawawi)]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Evidence on the Existence of Sihr
ruqyah_articles.text: Evidence from the Qur'an وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا لَمَنِ اشْتَرَاهُ مَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٠٢﴾ Translation: ...And they follow what the Satans recited over Sulayman's Kingdom. Sulayman disbelieved not but the Satans disbelieved, teaching the people sorcery, and that which was sent down upon Babylon's two angels, Harut and Marut; they taught not any man, without they said, 'We are but a temptation; do not disbelieve.' From them they learned how they might divide a man and his wife, yet they did not hurt any man thereby, save by the leave of Allah, and they learnt what they hurt them and did not profit them, knowing well that whosoever buys it shall have no share in the world to come; evil then was that they sold themselves for; if they had but known (2:102) قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾ Translation: Say: 'I take refuge with the Lord of the daybreak from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness when it gathers, from the evil of the women who blow on knots, from the evil of an envier when he envies.' (Chapter 113)According to Al-Qurtubi (R), (…From the evil of the women who blow on knots) implies female sorcerers (sahirat) who blow on thread knots while making their spells. [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi (20/257)]Verses on sihr and sahara are profuse and known even to those with little knowledge of Islam.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: 1\. Sihr of Separation
ruqyah_articles.text: وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا لَمَنِ اشْتَرَاهُ مَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٠٢﴾ Translation: and they follow what the Satans recited over Sulayman's Kingdom Sulayman disbelieved not but the Satans disbelieved, teaching the people sorcery, and that which was sent down upon Babylon's two angels, Harut and Marut; they taught not any man, without they said, 'We are but a temptation; do not disbelieve' From them they learned how they might divide a man and his wife, yet they did not hurt any man thereby, save by the leave of Allah, and they learnt what they hurt them and did not profit them, knowing well that whosoever buys it shall have no share in the world to come; evil then was that they sold themselves for; if they had but known. (2:102)Jabir (RA) reported that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Iblis would lay his throne on water and would send his brigade of demons. The lowest among them in rank is the one who is most notorious in stirring up fitna One of the demons would, after a mission, come and say to Iblis, I have done so and so.' Iblis would reply, 'You have not done anything.' Another one would come and say: 'I have not left such and such person until I separated him from his wife' Iblis would come closer to his demon and say, 'How good you are " [Muslim in An-Nawawi : 17/157]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Definition of Sihr of Separation
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionIt is a sihr which aims to separate between two spouses, or stir up hatred between two friends or two partners.

* * *

Types of Sihr of Separation1. Separating a person from his/her mother.2. Separating a person from his/her father.3. Separating a person from his/her brother.4. Separating a person from his/her friend.5. Separating a person from his/her business partner.6. Separating a person from his/her spouse. This is the most dangerous and prevalent type.

* * *

Symptoms of Sihr of Separation1. A sudden change in attitude from love to hate.2. A great deal of suspicion is aroused between the two people concerned.3. No excuses are accepted by either party, even if one of them is in the wrong.4. Exagerating the causes of disputes between two people, even though they may be trivial.5. Changing the mental image that a woman may have of her husband, or changing the mental image that a man may have of his wife; so that the man would see his wife in an ugly way, even though she were beautiful in reality, it is the demon who is entrusted with the task of performing this type of sihr is the one who would appear to the husband in her person, but in an ugly way. By the same token, the woman would see her husband in a horrible way.6. The person affected by sihr hates anything the other party does.7. The person affected by sihr hates the place in which the other party stays. For instance, a husband may be in a good mood when he is outdoors, but when he returns home, he feels quiete depressed.According to Al-Hafidh Ibn Kathir (R), the cause of separation between two spouses through this sihr is that each of them appears to the other as an ugly or ill-mannered person. [Tafsir Ibn Kathir: 1/144]

* * *

How does the sihr of separation take place?A person goes to a sorcerer and requests that a certain person be separated from his wife. The sorcerer would ask his client to provide the name of the person and that of his mother, and traces of the person's smell from his/her hair, garment or handkerchief etc. If this is too difficult to obtain, the sorcerer would perform sihr on some water, then ask his client to spill it along the way which that person normally uses.
