Abu Qatadah (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Shaytan. Therefore, whoever sees something that he dislikes, he should blow to his left three times saying 'A'oodhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem', and it will certainly not harm him. (Sahih al-Bukhari: 12/283 with Fath and Sahih Muslim: 15/16 with Nawawi)10. Narrated from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When one of you yawns, he should cover his mouth with his hand, for Shaytan enters it. (Sahih Muslim: 18/122 with Nawawi and Sunan ad-Darimi: 1/321)There are many more hadiths on this subject. Therefore, it is proven from this that the existence of jinn and Shaytan is a real truth. There is no room for doubt about it.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Opinions of the Salaf
ruqyah_articles.text: Statements and Opinions:1. Al-Khattabi (rahimahullah) said: A group of naturalists deny magic and refute its reality.The answer: Indeed, magic is proven and possesses reality. The Arabs and non-Arabs, namely Persia, the countries of the Indian subcontinent, the Romans, and most such nations agree that magic is proven. Yet they are among the greatest nations of the world in terms of knowledge and science.And Allah the Almighty says:يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السَّحْرَTranslation: "Teaching people magic." (Surah Al-Baqarah: 102)Similarly, Allah the Almighty commands seeking refuge from magic, saying:وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِTranslation: And from the evil of the blowers in knots. (Surah Al-Falaq: 4)He further said: Regarding this matter, so many reports have come from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that none denies them except those who deny reality. Moreover, the Islamic jurists have also shed light on what the punishment of a magician is. And that which has no basis would not be discussed and become so well-known. Therefore, denying magic (its existence) is ignorance, and refuting those who deny magic is a futile matter." (Sharh as-Sunnah: 12/188)2. Imam an-Nawawi said: The correct view is that magic indeed has a real existence. This is the view of the majority of scholars and the general scholars. This view is proven by the Qur'an and well-known authentic hadiths. (Compiled from Fath al-Bari: 10/222)3. Abu al-'Izz al-Hanafi (rahimahullah) said: Many differ regarding the reality and types of magic; but the majority say: Indeed, it exerts an influence on the death and illness of the bewitched person, without any apparent external action------. (Sharh al-'Aqidah at-Tahawiyyah: 505)4. Ibn Qudamah (rahimahullah) said: Under the influence of magic, people become physically and mentally ill, die, and separation occurs between husband and wife. Allah the Almighty says:فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِTranslation: "They learned from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife." (Compiled from Fath al-Majid: 314)Therefore, conclusive evidence is found regarding magic that it certainly exists, and the Messenger (ﷺ) forbade going to a magician. And the Prophet (ﷺ) would not forbid something that does not exist. Thus, it is understood from this that magic exists.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: Imam ar-Razi (rahimahullah) divided magic into seven categories.1\. The magic of star-worshippers:They used to worship seven revolving stars, and their belief was that these stars govern the universe and that good and evil come to people by their decree. And to them Allah the Almighty sent Ibrahim (AS).2\. The magic of illusion-prone and hard-hearted people:People are deeply influenced by imagination and illusion; for it is not as easy for a person to walk on a rope or bamboo over the deep sea, or over something dangerous, or on a suspended bamboo, as it is to walk on land. He further said: For instance, medical scientists agree that a patient with a nosebleed should not look at anything red. This is solely because human nature is boundlessly prone to illusion.3\. Magic with the assistance of jinn:Jinn are of two types: 1. Believers and 2. Disbelievers. Disbelieving jinn are called devils. Imam ar-Razi said: Magicians convey the effects of magic through devils.4\. Sleight of hand and optical illusions:This is a technique that attracts human sight and attention from all directions, confines it to a specific area, and makes the person a fool.5\. Demonstrating astonishing acts:This is shown by setting up some mechanism. For example: a horseman has a horn that sounds on its own from time to time, or like an alarm clock that rings at a specific time. Someone arranges something like this differently and presents it as magic. He said: This is in fact a real matter, not magic; whoever acquires its knowledge is able to do it.6\. Using a specific substance as medicine:Such as by mixing it into food or oil. He said: Know that there is no way to deny the effects of specific substances. For example: a magnet.7\. The magician performs magic by winning the belief of people's hearts:For example, he claimed that he knows the Ism al-A'zam and that the jinn are obedient to him; when a person is influenced by all these words of his, cannot distinguish between truth and falsehood, and places trust in him, then he loses his intellect, and at that moment it is possible for the magician to do whatever he wants.Fabricating and conveying one person's words to another secretly, subtly, and attractively, which is widely prevalent among people. (Tafsir Ibn Kathir: 1/148)Ibn Kathir (rahimahullah) said: Imam ar-Razi included many of the aforementioned types under the category of magic because subtlety is found in all of them. And the linguistic meaning of magic is that whose cause is extremely subtle and hidden. (Ibn Kathir: 1/147)

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: Imam Raghib (rahimahullah) said: Magic is used in various meanings:1. Everything that is extremely subtle and concealed. That is why it is said سحرت الصبي, meaning, I deceived the child and attracted him. Therefore, whoever can attract anything, it is as though he has bewitched it. Included in this is the poetry of poets, for captivating hearts. Similarly, the saying of Allah:بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَTranslation: Our eyes have only been dazzled; rather, we are a people bewitched. (Surah Al-Hijr: 15)Included in this is what is narrated in the hadith:إن من البيان لسحرًاIndeed, some speech is magical.2. That which is done through deception, having no reality, such as: the acts of illusionists, who bewitch people's eyes through the subtlety of sleight of hand.3. Whatever is attained with the help of Shaytan by seeking closeness to him. It is to this that the words of Allah allude:وَلٰكِنَّ الشَّيٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَTranslation: "But the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic." (Surah Al-Baqarah: 102)4. The magic of astrologers through star worship. (From Fath al-Bari. Taken from: 10/222, and see Al-Mufradat of Raghib al-Isfahani)

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: Through research and examination of the classifications of magic by Imam Razi, Raghib, and other scholars, it becomes clear that they included within magic certain things that do not belong to it. The reason is that they did so on the basis of the literal/lexical meaning of magic--that is, that whose cause is subtle and hidden. Because of this, they included many such things within magic--such as wondrous creations, things done by sleight of hand, or what is secretly instigated between people--the causes of which are subtle, obscure, and hidden.The aforementioned matters are not our topic of discussion; rather, our subject and focus here will be centered on real magic, in which the magician generally relies and depends upon the jinn and Shaytan. Another noteworthy point is what Imam Razi and Raghib described, which is named the spirituality or actions of the stars; but in this case as well, the reality is that the star is a creation of Allah, subject to His command; therefore, the star has no spirituality or inherent influence over any creation.If someone says: We do observe that certain magicians, according to their assumptions, utter certain names for the stars, chant incantations, or gesture toward and address them, as a result of which the magical effect also takes real form before the spectator?The answer: If that is indeed the case, it is not actually due to the influence of the star; rather, it happens through the influence of Shaytan to misguide the magician and plunge him into fitnah. Just as it is narrated that when they used to address stone idols, Shaytan would answer with a voice from within the idol. And they thought that it was their deity, but in reality it was not. Therefore, there are many ways to misguide people. May Allah protect us all from the evil of the devils among mankind and jinn. Ameen.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Some Information Regarding the Treatment of Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: 1. Qatadah (RA) said: I asked Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib (rahimahullah), "Can incantations be performed if a person is sick or for impotence?" He said, "There is no prohibition against it, because what is intended by it is the welfare of people." (Fath al-Bari: 10/232)2. Imam al-Qurtubi (rahimahullah) said: The Muslim scholars have a difference of opinion on this matter. Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib validated treating people by countering magic with magic. Imam Muni (rahimahullah) expressed this opinion.Imam ash-Sha'bi (rahimahullah) said: There is no harm if the incantation is in the Arabic language; but Hasan al-Basri (rahimahullah) considered it disliked (makruh). (Al-Qurtubi: 2/49)3. Ibn Qudamah (rahimahullah) said: If the practitioner treating magic treats through verses of the Qur'an or through any dhikr, or through words in which there is no element of disbelief (kufr), then there is no hindrance; but if it is done through magic itself, then Imam Ahmad (rahimahullah) turned away from it. (Al-Mughni: 10/114)4. Hafidh Ibn Hajar (rahimahullah) said: The saying of the Prophet (ﷺ):النشرة من عمل الشيطانMeaning, "Incantation is part of the work of Shaytan." (Musnad Ahmad and Sunan Abi Dawud)Its intent is fundamentally this, but that whose intention is good, there is no harm in it. Ibn Hajar further said: Incantations are of two types:First: Permissible incantation: This method is treating magic through the Qur'an and Shar'i supplications.Second: Prohibited incantation: This type is that through which magic is undone by magic. That is, to undo magic, Shaytan is pleased and his help is sought by gaining his closeness and pleasure. And the hadith of the Messenger (ﷺ):النشرة من عمل الشيطانMeaning, "Incantation is part of the work of Shaytan," generally points to this. For this reason, the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade going to fortune-tellers and magicians in several hadiths and deemed it disbelief (kufr).

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Some Information Regarding the Treatment of Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: 1. Hafidh Ibn Hajar (rahimahullah) said that the words of Allah:إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْTranslation: "We are only a trial, so do not disbelieve." (Surah Al-Baqarah: 102)This ayah proves that learning magic is kufr. (Fath al-Bari: 10/225)2. Ibn Qudamah (rahimahullah) said: Learning and teaching magic is prohibited, and all the people of knowledge agree on this that it is haram. The followers of Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal (rahimahullah) said that whoever learns or teaches magic becomes a disbeliever (kafir), even if he believes that magic is unlawful. (Al-Mughni: 10/106)3. Imam Abu Abdullah ar-Razi (rahimahullah) said: Learning about magic is neither detestable nor prohibited. Because there is consensus among all learned scholars on this matter that acquiring knowledge is generally permissible. For example, the words of Allah:قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَTranslation: Say: "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" (Surah Az-Zumar: 9)Another point is that if one has no conception of magic, how will we be able to differentiate between magic and miracles (mu'jizah)? In order to determine this distinction, it is necessary to know about this matter. Therefore, acquiring knowledge of magic cannot be prohibited.4. Ibn Kathir (rahimahullah) said regarding the aforementioned opinion of Imam ar-Razi (rahimahullah): It is not acceptable for several reasons. Firstly, if this opinion is accepted rationally and logically that learning magic is not a bad thing, then the point is that the Mu'tazilah, who give precedence to logic, consider learning magic prohibited. And if it is thought that there is no prohibition in the Shari'ah, then the answer to it is the saying of Allah the Exalted:وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُTranslation: "They followed what the devils recited during the reign of Sulayman (AS)." (Surah Al-Baqarah: 102)In this ayah, learning magic has been termed an affair of Shaytan.It is in Sahih al-Bukhari that whoever goes to a fortune-teller or a magician has indeed disbelieved in what was revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ). Allamah ar-Razi's statement that magic is not prohibited has no valid evidence to support it. And comparing magic with noble knowledge and citing this saying of Allah the Exalted:قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَTranslation: "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" (Surah Az-Zumar: 9)as proof is not correct. Because in this ayah, praise has been given to the bearers of Shar'i knowledge (not magicians).And the statement that in order to know miracles one must also know magic is not correct, because the greatest miracle is this Qur'an revealed to our Prophet (ﷺ). And there is no resemblance between magic and miracles. Another matter is that the Sahaba, Tabi'in, and all such Muslims were aware of miracles; they did not feel the need to have knowledge of magic. (Tafsir Ibn Kathir: 1/145)5. Allamah Abu Hayyan mentioned in his book Bahr al-Muhit that if magic is such that shirk is committed through it--that is, describing the greatness of and worshiping Shaytan and stars--then learning it is haram by consensus of all. Learning it and acting upon it is haram. Similarly, if its objective is bloodshed, or causing separation between husband and wife or friends, learning it and acting upon it is not permissible.And whatever is fraud, sleight of hand, and things of this sort, it is also not appropriate to learn them, because they are false and futile, even if amusement and play are intended by them. (Rawai' al-Bayan: 1/85)The essence of all the above statements is: whichever type magic may be, even if it is related to amusement and play, it is impermissible in all circumstances.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Some Information Regarding the Treatment of Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: Allamah al-Maziri said: The difference between magic, mu'jizah, and karamah is that in magic, the magician achieves his self-interest through training in specific methods of incantations and deeds. On the other hand, karamah occurs suddenly in a miraculous manner. And mu'jizah is distinct in character from karamah because through it, opponents are challenged.Hafidh Ibn Hajar (rahimahullah), quoting Imam al-Haramayn, mentions that everyone agrees magic is manifested only through the hands of a fasiq (grave sinner). On the other hand, the manifestation of karamah never occurs through the hands of a fasiq.Ibn Hajar (rahimahullah) further said, everyone must be aware that if an abnormal and extraordinary matter is manifested by a person who is obedient to the Shari'ah and free from major sins, it will be karamah; otherwise, it will be magic. Because magic occurs with the help of Shaytan.Note: Sometimes it may even happen that a person is not a magician, nor does he know anything about magic, nor is he a proper follower of the Shari'ah, but rather commits major sins, or is a grave-worshiper and innovator; yet even then, it is seen that something miraculous occurs through him.The secret behind this is that Shaytan assists him so that common people are attracted to his innovated path. And people abandon this Sunnah and adopt satanic methods. Incidents of this kind are many, occurring especially in the case of leaders of Sufi orders.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Conditions That a Magician Must Fulfill
ruqyah_articles.text: 1. He must sell his soul, all his property, home, and children--everything to Shaytan.2. He must be extremely cunning, unyielding, and crafty, so that no one can sway him from this satanic belief of his, even though he will have to face various forms of insult and humiliation because of these beliefs.3. He must be foolish, having no shame, awareness, or any feeling, no mercy worth acknowledging, no compassion, or any other kind of emotion or feeling of magnanimity.4. If his master Shaytan or any of his followers appears before him in a terrifying form, he will not be afraid, or if a sword for beheading or an executioner's hangman's noose is brought before him. Even then he will not be afraid.5. If Iblis delays in helping him or withdraws any assistance, he will not complain about it or be irritated; rather, he will remain steadfast with all his might to obtain this help without any complaint, nor will he give up. Even if he is told to do something that is forbidden according to all religions, etiquette, customs, and laws followed by humanity, he will not hesitate to do it.6. He will continue the work of sorcery by exerting all his strength and remain engaged in studies related to it, do everything required according to satanic rituals, and attend the assemblies of Shaytan without caring whether any harm might come to him or to any other person in society through these acts; in this regard, he will perform all tasks with discipline and within the specified time.7. In regard to all beautiful and valuable things, he must naturally or deliberately be ignorant.8. He must believe in the power and capability of Shaytan, and must also believe in the power of those spirits of Shaytan who assist him, and be obedient to the commands of Shaytan, accepting all of Shaytan's terms, conditions, and laws.9. He must be a sworn enemy of all religions; he must express hatred toward all religions, mock them, and show contempt for all revealed Scriptures, tearing up these Scriptures and showing disrespect toward them.10. He will be ready to commit any kind of crime or sin, and he will remain immersed in immorality and licentiousness.11. He must be an exemplar in obscenity and baseness, which will be reflected in his clothing and lifestyle. He must permanently abandon the use of soap and water until a foul stench develops on his body, and by this foul stench he will be known among his peers.12. He will spend most of the time, and if possible all of the time, in isolated, remote, and deserted areas. Furthermore, as part of magic and for harming people, unless instructed to do so, he cannot interact with them or communicate with them." [Ibrahim Muhammad al-Jamal, Al-Sihr, pp. 38-39]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: What a Magician Does in Society
ruqyah_articles.text: The magician wants to spread all kinds of harmful and corrupt acts in society, and he enjoys doing so. He does not hesitate to cause any harm to creation or commit any terrible evil deed, nor does he refrain from such acts. The acts that the magician carries out include--destroying crops and livestock, setting fires, ruining trade goods, creating discord between husband and wife, causing infertility in married couples, producing creams that destroy human desire, causing miscarriages, making people insane, confused, or inattentive, preparing powders that create love or hatred, spoiling engagements by casting spells, and rendering the husband impotent before marriage, etc.Then, this magician begins to act like a germ, eating away at the spine and bones of society until it is weakened. If this germ is not destroyed, eventually the entire body will succumb to weakness. For this reason, Islam has taken a strict stance against magic and the magician. According to the most correct and reliable scholars, these magicians must be executed, and shedding their blood without first giving them the opportunity to repent is also permissible.Allah Ta'ala says:وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْTranslation: And Sulaiman did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved. They taught people magic and (they followed) that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But they did not teach anyone until they had said, 'We are only a trial, so do not disbelieve.' (Al-Baqarah 2:102)If it is asked: Where an apostate is given the opportunity to repent, why is the magician not given the opportunity to repent? According to the Maliki school, the answer to this question is--magic is like heresy, and a heretic is not given any opportunity to repent.Executing the magician was the path demonstrated by Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA). It is narrated in Sunan Abi Dawud that Bajalah ibn 'Abdah said: I was the scribe of Juz' ibn Mu'awiyah, the uncle of al-Ahnaf ibn Qays. Once, a letter came to us from Umar (RA) before his death, in which it was stated: "Kill every magician." [Sunan Abi Dawud, 3/228, Hadith No. 3043] and the chain of transmission of this hadith is also sahih. [Musnad al-Imam Ahmad, 1/190, 192; al-Bayhaqi, 8/136; Ibn Hazm, al-Muhalla, 11/397]There is another sahih hadith regarding the killing of magicians. Narrated from the Mother of the Believers Hafsah (RA), and it is recorded in Muwatta Imam Malik from Abdur-Rahman ibn Sa'd ibn Zurarah, that he heard that the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Hafsah (RA), executed a slave-woman because that slave-woman had cast magic on her. Hafsah (RA) had a written contract of emancipation with this slave-woman; she ordered that the slave-woman be put to death. [Muwatta, p. 543]Many Companions also supported executing the magician; they are--Umar ibn al-Khattab, Uthman ibn Affan, Ibn Umar, the Mother of the Believers Hafsah, and Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (RA). [Tafsir al-Qurtubi, 2/48]Among the Imams, Imam Abu Hanifah and Malik supported this opinion, and Imam Ahmad narrated this hadith.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: How a Magician Performs Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: Whoever wants magic to be performed, whether a man or a woman, goes to the magician and requests magic to be cast on a specific person. Or they may think that this person is not a magician, so they request him to treat them or one of their relatives. At this stage, the magician asks for the name of the person on whom magic is to be cast and their mother's name, and tells them to bring their worn clothing, hair from their head, or their photograph.But why does the magician ask for the mother's name instead of the father's name? The reason is that this magician and the jinn with him are disbelievers; they reject all religions and divine laws and mock them. Therefore, they do not recognize lawful marriage contracts either. According to the magician, everyone who comes to him is illegitimate and born through zina--which Allah has forbidden. Then the magician counts the letters of both names. If he considers that the name is close to earth (al-teen), he buries his magical incantation in the earth, and if the name is close to water (al-ma'), he submerges his incantation in water--such as throwing it into a well. Just as the Jew Labid ibn al-A'sam did when casting magic on the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). When Labid counted the letters of the name of Muhammad (ﷺ) and found that in the names of Muhammad and his mother Aminah, the letters Alif and Meem were repeated and that this was close to water (al-ma'), he threw his magical spell into a well called Dharwan.If the name is close to water, the magician submerges his amulet in a well or in the sea. And if the name is close to the wind, they hang this amulet from a tree, a date palm, or a high wall. After that, he burns incense as an offering to the jinn, because the jinn consume the incense offered to them. Along with burning incense, the magician recites words of disbelief and shirk, displaying deep respect and honor toward the leaders of the jinn. There is a different incense for each type of magic. Then the magician begins to write his spell or amulet; this is much like a letter written expressing servitude to the leaders of the jinn, showing respect to the leaders of the jinn, and showing disrespect toward the words of Allah.Then the jinn present their conditions to the magician, and the magician imposes these conditions on the patient who came to him to take an amulet; the patient is asked to participate in a Zar circle, and is commanded, according to the conditions, to slaughter a specific animal, eat a specific type of food, and remain in seclusion in a dark room for a specific period of time. And if this spell or amulet is burned, or destroyed or nullified, then the matter becomes easy for the victim. For this reason, many magicians, in order to protect their amulets, place the amulet inside a copper container and seal the opening with lead. Many common people call this method hijab. Then the magician summons the jinn to carry out its mission against the victim. This mission is to make the victim sick, create hallucinations in him, and cause division between him and his wife.This jinn is called the servant of magic. This servant jinn identifies the affected person by smelling the belongings they used, the scent of their clothes, and looking at their photograph. Then it continues to follow the affected person and observes their various affairs. If in its inquiry it realizes that the affected person does not always remain steadfast in Allah's commands, then its mission becomes easy; then the jinn possesses that person or creates hallucinations in them by showing terrifying things, plunging them into severe pain and depression. But if the jinn sees that the affected person always remains steadfast in Allah's commands and the victim is very Allah-fearing, then the jinn fears him and continues to follow him; whenever the victim turns away even slightly from the remembrance of Allah or becomes very angry, the jinn takes advantage of that moment. Taking this opportunity, it possesses the victim. Then the magician continues his magic with the help of an intermediary between him and the servant jinn; this intermediary brings news of the daily results and conveys the magician's instructions to the servant jinn.If the victim is Allah-fearing and pious, and recites daily dhikr, then the magician's servant jinn fears him, and this fear of Allah in the victim exhausts the jinn, so that the magic cannot have any effect on him. If the intermediary had not advised this servant jinn to be patient and enticed it with rewards from Shaytan or threatened to kill it, this jinn would have fled. But if the victim's iman is weak and there is no true relationship with Allah, then this becomes a problem for him, because taking advantage of this weakness, the magician is able to exert an adverse effect on his body, the reflection of which is seen in the victim's life, and through this magic he gets entangled in such an ordeal that may have no end, and this problem of his may persist until death.Here we will become acquainted with two types of spells or amulets; one type of amulet is introduced inside the sick patient's body through food or drink, or through perfume, or by shaking hands with the patient; another type of amulet is kept outside, perhaps buried somewhere. Or hung from a tree.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Effects of Magic on the Afflicted Person
ruqyah_articles.text: The effect of magic falls upon the victim in two ways; either the magic will exert an internal effect inside the patient's body; or there may also be an external effect, such as: if the magic affects the patient externally or from a distance, then in that case this magic can create hallucinations and anxiety in the patient. That is, the effect will be according to how the magician conducts his magic. I am presenting this information here for those whose lives are devastated by falling into the clutches of magic, so that they can treat it themselves or so that this information may be of benefit to raqis in treating the patient.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Effective Information Regarding Magic
ruqyah_articles.text: The best way to treat and prevent sihr (magic) is the method prescribed by the Shariah. Because sending a victim to a magician for treatment can be tantamount to a battle between two groups of jinn involving him, where the victim's fate will depend on the outcome of the battle; the two groups of jinn may reach an agreement to expel the servant jinn for some time, but after this period that servant jinn will return again and continue its activities. But in contrast, neither jinn nor magician can resist the treatment performed in the manner directed by the Qur'an.لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِTranslation: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and split from fear of Allah. (Surah Al-Hashr 59:21)The effect of sihr is for a limited time; once the ta'weez (amulet) is destroyed, it no longer has any efficacy after a short while. For this reason, some magicians follow up on their spells and renew these amulets from time to time.There are several benefits for a sick person in following a routine and regularly reciting morning and evening adhkar. These benefits are--1. Cutting off the return path of the intermediary between the magician and the jinn, which is known in military terminology as cutting off the supply line.2. Weakening the servant jinn by killing it or forcing it to flee.3. If the magician wishes to renew his amulet, in that case, he will have to face many complications in conducting this mission.Every act of sihr requires a magician, a victim, an amulet, certain specific items for sihr, and an intermediary to work between the victim and the magician.Often the magician ties the tongue of his servant jinn, as a result of which the victim cannot speak. Very recently, in such an incident, a woman's speech was stopped for six months.She was undergoing treatment at a psychiatric hospital, and this treatment ended in her separation from her husband. The magician failed to cure her; finally, she was treated in the light of the Qur'an.There are also magicians among the jinn. A magician can also cast sihr on a jinn and send it to the victim through this; in this case, the sihr cast upon the victim becomes very complicated.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Signs by Which a Magician Can Be Recognized
ruqyah_articles.text: 1. He will ask for someone's name and their mother's name.2. He will ask to slaughter an animal or a bird, whether this animal has any specific characteristics or not, or whether the blood of this animal is rubbed on the body or not.3. He will instruct the patient to consume a specific type of food or drink for a specific period of time, and tell him to live isolated from people in a dark room during this period.4. He will give the patient some paper to burn and tell him to inhale the smoke from burning this paper, or advise him to hang it somewhere or bury it.5. Those who write letters of names or numbers, or tear up paper containing the words of Allah, are all magicians.6. Those who utter incomprehensible words or chant incantations in any language other than Arabic are all magicians.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Warning Against Going to a Magician
ruqyah_articles.text: We understood that magicians are disbelievers, and the prescribed punishment for them in Islam is beheading with a sword. Islam has forbidden Muslims from going to a magician; we will now explain this matter. It has been narrated from al-Bazzar with a hasan chain that Ibn Abbas says, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"They are not of my ummah: those who take omens from birds as good or evil, or who foretell the future or have their future foretold, or who practice sihr (magic) or have sihr practiced for them. Whoever goes to a magician and believes what he says, disbelieves in the Book of Allah revealed to Muhammad (ﷺ)." [At-Tabarani, from al-Bazzar with a jayyid chain]Narrated from Abu Hurairah (RA) in Sahih al-Bukhari and Muslim, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Keep yourselves away from seven sins that will throw people into Hell."They said: O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), what are those sins? He said:"Associating anyone as a partner with Allah, practicing sihr, killing a soul which Allah has forbidden except as permitted by Islamic Shariah, consuming usury (riba), consuming the property of orphans, fleeing from the battlefield, and falsely accusing innocent, chaste believing women." [Fath al-Bari, 5/93, Muslim-1/92]And he said:"Whoever consults a fortune-teller and believes what he says will have nothing to do with the Book of Allah revealed to Muhammad (ﷺ), meaning through this he disbelieves in the Qur'an. And whoever goes to a magician, but does not believe what he says, his worship for forty days will not be accepted."Many may say: I do not go to a magician to cause harm to anyone; I go to cure the sihr that has been cast upon me. We will say to them: Your condition is like that of a person who throws himself into the fire praying to be saved from the scorching heat of the desert.Often the jinn also rebel against magicians and make them so ill that no remedy can be found for it.Often the jinn and Shaytan together put the magician into extreme danger and do not provide him any help. In this regard, Allah the Exalted says:وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْإِنسَانِ خَذُولًاTranslation: And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter. (Surah Al-Furqan 25:29)Often the jinn tell the magician to engage in immoral acts with a woman who comes to him for treatment, or tell him to write with blood on sensitive parts of that woman's body.Often sihr produces the opposite of the desired result; thus, it is seen that many people have sihr performed for their own benefit, but it ends in a painful experience, and they themselves become afflicted by it. Many women have sihr cast on their husbands so that their husbands will love them and not take a second wife, but the outcome of the sihr is the opposite: under the influence of the sihr, the husband divorces her instead of loving her. Allah the Exalted says:وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِTranslation: But the evil plot encompasses only its people. (Surah Fatir 35:43)Many healthy and strong men and women also go to the magician, and then the magician creates various problems among them through the jinn, so that he can extort money from them through this.The jinn and Shaytan have many demands, and these demands of theirs exhaust a person. Often they demand the sacrifice of a specific animal, telling them to slaughter a pet rooster or pigeon; moreover, there are strict conditions attached to this slaughter, and the blood of this animal is instructed to be rubbed on the patient's body.Or they demand keeping the sick patient isolated in such a secluded room where sunlight will not enter even in forty days, or advise the patient not to touch water for a specific period of time; in this way, there is no end to their demands. In every region, the jinn puts forward its own demand, and that demand is unique to that area. In Egypt, there is an abandoned well named Abu Hashimah; magicians send infertile women to bathe here after Maghrib on Friday. There are many jinn in this abandoned well who enjoy the sight of women bathing. In this case, a jinn may become attracted to a woman and even engage in sexual intercourse with her. The poor man who brings his wife to this well to cure her of infertility actually forgets that fertility is controlled solely by Allah the Exalted. Allah the Exalted says:يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ ﴿٤٩﴾ أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ ﴿٥٠﴾Translation: He grants to whom He wills female [children], and He grants to whom He wills males. Or He makes them both males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent. (Surah Ash-Shura 42:49-50)The demands of Shaytan and jinn are limitless. Allah the Exalted says regarding this:وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا ﴿٦﴾Translation: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in arrogance. (Surah Al-Jinn 72:6)Shaykh Hafidh al-Hakami (rahimahullah) said: Nullifying the effect of sihr by using sihr is also haram, because it is tantamount to supporting and aiding sihr, and in order to undo the effect of Shaytan from the victim, a person thus becomes even closer to Shaytan. For this reason, al-Hasan said: No one supports sihr except a magician.When magicians saw that there was no one standing with a sword to resist them, they raised their heads even more and began casting sihr on people in a very calculated manner, forcing them to have sihr done whether people liked it or not, and through this, seizing their wealth, establishing control over wealth, and simultaneously leading the victim astray. [Ma'arij al-Qubul 1/530]After all the above discussion, we want to tell the Ummah of Tawhid, the Ummah that follows the Qur'an, the Ummah of Muhammad (ﷺ), and the believers steadfast in faith that the magician himself is a disbeliever (kafir), and his action is kufr. He has no power to bring benefit or cause harm; he has no power to grant life, inflict death, or resurrect after death. He has no knowledge of the unseen (ghayb). And the jinn who serve these magicians are disbelievers and rebels, because those among the jinn who are believers love only those among humans who are believers; they do not wish to be subdued and enslaved by anyone.O Ummah of the Qur'an, take a look at the condition of magicians. They beg for money, they take money from sick people, so how will they make you rich? Since Islam has shut the door to visiting a magician, is there an alternative way? We will say: Yes, there is an alternative in the Book of Allah and the Hadith of the Messenger (ﷺ). In the next chapter, we will discuss the Islamic method of nullifying the effects of sihr and treating sihr, in sha Allah.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: How to Protect Yourself from Magic?
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionPhysicians always say that prevention is better than cure. In this case, we would say: the best treatment or cure for sihr (magic) is to protect oneself from it before it occurs. Even if the vile magician, who has sold his soul to Shaytan, seeks help from Shaytan to achieve his purpose, there is no reason to worry, because Islam has told us how to protect oneself and one's family from the accursed Shaytan. Muslims should follow the following methods to protect themselves from the evil effects of sihr.

* * *

Strengthening Faith FurtherA Muslim must strengthen himself and his belief in Tawhid. This is how a Muslim strengthens his iman, removes all fear from the heart except the fear of Allah, and reinforces the conviction that the power to benefit or harm anyone lies solely in the hands of Allah. A Muslim must understand that these means are like the movements of the wind, which are controlled by the hand of their Controller and Creator, and they cannot harm anyone without the command or will of Allah.Regarding magicians, Allah the Exalted says:وَمَا هُم بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِTranslation: But they could not thus harm anyone except by permission of Allah. (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:102)وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِTranslation: 'And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. (Surah Yunus 10:107)Those who are true servants of Allah, who abide by Allah's commands and prohibitions in both times of hardship and ease, and whose center of all fear is solely Allah the Exalted--it is them who are referred to in the following verse:أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُTranslation: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant? (Surah Az-Zumar 39:36)Through the exercise of complete obedience and servitude to Allah comes complete protection; Shaytan has no power or authority over them. Allah the Exalted says:إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌTranslation: 'Indeed, over My servants you have no authority. (Surah Al-Hijr 15:42)The one whose iman is strong will be protected by Allah and will remain under His care, and the likelihood of him being afflicted by sihr is very slim. And the magicians themselves also know this well: that only people of weak iman will be afflicted by their spells.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: How to Protect Yourself from Magic?
ruqyah_articles.text: The best and most effective way to be saved from sihr (magic) is to recite the adhkar daily in the morning and evening. Because these adhkar protect the person from its grasp even before the sihr is cast, save the afflicted person from its effects, remove all evil influences, and cure it if one has already been affected by sihr. Ibn al-Qayyim (rahimahullah) said:The most effective Allah-given means against sihr, the single method that eliminates all evil influences and wards them off and repels them, is dhikr, verses of the Qur'an, and du'as; as a result of reciting these, the efficacy of sihr is nullified. The stronger these are, the faster they spread. It is like two armies facing each other, where both armies are equipped with weapons and both have immense power; whichever of the two armies can overcome the opposing force will be declared victorious.If the heart and mind remain immersed in the remembrance of Allah, if du'as and dhikr are recited regularly, refuge is sought from harm, and one recites with full concentration, then before being afflicted by sihr, this will be the best and most potent means to eliminate the effects of sihr, and after being afflicted, this will be the most powerful remedy.Magicians know that their sihr can only exert its full effect on those whose hearts are weak and who are easily influenced, who are guided by their own desires and cravings, and who are always preoccupied with petty and insignificant matters. This is why the majority of those who are afflicted by sihr are women, children, the ignorant, and those who live in remote areas, or those whose faith in Allah and tawhid is weak, as well as those who do not regularly recite dhikr, verses of the Qur'an, and du'as. In short, those afflicted by the evil effects of sihr are those who are weak, easily influenced, and always engrossed in trivial matters.They say: The victim himself provides the opportunity for the attack of sihr, because as we know, whatever matter a person pays the most attention to, his mind remains attached to it. Therefore, whichever direction a person's inclination lies, he is controlled by his mind under the drive of that direction. Satanic souls can only control those souls that are already prepared to be overcome, because their hearts have already inclined toward something that is very conducive to the execution of the deeds of evil spirits, and they are easily attacked by devils and evil jinn. The reason for this is that there is no spiritual strength within these people, and they are not prepared to resist. Therefore, you will notice that the hearts of these people are empty, their minds have no strength, no power to struggle, and their minds are already inclined toward something due to which the jinn easily overcome them and magicians cast sihr. [Zad al-Ma'ad, 3/105]Imam Ahmad and at-Tirmidhi narrated a long hadith from al-Harith al-Ash'ari, in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"...I command you to remember Allah, for the likeness of the remembrance of Allah is that of a person chased by an enemy, who finally took refuge inside a fortress to save himself. Likewise, a person cannot protect himself from Shaytan with anything other than the remembrance of Allah." [Narrated from Musnad Ahmad, 408/202; at-Tirmidhi: 2867, the hadith is sahih]

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: How to Protect Yourself from Magic?
ruqyah_articles.text: Imam al-Bukhari (rahimahullah) narrates in his Sahih hadith book from Amir bin Sa'd, his father Sa'd said, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Whoever eats an Ajwa date in the morning will not be affected by any poison or sihr on that day until night comes." [Fath al-Bari, 10/249] Another person said regarding this, "Seven dates."In another narration, it has come:"Whoever eats seven Ajwa dates in the morning will not be affected by any poison or sihr on that day."Whoever eats Ajwa dates regularly on an empty stomach with full trust and faith in the words of Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ), these dates will work for him in such a way as if he has been vaccinated against sihr; neither sihr nor any poison will be able to harm him. Some scholars have said regarding a characteristic of this date that it is very hot and it is sufficient to eliminate illness, however, the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned a specific method for gaining protection from sihr. Allah knows best, perhaps there is some component in that date that protects people from poison and sihr.We believe all the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), even if we do not know how it works. There is no room for doubt that Madinah dates may have special qualities, but if Madinah dates are not available, then insha'Allah any date will work.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: How to Protect Yourself from Magic?
ruqyah_articles.text: Since no benefit can be obtained from magicians for the one who has been harmed, and the one who has no problem is also not safe from their harm. The shaytans and evil jinn who work with magicians also know very well that those Muslims who knock on a magician's door have weak iman and have no trust in Allah, so harming them or possessing them is very easy.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Magic of Separation
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionAllah Ta'ala says:وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا لَمَنِ اشْتَرَاهُ مَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٠٢﴾Translation: And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. And Solomon did not disbelieve; rather, the devils disbelieved. They taught people magic and (they followed) that which was sent down to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. And they did not teach anyone until they said, "We are only a trial, so do not disbelieve." Even then, they learned from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. Yet they could not harm anyone through it except by Allah's permission. And they learned what harmed them and did not benefit them, and they certainly knew that whoever purchased it would have no share in the Hereafter. And surely wretched was that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew. (Surah Al-Baqarah: 102)Jabir (RA) said, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Iblis places his throne on water (the sea). And he sends his troops on expeditions, and the most beloved devil to him is the one who causes the most discord and turmoil. At the end of the expedition, everyone comes to present the success of their expeditions to the chief devil. Then the chief says, "None of you has done any great work." Then a small devil comes to the chief and says, "I did not leave so-and-so until I caused separation between him and his wife." Then the Messenger (ﷺ) said: The chief of the devils draws that small devil close to him and says, "How excellent you are!" In another narration it is stated that the big devil embraces the small devil. (Muslim)

* * *

Definition of This Type of MagicThis is an act of magic that causes separation between husband and wife, or creates envy and hatred between two friends or two partners.Types of Causing Separation:1. Causing separation between mother and child.2. Causing separation between father and child.3. Causing separation between two brothers.4. Causing separation between friends.5. Causing separation between business partners.6. Causing separation between husband and wife. And this type is the most dangerous and the most prevalent.

* * *

Symptoms of the Magic of Separation1. Sudden turning of love into enmity.2. Arising of excessive suspicion between both of them.3. Neither seeking forgiveness from each other nor forgiving each other.4. Arising of excessive disagreement, even if it is over a trivial matter.5. The wife's beauty turning into ugliness. Even if she is very beautiful, appearing repulsive to the husband, and the husband feeling repulsive to the wife.6. The bewitched person disliking every action of the other person.7. The bewitched person disliking the sitting place of the other party. For example: the husband is very fine outside the house, but as soon as he enters the house, he feels extreme constriction in his heart. Ibn Kathir (rahimahullah) says: As a result of the magic of separation between husband and wife, the bewitched person will look upon the other with an evil eye or with suspicion, or fall into other such matters that cause separation. (Tafsir Ibn Kathir: 1/144)

* * *

How Magic Is Done to Cause Separation Between Two PeopleWhen a person goes to a magician and says, "Cause separation between so-and-so and so-and-so," the magician asks him to provide the person's name and his mother's name. In addition, he asks him to bring the person's clothes, cap, hair, etc. And if it is not possible to obtain all of these, then bewitched water is poured on that person's path on which the targeted person walks. And as soon as he crosses that water, he becomes afflicted by magic. Or it is also done in such a way that food is bewitched and given to eat.

* * *

Treatment - First Stage: The Stage Prior to Treatment:Its treatment must be done in three stages:First stage: The stage prior to treatment:1. An atmosphere of faith must be created in that house. For example: first of all, that house must be purified from all kinds of pictures so that angels may enter.2. That house must be purified from all kinds of music.3. No one in that house shall violate the rulings of Shari'ah. For example: men will not wear gold, women will not remain unveiled, and no person will smoke.4. If there are any amulets (ta'weez), charms, cowrie shells, or anything of that sort with the sick person, they must be removed and burned.5. Preparing everyone in the family as believers in pure aqeedah, so that no one maintains a connection with anyone other than Allah for this.6. The sick person will be asked questions to diagnose their condition and understand their symptoms, such as: Do you ever feel aversion toward your wife? Does dispute arise between you over ordinary and trivial matters? Do you feel joy outside the house? And whenever you enter the house, do you feel distress? Does either person feel irritation during intercourse? During sleep, does either of the two feel restlessness or see terrifying dreams?If two or more from the above questions are affirmative, the practitioner will begin treatment.7. Before starting the treatment, both oneself and the assistant will perform wudu.8. If the sick patient is a woman, one will not treat her unless she is properly covered in purdah.9. One will not treat any woman who is dressed contrary to the Shari'ah, such as: having an uncovered face, wearing perfume, or having long nails in resemblance to disbelieving women.10. A woman's treatment must be in the presence of her mahram (close relative).11. No man other than a mahram can stay with her.12. For success, one must keep oneself free from all impurities and from all reliance on others, and seek help from Allah alone and place trust solely in Him.

* * *

Second Stage of Treatment: Du'as and VersesThe practitioner will place his hand on the patient's head and recite these du'as and verses near their ear with care, correctly, and aloud.1.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ‎﴿١﴾‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‎﴿٢﴾‏ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ‎﴿٣﴾‏ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ‎﴿٤﴾‏ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ‎﴿٥﴾‏ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ‎﴿٦﴾‏ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ ‎﴿٧﴾‏Translation: (1) In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (2) [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds. (3) The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. (4) Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. (5) It is You we worship and You we ask for help. (6) Guide us to the straight path; grant us guidance to the path. (7) The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, those whom You have blessed--not of those who have evoked [Your] anger, nor of those who are astray. (Surah Al-Fatihah)2.الم ‎﴿١﴾‏ ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ ‎﴿٢﴾‏ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ ‎﴿٣﴾‏ وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ ‎﴿٤﴾‏ أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ‎﴿٥﴾‏Translation: (1) Alif, Lam, Meem. (2) This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah. (3) Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them. (4) And who believe in what has been revealed to you and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith]. (5) Those are upon guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful. (Surah Al-Baqarah: 1-5)3.وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا لَمَنِ اشْتَرَاهُ مَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ‎﴿١٠٢﴾Translation: (102) And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Sulaiman. Sulaiman did not disbelieve; rather, the devils disbelieved. They taught people magic and (they followed) what was revealed to the two angels in Babylon, Harut and Marut. And they did not teach anyone until they said, "We are only a trial, so do not disbelieve." Even so, they learned from them that by which they caused separation between a man and his wife. Yet they could not harm anyone through it except by Allah's permission. And they learned what harmed them and did not benefit them, and they certainly knew that whoever purchased it would have no share in the Hereafter. And surely evil is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew. (Surah Al-Baqarah: 102)Recite this verse frequently.4.وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ‎﴿١٦٣﴾‏ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَالْفُلْكِ الَّتِي تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِمَا يَنفَعُ النَّاسَ وَمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِن مَّاءٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَاحِ وَالسَّحَابِ الْمُسَخَّرِ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ‎﴿١٦٤﴾Translation: (163) And your god is one God. There is no (true) god except Him; He is the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. (164) Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, the alternation of the night and the day, the ships that sail through the sea with that which benefits people, and the rain that Allah has sent down from the sky, thereby reviving the earth after its death and dispersing throughout it every kind of moving creature, and the shifting of the winds and the clouds directed between the sky and the earth are signs for a people who use reason. (Surah Al-Baqarah: 163-164)5.اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ ‎﴿٢٥٥﴾Translation: (255) Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Self-Sufficient and Eternal Sustainer, the Sustainer of all things. Neither drowsiness nor sleep touches Him. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Him. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows all that is before them and all that is behind them. And they cannot encompass anything of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi encompasses the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not fatigue Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Magnificent. (Ayat al-Kursi, Surah Al-Baqarah: 255)6.آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ‎﴿٢٨٥﴾‏ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ‎﴿٢٨٦﴾‏Translation: (285) The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. Each of them has believed in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers, [saying], 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they say, 'We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final destination.' (286) Allah does not burden any soul beyond its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. 'Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not lay upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.' (Surah Al-Baqarah: 285-286)7.شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ ۚ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ‎﴿١٨﴾‏ إِنَّ الدِّينَ عِندَ اللَّهِ الْإِسْلَامُ ۗ وَمَا اخْتَلَفَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ ‎﴿١٩﴾Translation: (18) Allah bears witness that there is no (true) god except Him, and so do the angels and those of knowledge. He is upholding justice. There is no (true) god except Him, the Almighty, the All-Wise. (19) Truly, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them, out of mutual envy. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allah, then surely Allah is swift in taking account. (Surah Ali 'Imran: 18-19)8.إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‎﴿٥٤﴾‏ ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ ‎﴿٥٥﴾‏ وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا ۚ إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ ‎﴿٥٦﴾Translation: (54) Indeed, your Lord created the heavens and the earth in six days, then rose over the Throne. He covers the day with the night, each pursuing the other rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected to His command. Know that the creation and the command belong to Him. Blessed is Allah, the Lord of all creation. (55) Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret. Indeed, He does not like the transgressors. (56) And do not cause corruption upon the earth after its reformation, and call upon Him with fear and hope. Surely, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good. (Surah Al-A'raf: 54-56)9.۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ‎﴿١١٧﴾‏ فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ ‎﴿١١٨﴾‏ فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ ‎﴿١١٩﴾‏ وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ ‎﴿١٢٠﴾‏ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‎﴿١٢١﴾‏ رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ‎﴿١٢٢﴾‏Translation: (117) And I revealed to Moses, 'Throw your staff,' and at once it swallowed up what they had falsely fabricated. (118) Thus the truth became manifest, and what they had been doing was abolished. (119) So they were defeated right there and became humiliated. (120) And the magicians fell down in prostration. (121) They said, 'We have believed in the Lord of all creation, (122) the Lord of Moses and Aaron.' (Surah Al-A'raf: 117-122)Recite these verses abundantly, especially the 'وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ' portion.10.فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ السِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ ‎﴿٨١﴾‏ وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ ‎﴿٨٢﴾Translation: (81) Then when they threw (their ropes and staffs), Moses said, 'What you have brought is magic. Indeed, Allah will render it void. Indeed, Allah does not rectify the work of corrupters.' (82) 'And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it.' (Surah Yunus: 81-82)Recite this abundantly as well, especially recite the " إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ " portion abundantly.11.إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ ‎﴿٦٩﴾‏Translation: (69) What they have crafted is merely the trick of a magician. And the magician will not succeed wherever he may come.' (Surah Taha: 69)12.أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ ‎﴿١١٥﴾‏ فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ ‎﴿١١٦﴾‏ وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ ‎﴿١١٧﴾‏ وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ ‎﴿١١٨﴾‏Translation: (115) 'Did you think that I created you merely in vain and that you would not be returned to Me?' (116) So exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign; there is no (true) god except Him; the Lord of the Noble Throne. (117) And whoever invokes another god along with Allah, for which he has no proof, his reckoning is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed. (118) And say, 'O our Lord, forgive and show mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.' (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 115-118)13.وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا ‎﴿١﴾‏ فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا ‎﴿٢﴾‏ فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا ‎﴿٣﴾‏ إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ ‎﴿٤﴾‏ رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ ‎﴿٥﴾‏ إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ ‎﴿٦﴾‏ وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّارِدٍ ‎﴿٧﴾‏ لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ ‎﴿٨﴾‏ دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ ‎﴿٩﴾‏ إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ ‎﴿١٠﴾Translation: (1) By the angels lined up in ranks, (2) and then by those directing [the clouds] smoothly, (3) and by those who recite the Book of Reminder (the Heavenly Scripture); (4) indeed, your God is One; (5) He is the Lord of the heavens, the earth, and whatever is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise. (6) Indeed, I have adorned the nearest heaven with the beauty of the stars, (7) and guarded it against every rebellious devil. (8) They cannot listen to the exalted realm, because they are pelted from every side (with meteors) (9) to drive them away, and for them is an enduring punishment; (10) except one who snatches something stealthily, then a burning meteor pursues him. (Surah As-Saffat: 1-10)14.وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوا أَنصِتُوا ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ ‎﴿٢٩﴾‏ قَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنزِلَ مِن بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ‎﴿٣٠﴾‏ يَا قَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَآمِنُوا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ‎﴿٣١﴾‏ وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ ‎﴿٣٢﴾Translation: (29) And recall when I directed a group of jinn toward you, listening to the Qur'an. When they arrived there, they said, 'Listen quietly.' Then when the recitation ended, they returned to their people as warners. (30) They said, 'O our people! We have indeed heard the recitation of a Book revealed after Moses, confirming what came before it and guiding to the truth and to a straight path. (31) O our people! Respond to the caller of Allah and believe in Him; Allah will forgive your sins and protect you from a painful punishment. (32) And whoever does not respond to the caller of Allah cannot escape Him on the earth, and there is no protector for him besides Allah. Those are in clear error.' (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 29-32)15.يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا مِنْ أَقْطَارِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَانفُذُوا ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَانٍ ‎﴿٣٣﴾‏ فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ‎﴿٣٤﴾‏ يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ ‎﴿٣٥﴾‏ فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ‎﴿٣٦﴾Translation: (33) O gathering of jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass! But you cannot pass except with authority (granted by Allah). (34) So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny? (35) There will be sent against both of you flames of fire and dark smoke, and you will not be able to defend yourselves. (36) So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny? (Surah Ar-Rahman: 33-36)16.لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ‎﴿٢١﴾‏ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ ۖ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ‎﴿٢٢﴾‏ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ‎﴿٢٣﴾‏ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ‎﴿٢٤﴾‏Translation: (21) Had I sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have surely seen it humbled and splitting apart from the fear of Allah. And these examples We present to mankind so that perhaps they may reflect. (22) He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity; Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; He is the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. (23) He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Most Holy, the Free from all flaws, the Granter of Security, the Guardian, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supreme; Exalted and Pure is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. (24) He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names; whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him. And He is the Almighty, the All-Wise. (Surah Al-Hashr: 21-24)17.قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا ‎﴿١﴾‏ يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا ‎﴿٢﴾‏ وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا ‎﴿٣﴾‏ وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا ‎﴿٤﴾‏ وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن تَقُولَ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا ‎﴿٥﴾‏ وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا ‎﴿٦﴾‏ وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا ‎﴿٧﴾‏ وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا ‎﴿٨﴾‏ وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا ‎﴿٩﴾Translation: (1) Say, 'It has been revealed to me that indeed a group of jinn listened attentively, then said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an, (2) which guides to the truth; so we have believed in it. And we will never associate anyone with our Lord.' (3) 'And exalted is the majesty of our Lord; He has neither taken a wife nor a son.' (4) 'And the foolish among us used to utter outrageous things about Allah.' (5) 'Yet we had thought that mankind and jinn would never utter a lie against Allah.' (6) And indeed, certain individuals among mankind used to take refuge with certain individuals among the jinn, so they increased them in arrogance. (7) And they thought, just as you thought, that Allah would never resurrect anyone. (8) 'And we sought to reach heaven, but we found it filled with strict guards and flaming meteors.' (9) And we used to sit at stations therein to eavesdrop, but whoever tries to listen now will find a flaming meteor waiting for him.' (Surah Al-Jinn: 1-9)18. Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, Surah An-Nas.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ‎﴿١﴾‏ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ‎﴿٢﴾‏ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ‎﴿٣﴾‏ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ‎﴿٤﴾‏Translation: (1) Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One and Unique. (2) Allah is not in need of anyone; all are in need of Him. (3) He did not give birth, nor was He given birth to. (4) And there is none equal to Him.' (Surah Al-Ikhlas: 112)بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ‎﴿١﴾‏ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ‎﴿٢﴾‏ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ‎﴿٣﴾‏ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ‎﴿٤﴾‏ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ‎﴿٥﴾‏Translation: (1) Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, (2) from the evil of that which He created, (3) and from the evil of the darkness of night when it intensifies, (4) and from the evil of the women who blow on knots, (5) and from the evil of an envier when he envies.' (Surah Al-Falaq: 113)بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ‎﴿١﴾‏ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ‎﴿٢﴾‏ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ‎﴿٣﴾‏ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ‎﴿٤﴾‏ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ‎﴿٥﴾‏ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ‎﴿٦﴾‏Translation: (1) Say, 'I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind, (2) the Sovereign of mankind, (3) the God of mankind, (4) from the evil of the whisperer who quickly hides, (5) who whispers into the hearts of mankind, (6) from among jinn and mankind.' (Surah An-Nas: 114)

* * *

Second Stage of Treatment: Steps Following the Recitation of Du'asRecite all the above verses and surahs near the patient's ear in a loud voice and with correct pronunciation. After this, one of three conditions may occur with the patient. Firstly, the patient might lose consciousness, and the jinn by whom he is possessed--who is responsible for the sihr (magic)--will begin to speak. In this situation, the practitioner should take the measures that ought to be taken regarding jinn, which I have described in detail in my other book. Then, he should ask the jinn the following questions:1. What is your name? And what is your religion? You must speak based on its religion. If it is a non-Muslim, invite it to accept Islam; and if it is a Muslim, explain to it that it is not permissible for you to remain engaged in the service of a magician, nor does Islam permit this.2. Ask it where the sihr is located. It must be compelled to speak the truth, because jinn always lie. If it provides news of a place, people must be sent to extract it.3. Ask it whether it alone is involved with the sihr (magic) or if there is someone else with it. If there are other jinn, compel that jinn as well to be present within the patient, then listen to its words too.4. Sometimes the jinn will say that so-and-so went to a magician and asked them to perform sihr. Such statements must never be believed, because the intention of the jinn is to sow enmity between two people, and in the Shari'ah, the testimony of such a jinn is unacceptable, since one employed in the service of a magician is a fasiq (transgressor).And Allah the Exalted says regarding this:يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَن تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ ‎﴿٦﴾‏Translation: O you who have believed, if a fasiq (transgressor) comes to you with information, verify it, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become regretful over what you have done. (Surah Al-Hujurat: 6)If the location of that sihr is found according to the information of the jinn and it is extracted, then recite the following verses over water:۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ‎﴿١١٧﴾‏ فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ ‎﴿١١٨﴾‏ فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ ‎﴿١١٩﴾‏ وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ ‎﴿١٢٠﴾‏ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‎﴿١٢١﴾‏ رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ‎﴿١٢٢﴾Translation: (117) And I revealed to Moses, 'Throw your staff,' and at once it swallowed up what they had falsely fabricated. (118) Thus the truth became manifest, and what they had been doing was abolished. (119) So they were defeated right there and became humiliated. (120) And the magicians fell down in prostration. (121) They said, 'We have believed in the Lord of all creation, (122) the Lord of Moses and Aaron.' (Surah Al-A'raf: 117-122)إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ ‎﴿٦٩﴾Translation: What they have crafted is merely the trick of a magician. And the magician will not succeed wherever he may come.' (Surah Taha: 69)فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ السِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ ‎﴿٨١﴾‏ وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ ‎﴿٨٢﴾‏Translation: (81) Then when they threw (their ropes and staffs), Moses said, 'What you have brought is magic. Indeed, Allah will render it void. Indeed, Allah does not rectify the work of corrupters.' (82) 'And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it.' (Surah Yunus: 81-82)Recite these verses over a vessel of water and blow into it so that the breath from reciting the Qur'an reaches the water. Then immerse the sihr into that water, whatever type of magic object it may be--such as paper, perfume, etc. Afterward, discard that water somewhere far away from public pathways. If the jinn says that the afflicted patient was made to drink the sihr, the patient must be asked whether they have abdominal pain. If there is pain, it is to be understood that the jinn spoke the truth, and if there is no pain, it is to be understood that the jinn lied.Once the collection of truthful information from the jinn is finished, tell the jinn to depart from the patient and never return again. In this manner, insha'Allah, the sihr can be destroyed. Then, recite the three verses mentioned previously over water, recite verse 102 of Surah Al-Baqarah, and blow into the water. Tell the patient to bathe with it and drink from it for a few days.And if the jinn says that the patient walked over the magic object, or that sihr was performed using something belonging to them such as hair or clothing, then in this situation, the patient should drink from the water recited over with the aforementioned verses for a few days and bathe with it. Do not bathe in the bathroom; rather, bathe anywhere outside the bathroom, and continue doing this until the pain goes away.Then tell the jinn to leave this person and pledge not to return. Then after about a week, the patient will recite a second time. If the sick person does not feel anything, then it is to be understood that the sihr (magic) has been destroyed. If the patient loses consciousness again, then it is to be understood that the jinn is a liar and has not yet departed from the patient. Inquire of it gently about the reason for not leaving. And if it still disobeys after this, beat it and recite verses from the Qur'an. If the patient does not lose consciousness, but trembling begins in his body and his breathing becomes heavy, then the patient should listen to a cassette recording of Ayat al-Kursi three times a day, for one hour each time. He will listen in this manner for a month; then, when he visits again, perform ruqyah on him. This time, insha'Allah, he will be cured.And if he is not cured, provide a recorded cassette of these surahs: Surah As-Saffat, Yasin, Ad-Dukhan, and Surah Al-Jinn, so that he listens to it three times a day for three weeks. Insha'Allah, Allah the Almighty will heal him. Otherwise, the duration must be extended.Second StateIf during ruqyah the patient feels pain, or trembles, jerks, or feels a severe headache without losing consciousness, then in this state perform Shar'i ruqyah three times. If the patient loses consciousness, adopt the previously mentioned method. But if he does not lose consciousness and the headache and trembling begin to decrease, perform ruqyah on him for a few days. Insha'Allah, he will be cured soon. If he is not healed, adopt the following methods:1. Record the entirety of Surah As-Saffat once and Ayat al-Kursi multiple times. Then have the patient listen to it three times a day.2. Perform salah in congregation.3.
