After the Fajr prayer, the patient will recite the following du'a--لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌTransliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu, wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeerTranslation: There is no true deity except Allah, alone without partner; His is the dominion, and His is all praise; and He is competent over all things.one hundred times for up to one month; but one thing must be kept in mind that the patient's distress may increase for 10 or 15 days; but it will gradually decrease and end completely by the end of the month.Now when ruqyah is performed again, the patient will not feel any pain. Insha'Allah, the sihr will be destroyed. It may also happen that the sick patient's suffering has not eased even in a month, along with the patient having anxiety. In this state, when the patient comes to the practitioner, he will then recite the previously mentioned verses and surahs and blow upon him. After that, he will soon become unconscious. Then adopt the previous method of the first state.Third StateIf no change is observed during ruqyah, he must be asked again about his symptoms. Then, if most of the symptoms are absent, it must be understood that he is not affected by sihr or any other such illness. Confirm the condition, then perform ruqyah three times. Even after this, if no symptoms manifest and ruqyah is performed repeatedly, yet he feels nothing, then this situation is very rare. In this situation, adopt the following method:1. Have Surah Yasin, Ad-Dukhan, and Surah Al-Jinn recorded on a cassette, and it will be played to the patient three times every day.2. Make abundant tawbah and istighfar, at least 100 times a day or more.3. Recite (La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah) 100 times or more every day. Continue this method for up to one month.Then perform ruqyah on him and take action according to the previous two states.

* * *

The Third Stage of Treatment Is the Stage After the Completion of TreatmentIf Allah Almighty cures the patient through your efforts and the patient finds relief, then give thanks to Allah Almighty Who has granted you this opportunity. And you must remember Allah abundantly so that Allah grants you further tawfeeq for others as well. And let not this success in your treatment become a cause of transgression and arrogance for you.Allah Almighty says:وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ ‎﴿٧﴾Translation: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you are ungrateful, indeed, My punishment is severe.' (Surah Ibrahim: 7)And even after recovery, the patient is not free from danger, lest someone repeat the magic on them a second time. Because if those who had the magic performed find out about their recovery by visiting the practitioner, they will strive to go to the magician a second time to perform magic. Therefore, the patient should keep the matter of visiting their practitioner secret. And give them the following instructions for the patient's protection:1. Performing salah in congregation.2. Not listening to music.3. Performing wudu before sleeping and reciting Ayat al-Kursi.4. Doing all tasks by saying Bismillah.5. Reciting the following du'a 100 times daily after Fajr prayer.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌTransliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu, wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeerTranslation: There is no true deity except Allah, He has no partner; to Him belongs the dominion, and all praise is for Him; and He is capable of all things.6. Definitely reciting the Qur'an daily, even if just a little. If one does not know how to read the Qur'an, they should listen to it from someone else or on a cassette. (Learn the Noble Qur'an, because it is certainly essential for Muslims.)7. Keeping company with righteous people.8. Reciting the morning and evening masnoon du'as.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Magic of Causing Infatuation
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionThe Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Unlawful ruqyah, amulets, and 'tiwalah' (love-inducing magic) are indeed part of shirk." (Musnad Ahmad: 1/381, Sunan Abi Dawud: 3883, etc., Albani (rahimahullah) graded it sahih.)Allamah Ibn al-Athir (rahimahullah) said, "'Tiwalah' means adopting such a method whereby a wife becomes dear to her husband through magic or something else, which the Prophet (ﷺ) termed as shirk. Because they believe that all of this happened between them through it without the destiny (taqdir) ordained by Allah." (An-Nihayah: 1/200)I want to clarify that the ruqyah forbidden in the hadith refers to those ruqyahs through which the help of jinn, Shaytan, or anything else is sought, and which contain shirk. However, the ruqyah that is from the Qur'an and hadith is permissible; there is no difference of opinion regarding it. In Sahih Muslim, there is no harm in ruqyah as long as it contains no shirk.

* * *

Symptoms of Love-Inducing Magic1. Becoming excessively infatuated and in love.2. Constantly desiring sexual intercourse.3. Becoming impatient for sexual intercourse.4. Becoming restless to see the wife.5. Becoming subservient and obedient to the wife.

* * *

How is Love-Inducing Magic Performed?Generally, disputes do arise between husband and wife and then become normal again; but some women become impatient and rush to a magician so that they can obtain love in excessive measure through magic. The reason for this is the woman's lack of religious commitment and her ignorance that it is certainly haram. The magician asks the woman for some clothing belonging to her husband, such as a handkerchief, cap, shirt, undershirt, etc., that carries the scent of his sweat and is not new or washed, but rather used. The magician takes threads from it, ties knots in them, recites something over them, and blows on them.Then he tells that woman to bury these threads in a deserted place, or he blows magical incantations into food items or water. The vilest method of this magic is performing magic using impure substances. For example, performing magic with menstrual blood. Then that woman is told to feed it to her husband or mix it with his 'ittar (perfume).

* * *

Adverse Effects of Love-Inducing Magic1. Sometimes the husband falls ill due to the magic. I know of such a person who was ill for three years under the influence of this type of magic.2. Sometimes, instead of love, hatred begins to develop. And this is because some magicians do not possess knowledge of the fundamental principles of magic.3. Sometimes a wife performs such magic on her husband so that her husband hates all women and loves only her. As a result, that person begins to hate his own mother, sisters, and female relatives.4. Sometimes the action of this double-edged magic backfires, and along with hating all women, the husband begins to hate his wife as well. I have even received reports that the husband hated his wife and divorced her. And the wife ran to the magician a second time so that he would undo the effect of the magic; but as it happened, the magician died before she reached him.

* * *

Reasons for Performing Love-Inducing Magic1. Mutual disputes between husband and wife.2. The wife's greed for the husband's wealth, especially if the husband is wealthy.3. The wife's assumption that the husband might marry another woman, whereas it is permissible in the Shari'ah and there is no fault in it; but women of the present age, especially women influenced by destructive media, assume that their husband marrying another woman means he does not love her. This is a grave mistake. For there are many reasons due to which a man marries one, two, three, and up to four.Yet it is seen that he loves his first wife more. For example: someone [marries] to have more children, or someone is able to exercise patience without intercourse during the wife's menstruation and post-natal bleeding, or someone wants to build a relationship with a particular family, or there may be many other reasons.

* * *

Halal Magic to Attract the HusbandThis is a matter that I consider obligatory to make known to Muslim women. The point is that every woman can adopt lawful magic or means to attain her husband's love.For example, the wife will keep herself adorned and neat for her husband, speak sweetly with her husband, and likewise offer a bright smile and good conduct, so that her husband does not look here and there, but rather remains captivated by his own wife. In addition, she will safeguard her husband's wealth and care for his children. She will obey her husband except in disobedience to Allah; but looking at today's world, the complete opposite is seen.When a woman goes to an event or goes to meet her friends, she dresses up and wears jewelry as if she were a bride on her wedding night. Then, when she returns from there, she takes them completely off, puts them in their place, and awaits the next event, whereas the poor husband who bought these clothes and jewelry for her remains deprived of enjoying it. He finds her at home in those same old clothes, from which only the bad smell of onions, garlic, and cooking emanates. If a woman uses her intellect, she will certainly understand that indeed her husband has the greatest right to enjoy her adornment and beauty.Therefore, when your husband goes out for work, quickly finish the household chores, perform ghusl, adorn and beautify yourself, and wait for him. When the husband returns from work, greet him with a smile. When he returns home and finds his beautiful wife before him, food and drink prepared, and the house clean and tidy, his love for you will certainly increase many times over. By Allah! You will find this to serve as a lawful magic for you. Especially if you make your intention in adorning yourself to follow the command of Allah, then lowering your husband's gaze. For the one who is sated never has an appetite for food; rather, it is the one who is deprived of it who has that desire. Pay some attention to this valuable advice.

* * *

Treatment of Love-Inducing Magic1. For the patient, those verses must be recited that were mentioned previously. Among them, instead of reciting verse 102 of Surah Al-Baqarah, recite verses 14, 15, and 16 of Surah At-Taghabun:يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ ﴿١٤﴾ إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ ﴿١٥﴾ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ﴿١٦﴾Translation: "(14) O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon, overlook, and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. (15) Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward. (16) So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah] for your own good; and whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful." (Surah At-Taghabun: 14-16)2. In this case, the patient will generally not lose consciousness, but their sides will become numb. They will feel headache and heart palpitations, or they will vomit repeatedly, or they will experience severe pain in the stomach, especially if the magic was administered through drinking. Therefore, if they feel pain in the stomach or want to vomit, recite the following verses and blow into water, and have the patient drink that water right in front of you. If after drinking the water the patient vomits black or red, then understand that the magic has ended. Otherwise, they will be told to drink this water for three weeks or more so that the magic is eliminated.Those verses are as follows:1.فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ السِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ ﴿٨١﴾ وَيُحِقُّ اللَّـهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ ﴿٨٢﴾Translation: (81) Then when they had thrown, Musa said, 'What you have brought is magic. Indeed, Allah will make it useless. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters.' (82) And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it. (Surah Yunus: 81-82)2.وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ﴿١١٧﴾ فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ ﴿١١٨﴾ فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ ﴿١١٩﴾ وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ ﴿١٢٠﴾ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿١٢١﴾ رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ﴿١٢٢﴾Translation: (117) And We inspired to Moses, 'Throw your staff,' and at once it swallowed up the false things they had fabricated. (118) So the truth was established, and what they were doing was abolished. (119) Thus they were defeated there and became humiliated. (120) And the magicians fell down in prostration. (121) They said, 'We have believed in the Lord of all creation, (122) The Lord of Moses and Aaron.' (Surah Al-A'raf: 117-122)3.إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰTranslation: 'What they have done is only a magician's trick, and the magician will not succeed wherever he comes.' (Surah Ta-Ha: 69)4.اللَّـهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾Translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Self-Sufficient, the Ever-Sustaining, the Sustainer of all things. Neither drowsiness nor sleep touches Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows whatever is before them and whatever is behind them, and they cannot encompass anything of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not burden Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Magnificent. (Surah Al-Baqarah: 255)Recite the verses over water, but it must be recited without the wife's knowledge. Because if she finds out, she will resort to magic again.

* * *

An Example of the Magic of InfatuationA man came to me and began saying, 'Initially, I used to lead a normal life with my wife. Now I do not know what happened, I cannot stay away from my wife. Even during work, thoughts of her come to mind. When work is finished, I am eager to reach my wife quickly. Even if I am sitting among guests, I repeatedly leave them and go to my wife. I am always following behind her. I cannot understand what happened to me. I cannot survive without her anymore. It is as if she is directing me now. If she goes to the kitchen, I am behind her; if she goes to the bedroom, I am right behind her; I am right behind her when she sweeps. I do not know what has happened to me. Whenever she asks for anything, I fulfill it immediately.'After hearing these words, I recited the mentioned verses, blew over water, gave it to him, and told him to drink the water and bathe with it for three weeks. And I told him to come to me after three weeks and warned him that his wife must not find out. He did just that and said that he was recovering, though some symptoms still remained. I performed the same treatment for him a second time. Alhamdulillah, all this is the mercy of Allah Ta'ala. I have no control over this.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Magic of Optical Illusion or Prestidigitation
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionIn Surah Al-A'raf, Allah Ta'ala says:قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِينَ ﴿١١٥﴾ قَالَ أَلْقُوا ۖ فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا سَحَرُوا أَعْيُنَ النَّاسِ وَاسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَاءُوا بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍ ﴿١١٦﴾ ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ﴿١١٧﴾ فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ ﴿١١٨﴾ فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ ﴿١١٩﴾ وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ ﴿١٢٠﴾ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿١٢١﴾ رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ﴿١٢٢﴾Translation: (115) They said, 'O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the ones to throw.' (116) He said, 'Throw.' And when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people and struck terror into them, and they produced a great magic. (117) And We inspired to Moses, 'Throw your staff,' and at once it swallowed up the false things they had fabricated. (118) So the truth was established, and what they were doing was abolished. (119) Thus they were defeated there and became humiliated. (120) And the magicians fell down in prostration. (121) They said, 'We have believed in the Lord of all creation, (122) The Lord of Moses and Aaron.' (Surah Al-A'raf: 115-122)And in Surah Ta-Ha, Allah Ta'ala says:قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ ﴿٦٥﴾ قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ ﴿٦٦﴾Translation: (65) They said, 'O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw.' (66) Moses said, 'Rather, you throw.' Then, by the effect of their magic, it seemed to Moses as though their ropes and staffs were moving about. (Surah Ta-Ha: 65-66)

* * *

Symptoms of Illusion Magic1. A person sees a stationary object moving, and sees a moving object as stationary, inanimate matter.2. Seeing large objects as small and small objects as large.3. Seeing one object transformed into another object. For example: through the magic during the time of Musa (AS), ropes and staffs were seen in the form of pythons.

* * *

How Is Illusion Magic Performed?The magician brings forward an ordinary object or something known to everyone. Then he recites incantations containing shirk and prays to Shaytan. Then, with the help of Shaytan, that object is made to appear in another form. A person narrated such an incident to me: a magician placed an egg in front of people and spun it very quickly. He narrated another incident where the magician struck two stones against each other, and it appeared as though two goats were fighting. The purpose of all this is to astonish people and swindle money from them.Sometimes the magician also uses this type of magic for other types of magic. For example: through the magic of separation between husband and wife, a husband sees his beautiful wife as ugly. And in the magic of infatuation, a husband sees an ugly wife as beautiful. And this type of magic is different from the other types, which is called trickery (illusion). And it generally relies on sleight of hand.

* * *

Method of Neutralizing Illusion MagicThis magic can be broken by every such good deed by which Shaytan is expelled. For example:1. Adhan,2. Ayat al-Kursi,3. Supplications that expel Shaytan, and4. Saying Bismillah. However, all of these must be done in a state of wudu.In the case of illusion magic, if it is not broken even after taking the mentioned measures, then it must be understood that the trickster merely used sleight of hand; he is not actually a magician.

* * *

A Real Example of Illusion Magic and Its RemedyA Magician Spinning the Qur'an:A magician in Egypt used to display his sorcery before people by spinning the Qur'an. He would tie a thread to the Qur'an and tie it to a key, then lift and suspend the Qur'an, recite some incantations, and tell the Qur'an, 'Turn right,' and the Qur'an would spin rapidly to the right; if he told it to turn left, it would turn to the left. In this way, people were on the verge of falling into fitnah because this magic was done with the Qur'an. I challenged the magician and said, 'You will not be able to display magic in front of me.' People were astonished upon hearing my words. There was a young man with me; I told him to sit at the other end. I told my companion, 'Keep reciting Ayat al-Kursi repeatedly.'Now he began reciting Ayat al-Kursi. And I too began reciting Ayat al-Kursi at the other end. Meanwhile, the magician finished his incantations and told the Qur'an, 'Turn to the right,' but now it was not turning. A second time he recited his incantations and said, 'Turn to the left,' but his magic failed. The Qur'an remained in its place. In this way, Allah Ta'ala humiliated the magician in front of the gathering of people.وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اللَّـهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُTranslation: 'Indeed, Allah will surely support those who support Him.' (Surah Al-Hajj: 40)

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Magic of Causing Insanity
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionKharijah bint as-Salt narrated from her uncle that he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and embraced Islam. After embracing Islam, he was returning from him. On the way, as he was passing by a tribe, he saw a madman bound in chains. The people with him said, 'We have received news that this noble companion of yours has reportedly arrived with great good. So do you have anything with which you can treat this madman?'Then I recited Surah Al-Fatihah and performed ruqyah on him, and he was cured. In return for this, they gave me 100 goats. I presented myself before the Prophet (ﷺ) and narrated the full incident. He said, 'Did you recite anything other than Surah Al-Fatihah?' I said, 'No.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'By Allah! How many people earn their living through false ruqyah, whereas you have earned it through true ruqyah!'In another narration, that Companion recited Surah Al-Fatihah and performed ruqyah morning and evening for three days. Whenever he finished reciting Surah Al-Fatihah, he would gather his saliva in his mouth and spit it upon the patient. (Sunan Abi Dawud: Tibb: 19; Imam an-Nawawi declared it sahih, and so did Shaykh al-Albani.)

* * *

Symptoms of the Magic of Madness1. Restlessness, disorientation, and making excessive mistakes.2. Incoherence in speech.3. Change in the condition of the eyes and becoming unsightly.4. Inability to remain settled in one place.5. Inability to remain steady in any work.6. Indifference to keeping oneself neat and tidy.7. And when it takes its extreme form, that patient continues walking along unknown paths, and sometimes lies down in deserted places.

* * *

How Is the Magic of Madness Performed?The jinn to whom the task of this magic is entrusted (according to the magician's instruction) resides in the patient's brain and exerts pressure on and controls their memory and motor faculties in such a manner that none knows except Allah, as a result of which they fall into a state of madness.

* * *

Treatment of the Magic of Madness1. The previously mentioned verses must be recited.2. When the patient falls unconscious, the same procedure must be adopted with him as was previously described.3. And if the patient does not become unconscious, then ruqyah must be performed three times or more in the mentioned manner. If he still does not become unconscious, then those surahs must be recorded on a cassette and played to him two or three times every day for up to a month. The verses and surahs of ruqyah are:Surah Al-Baqarah, Hud, Al-Hijr, As-Saffat, Qaf, Ar-Rahman, Al-Mulk, Al-Jinn, Al-A'la, Az-Zalzalah, Al-Humazah, Al-Kafirun, Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas. It will be seen that as a result of listening to these surahs, palpitations will begin in the patient's heart; the patient may even fall unconscious while listening to the verses. Then the jinn will begin to speak, and sometimes the distress may increase and last for more than fifteen days. Then, gradually diminishing, it will completely cease by the end of the month. In this situation, the verses must continue to be recited over the patient so that normalcy returns to him.4. During the treatment period, the patient must not be allowed to use any pain-relieving medication, because its side effects may be bad.5. During the treatment period, electric shocks may be administered, because just as it can help in rapid recovery, it is also a cause of greater distress for the jinn.6. It may also be that you determine a duration of less than one month, or it may be three months or more.7. During the treatment period, it must also be kept in mind that the patient must not commit any minor or major sins, such as listening to music, smoking, or not performing salah, etc. And if it is a woman, that she does not remain without hijab.8. If the patient has stomach pain, then it must be understood that the patient was made to drink or fed a bewitched substance. You should then recite the mentioned verses, blow over water, and have the patient drink it until right before recovery, so that the effect of the magic is exhausted, or the patient vomits.

* * *

Some Examples of the Magic of MadnessFirst Example:Some people brought a man tied in chains to me. As soon as he saw me, he kicked those who had brought him captive so hard that they fell far away. Then all of them together subdued him and forced him to the ground. Then I began to recite the Qur'an and perform ruqyah on him, during which he began spitting in my face. Then I gave him some cassettes to listen to for 45 days and told them to come to me after 45 days. And when they brought the patient again, consciousness and sensation were present in the patient. And he was ashamed of the disrespect he had shown the first time, because he was in a state of madness at that time.And now, upon reciting the Noble Qur'an to him, no mishap was observed. Then he returned completely cured. And he asked me whether he had to give any charity since Allah had cured him, or whether fasting was necessary. I replied, "It is not obligatory upon you, but if you give charity, that is better."Second Example:One day, such a young man came to me that there was no doubt he was mad.As soon as I began reciting the Qur'an, it became clear that he had been driven mad through magic; he was going to get married a few days later. Then I recited more verses and performed ruqyah on him, and told him to listen to cassettes of the Qur'an for a month, and told him to come back after that. After about twenty days had passed, a relative of his gave the good news that he was completely cured and had also gotten married.Alhamdulillah, all this is the result of the mercy and grace of Allah Ta'ala.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Magic of Preferring Loneliness and Seclusion
ruqyah_articles.text:
Symptoms of This Sihr1. Preferring solitude.2. Staying completely isolated.3. Always remaining silent.4. Hating socializing with people.5. Uneasy temperament.6. Constant headache.

* * *

How This Type of Sihr Is PerformedThe magician sends a jinn to the person he wants to cast sihr on. And he commands the jinn to bring the person's brain under its control. And the effect of this sihr is greater the stronger the jinn is.

* * *

Treatment for This Type of Sihr(a) Perform ruqyah on him according to the previous method. And when the patient becomes unconscious, instruct him to do good deeds and instruct him to refrain from injustice, oppression, and sin, as described previously.(b) And if the patient does not become unconscious, then give him a cassette of the Qur'an to listen to, which will contain 1. Surah Al-Fatihah, 2. Surah Al-Baqarah, 3. Ali 'Imran, 4. Surah Ya-Sin, 5. As-Saffat, 6. Ad-Dukhan, 7. Adh-Dhariyat, 8. Al-Hashr, 9. Al-Ma'arij, 10. Al-Ghashiyah, 11. Az-Zalzalah, 12. Al-Qari'ah, 13. Al-Falaq and 14. Surah An-Nas.(c) Record all these surahs on three cassettes and tell the patient to listen to one cassette in the morning, the second in the afternoon, and the other at bedtime. He should listen like this for 45 days, or the duration may be extended up to 60 days. Once this period has passed, by the will of Allah, he will be cured.(d) The patient shall not use any medicine for his relief.(e) If the patient feels pain in his stomach, recite the mentioned surahs, blow onto water, and give it to the patient to drink for the above-mentioned duration.(f) And if the patient always has stomach pain, he should bathe with that water every three days; however, the condition is that he must not add more water to it or heat it, and he must bathe in a clean place.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Hearing Unknown Voices
ruqyah_articles.text:
Symptoms of This Sihr1. Seeing terrifying dreams.2. Seeing someone calling in a dream.3. Hearing voices while awake yet not seeing anyone.4. Increase in waswasa.5. Excessive suspicion arising regarding close relatives and friends.6. Seeing oneself falling down from a high place in a dream.7. Seeing a terrifying beast chasing him in a dream.

* * *

How This Type of Sihr Is PerformedThe magician assigns a jinn the duty to show such-and-such person terrifying things while asleep and awake; then that jinn frightens him during sleep through dreams by taking the form of a terrifying beast. And sometimes it calls him in a terrifying voice while awake. Sometimes that voice seems familiar, and sometimes unfamiliar.Afflicted by this sihr, sometimes a person goes mad, and at other times it remains limited to waswasa; the reaction is greater or lesser according to the power of the sihr.

* * *

Treatment for This Type of Sihr1. Follow the method of treating sihr that has been described in the preliminary discussion of the book.2. If the patient becomes unconscious, the method instructed to be adopted must be followed.3. If the patient does not become unconscious, then give the following instructions for treatment:(a) Before sleeping, perform wudu and recite Ayat al-Kursi.(b) The patient will raise both hands as in supplication, recite Surah An-Nas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah Al-Ikhlas, blow into both hands, and wipe over the entire body with both hands; this should be done three times. (al-Bukhari and Muslim)(c) Recite Surah As-Saffat in the morning, and recite Surah Ad-Dukhan at bedtime at night, or at least listen to these two surahs.4. Recite or listen to Surah Al-Baqarah every three days.5. Recite the following du'a seven times every day in the morning and evening:فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّـهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ ﴿١٢٩﴾Translation: But if they turn away, say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne." (Surah At-Tawbah: 129)6. Recite the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah every night before sleeping. (al-Bukhari and Muslim)7. At bedtime, the patient will recite this du'a:بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَأَخْسِئْ شَيْطَانِي وَفُكَّ رِهَانِي، وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي النَّدِيِّ الْأَعْلَي8. Record the following surahs on a cassette and have the patient listen to them three times daily: Surah Fussilat, Surah Al-Fath, and Surah Al-Jinn.Continue like this for one month; in sha Allah, the patient will be cured.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Making Someone Physically Ill Through Magic
ruqyah_articles.text:
Symptoms of This Sihr1. Having constant pain in any organ of the body.2. Tremors or convulsions occurring in the body and falling unconscious.3. Any organ of the body becoming paralyzed.4. The whole body becoming lifeless.5. Any one of the five senses failing to work.One thing must be clarified here: these symptoms also occur in normal illnesses. However, to distinguish between them, if ruqyah is performed by reciting the Qur'an over the patient, and if the patient feels any convulsion and becomes numb, or falls unconscious, or a trembling occurs in the body, or feels pain in the head, then it must be understood that sihr has been done to the patient. And if this does not happen, it must be understood that this is a normal illness, and its treatment must be done by a doctor.

* * *

How This Sihr OccursIt is known to everyone that the human brain is the root of all parts; the brain directs any part of the body, and when danger comes, it protects the organ by giving danger signals. And that takes place in less than a second.فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِTranslation: This is the creation of Allah; so show me what those other than Him have created! (Surah Luqman: 11)When a person is afflicted by this type of sihr, the jinn brings the person's brain under control. Then whichever organ the magician instructs to cause trouble in, the jinn causes trouble in that very organ. Therefore, the jinn may influence the center point of human hearing or sight, or influence a nerve connected to the brain that relates to an organ; in this situation, the organ may fall into three states:Its Three States:1. Either the jinn, aided from Allah [i.e., by Allah's leave], deadens the motor power in an organ all at once, whereupon that organ becomes completely paralyzed, resulting in the patient becoming completely blind or losing hearing.2. Or the jinn, by the very power of Allah, paralyzes the motor power of an organ and at other times releases it, as a result of which that organ sometimes becomes well and then becomes afflicted again.3. Or, while the motor power of the patient's brain continues to run normally, it snatches away an organ of his so that there is no movement left, due to which the functioning of the organs is obstructed even though it is not paralyzed. And Allah Ta'ala says regarding the magicians:وَمَا هُمْ بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ اللّٰهِTranslation: "And they cannot harm anyone through it except by the permission of Allah." (Surah Al-Baqarah: 102)This ayah proves that a magician cannot harm anyone except by the will of Allah. Therefore, all diseases and afflictions occur by the will of Allah and relief is attained by the will of Allah. Many doctors do not want to accept that cure occurs by the will of Allah through ruqyah even without medicine. However, after seeing practical proof, they are compelled to accept it.A doctor came to me and started saying, "I have come regarding a matter that has astonished me." I asked, "What is that matter?" He said, "A person brought a son of his to me who was afflicted with polio, meaning his child's body was in a paralyzed state. When I did a check-up and found out that he was afflicted with such a spinal disease for which there is no treatment. Surgery is also futile; but after a few weeks, when the man came to me and I asked about his boy whose four limbs were paralyzed, he said: 'Alhamdulillah, now he sits and even walks along the wall.'"I asked him, "From whom did you seek treatment for your child?"In reply he said, "From Shaykh Wahid."The doctor said, "That is why I have come to you to know the matter of how you treated him." I said to that doctor, "I recited verses of the Qur'an, blew onto black seed oil, and told them to massage it onto the paralyzed limbs. Allah Ta'ala healed that servant. All of this is Allah's grace; there is nothing with me."

* * *

Treatment for This Type of Sihr1. Just as I have described earlier, after reciting the verses of the Qur'an three times in front of the patient, if the patient becomes unconscious, treatment must be carried out following the same method.2. And if the patient does not become unconscious and only slight symptoms appear, then the following method must be adopted: record onto a cassette Surah Al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi, Surah Ad-Dukhan, Surah Al-Jinn, and Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas, the short surahs from Surah Al-Bayyinah to Surah An-Nas, and give it to the patient. And the patient will listen to it three times every day.In addition, recite the following du'as, verses, and surahs, blow onto black seed oil, give it to the patient, and instruct with emphasis to massage it onto the patient's forehead and painful areas morning and evening.Those verses and surahs are these: 1. Surah Al-Fatihah, 2. Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas3. Recite this verse seven times.وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاۤءࣱ وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِینَTranslation: "And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers" (Surah 17:82)4.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ وَاللَّهُ يشْفِيْك مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عيْنِ حَاسِدٍ اللَّهُ يشْفِيْكTransliteration: Bismillahi arqeeka min kulli shay'in yu'dheeka min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'aynin aw haasidin, Allahu yashfeeka"Translation: In the name of Allah, I perform ruqyah on you from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul and every eye and every envier, I perform ruqyah on you. May Allah grant you cure. [Sahih (Albani) Sunan Ibn Majah: 3523]5.اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اِشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًاTransliteration: Allaahumma rabban-naas, adh-hibil-ba's, ishfi, wa antash-shaafee, laa shifaa'a illaa shifaa'uka, shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamaTranslation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the difficulty, grant healing, You are the Giver of shifa or health, there is no shifa except Your shifa (granting health or curing disease), grant shifa in such a way after which no illness or disease remains.Perform this practice for up to 60 days. If he recovers, then well and good; otherwise, perform the said ruqyah a second time, then administer the same method. Just like the second time, adopt the procedure in accordance with what is needed in view of his condition.

* * *

Some Examples of This Type of TreatmentA Girl Who Has Not Spoken for a MonthA girl had lost the power of speech for a month. She came to me with her brother and father. They said that her mouth had become closed in such a way that her mouth had to be opened by force just for eating and drinking. They said that she had been in such a state for 35 days. Then, when I recited the Qur'an over her and she listened to it, she started speaking, alhamdulillah! Then she regained her power of speech.A Jinn Holding a Woman's Leg:A woman came to me and said that she had severe pain in her leg. I thought that perhaps her leg had become like this due to some illness, because she could not lift her leg at all.Nevertheless, I started performing ruqyah. As soon as the woman heard Surah Al-Fatihah, she fell unconscious. And the jinn started speaking; it said that it was holding this woman's leg. I said to it, "If you wish to attain the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala, come out from inside this woman." Alhamdulillah, the jinn came out from that woman, and she started walking.A Jinn Had Twisted a Man's Face:One day, a man came to me whose face was turned to the right side. When I performed the said ruqyah on him, the jinn spoke: "This man caused me harm, which is why I turned his face." Then I admonished and advised the jinn, as a result of which, alhamdulillah, the jinn left that man. And that man stood up healthy, and his face became straight as well.The Incident of a Girl in Whose Treatment Even Doctors Were Helpless:One day, a man came and told me that his daughter had suddenly become panicked and fell unconscious, and after that, she could not speak for two months. Now she can only hear. She cannot eat food, nor does she move any limb of her body. Currently, she is undergoing treatment at Abha Hospital in Saudi Arabia. The doctors said that every effort had been made for her; even one doctor said that all her reports were good, but the core reality and mystery behind it could not be understood. Now she is going through a critical time. A hole has been made in her throat for breathing. And food is given into her stomach through a tube in her nose so that the rest of her life can continue like this.I do not go to anyone for treatment, whoever it may be; since he came to me through a dear friend of mine and a prominent scholar, Shaykh Sa'eed bin Musfir al-Qahtani, I was compelled to go along.After obtaining special permission to enter the hospital, I reached the aforementioned girl for her treatment. There I saw that the girl was lying mute on her bed. She could only hear and see, but could not speak, nor could she move anything except her head, and she had become weak to such a state that no one knows except Allah. When I asked her about some symptoms, she gave a negative answer with her head. I could not understand what had happened to her; then I went to the mosque to pray salah, prayed there, made du'a to Allah for her recovery, and upon returning, I placed my hand on her head, recited Surah Al-Falaq, and recited the following du'a:اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اِشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِيْ لَا شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًاTransliteration: Allaahumma rabban-naas, adh-hibil-ba's, ishfi, wa antash-shaafee, laa shifaa'a illaa shifaa'uka, shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqama.Translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the difficulty, grant healing, You are the Giver of shifa or health, there is no shifa except Your shifa (granting health or curing disease), grant shifa in such a way after which no illness or disease remains. [Sahih al-Bukhari: 5743]Then, by the mercy of Allah Ta'ala, the girl began to speak. Her father and brother wept with joy. When her father wanted to kiss my head, I told him that I had no credit in this. All of this is the benevolence of Allah Ta'ala. Then the girl said, "I want to return home from the hospital." Then they took her home.The Jinn Showing the Location of the Sihr:A sick young man came to me. When I recited verses of the Qur'an before him, the jinn inside him started speaking: it was in charge of the sihr; such-and-such person had cast sihr on him. And the items of sihr were kept inside a pillar. Then I told the jinn to come out, whereupon it came out, alhamdulillah. And the patient's people found some torn pieces of paper under the pillar, on which some letters were written. They threw them into water and destroyed the sihr. Alhamdulillah, the patient became well.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Magic of Istihadah, That Is, Irregular Long-Term Uterine Bleeding
ruqyah_articles.text:
IntroductionOnly women are affected by this type of magic. The woman who is bewitched to cause bleeding, the magician sends a jinn into that woman's body, and that jinn then flows through her veins and blood, as:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Shaytan flows through the child of Adam like the flow of blood." (al-Bukhari and Muslim)When the jinn reaches a specific vein in the woman's uterus, it strikes it; as a result, blood continues to flow from that vein. In response to Hamnah bint Jahsh's question regarding the issue of istihadah, the Prophet (ﷺ) said that this is the result of a strike by Shaytan. (The hadith was narrated by at-Tirmidhi and is sahih) In another narration it is stated: "This is only blood from a vein, not menses." (an-Nasa'i and Musnad Ahmad)Combining both narrations, it is understood that istihadah occurs only when Shaytan strikes one of the veins present in the woman's uterus.

* * *

What Is the Magic of Bleeding?Muslim scholars have named this blood istihadah, and doctors in their terminology call it uterine discharge.Allamah Ibn al-Athir said, istihadah refers to blood flowing outside the designated period of menstruation. (An-Nihayah: 1/479) Its duration may be up to several months. The amount of blood is sometimes less and sometimes more.

* * *

Treatment for the Magic of BleedingOne should recite the above-mentioned ruqyah over water, drink that water, and bathe with it; upon using it for three days, the bleeding will stop by the command of Allah. Even after a long time has passed, if the flow of blood does not stop, then write this verse: "Likulli naba-in mustaqarr" (For every news there is a designated time) with clean ink, dissolve it in water, and have the patient drink it for two or three weeks. Insha'Allah, she will be cured from the illness.

* * *

A Real Example of the Treatment for This MagicA woman afflicted with this illness came to me. Then I performed ruqyah on her by reciting verses of the Qur'an and also gave her a Qur'an cassette to listen to.Alhamdulillah, she recovered within a few days. And Shaykh al-Islam Imam Ibn Taymiyyah (rahimahullah) gave the opinion on the permissibility of writing verses of the Qur'an with permissible ink, mixing them into water, drinking that water, and bathing with it. (Fatawa Ibn Taymiyyah: 19/64)

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Magic of Breaking Marriage
ruqyah_articles.text:
Symptoms of This Magic1. Considering the marriage suitor very bad.2. Constant restlessness prevailing in the brain. Having headaches at various times that cannot be cured by any medicine.3. Not finding comfort during sleep.4. Constantly feeling pain in the stomach.5. Feeling pain in the joints of the lower back.6. Mental distress, especially from Asr until midnight.

* * *

Description of How This Magic Is PerformedAn envious person opposed to marriage goes to a wicked magician and requests that he perform such magic on so-and-so's daughter that she refuses to get married.The magician tells him, this task is easy, you just bring some item belonging to that girl, such as hair, clothes, etc. And bring her name and her mother's name. After that, the work will be done easily. The magician assigns a jinn for this work. Then the jinn pursues that girl or boy. And finding them in any one of the following states, it enters them:1. A state of fear and terror.2. A state of extreme anger.3. A state of extreme heedlessness or negligence.4. A state of extreme sexual desire.In this case, the jinn takes one of two courses:1. Either it enters the girl and instills hatred in her heart, as a result of which she rejects whoever proposes to her.2. If it cannot enter the woman, it enters the boy and instills hatred in his heart, making him think that the bride is unattractive and ugly. Consequently, whoever proposes to that girl rejects her immediately afterwards without any reason, even though he had initially agreed. And that is due to the whisperings of Shaytan; in such circumstances, due to the severity of the magic, the man feels restlessness from the moment he goes to the woman's house for the proposal and departs from there quickly; the opposite may also occur.

* * *

Treatment for This Type of Magic1. You will perform ruqyah by reciting the mentioned verses and du'as. However, if the patient falls unconscious and the jinn begins to speak, even then the previously mentioned method must be adopted.2. And if the patient does not fall unconscious and feels other kinds of changes in the body, then they should be told to follow the instructions below:1. One must be punctual in performing all prayers at their proper times.2. One must stay away from music.3. Before going to sleep, perform wudu and recite Ayat al-Kursi.4. Before going to sleep, raise both hands, recite Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas, blow into the hands, and wipe the entire body (do this three times).5. Record Ayat al-Kursi repeatedly on a one-hour cassette and listen to it once daily.6. Record Surah Al-Falaq, An-Nas, and Al-Ikhlas repeatedly on another one-hour cassette and listen to it at least once daily.7. Recite the previously mentioned Qur'anic verses and du'as, blow over water, tell the patient to drink it, and have them bathe with that water; do this for three days. And perform the ghusl in a clean place.8. The patient must daily, after Fajr prayer,لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌTransliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu, wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeerTranslation: There is no true deity except Allah, He has no partner; dominion belongs to Him, and all praise is His; and He has power over all things.recite one hundred times.9. Observe the Shar'i hijab.One should continue this practice for up to one month. After that, one of two situations will occur:Insha'Allah, either they will be completely cured, or their distress will increase and the patient will faint when ruqyah is performed by reciting the Qur'an. In such a situation, the previously described method must be adopted.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Treatment of Sexual Impotence
ruqyah_articles.text: Magicians (may Allah curse them) can also overpower even a newly married couple through magic and make [the husband] impotent or sexually incapacitated, so that he cannot have intercourse with his wife. This sexual dysfunction is of two types:1. Sexual incapacitation or impotence in the case of the husband.2. Frigidity in the case of the wife.This problem can be diagnosed by asking the husband certain specific questions. The symptoms of sexual dysfunction are--pain in the thighs, a feeling of heaviness in the head along with a headache, and changes in mood. Once the problem of sexual dysfunction is diagnosed, the treatment is very easy and simple. First, seven lotus leaves should be taken and crushed between two stones, then this mixture should be mixed into a large pot of water. Then Surah Al-Fatihah, and the magic-nullifying Surah Yunus, Al-A'raf, Ta-Ha, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Falaq and Nas) must be recited.1. Surah Al-Fatihah: (1-7)بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿١﴾ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿٢﴾ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿٣﴾ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ﴿٤﴾ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ﴿٥﴾ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ﴿٦﴾ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ ﴿٧﴾Translation: (1) In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (2) All praise is for Allah, Lord of all creation. (3) The Merciful, the Especially Merciful, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (4) Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. (5) It is You we worship and You we ask for help. (6) Show us the straight path. Guide us to the path. (7) The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor. Those whom You have blessed. Not of those upon whom [Your] wrath has fallen, nor of those who are astray.2. Ayat al-Kursi (Al-Baqarah 2:255)اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾Translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him. He is the Self-Sufficient and the Ever-New Sustainer, the Sustainer of all things. Neither drowsiness nor sleep touches Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows all that is before them and all that is behind them. They cannot encompass anything of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving both of them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Supreme.3. Al-A'raf: (117-122)وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ﴿١١٧﴾ فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ ﴿١١٨﴾ فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ ﴿١١٩﴾ وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ ﴿١٢٠﴾ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿١٢١﴾ رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ﴿١٢٢﴾Translation: (117) And I inspired Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it swallowed the falsehood they had fabricated. (118) Thus the truth was established, and that which they were doing was nullified. (119) So they were defeated there and became humiliated. (120) And the magicians fell down in prostration. (121) They said, "We have believed in the Lord of all creation, (122) The Lord of Moses and Aaron."4. Surah Yunus: (81-82)فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ السِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ ﴿٨١﴾ وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ ﴿٨٢﴾Translation: (81) Then when they had thrown (their ropes and staffs), Moses said, "What you have brought is magic. Indeed, Allah will nullify it. Indeed, Allah does not rectify the work of corrupters." (82) And Allah establishes the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it.5. Surah Ta-Ha: (20:69)وَأَلْقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوا ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ ﴿٦٩﴾Translation: "And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow what they have crafted. What they have crafted is only the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he comes."6. The Surahs that are recited to seek protection from Allah--Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nasقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾Translation: (1) Say, "He is Allah, [Who is] One. (2) Allah is not dependent on anyone, everyone is dependent on Him. (3) He neither begets nor is He begotten. (4) Nor is there any equivalent to Him." (Surah Al-Ikhlas)قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾Translation: (1) Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, (2) From the evil of that which He created, (3) And from the evil of darkness when it settles, (4) And from the evil of the blowers in knots, (5) And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (Surah Al-Falaq)قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾Translation: (1) Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (2) The Sovereign of mankind, (3) The God of mankind, (4) From the evil of the whisperer who quickly withdraws, (5) Who whispers into the hearts of mankind, (6) From among jinn and mankind." (Surah An-Nas)Then the incapacitated person will pour the water over which the above-mentioned ruqyah was recited over his body and drink some of it, and bathe with the remaining portion for seven consecutive days. In addition, he will recite the above-mentioned ruqyah over olive oil and massage this oil on his body. In most cases, the problem of sexual dysfunction is cured from the very first bath.

ruqyah_articles.category: Ruqyah for Different Types of Magic
ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Some Important Points
ruqyah_articles.text: The one who wishes to get married will keep himself protected by seeking protection and refuge with Allah through dhikr and according to the method shown by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Sitting in the room where the marriage is solemnized, he will recite Surah Al-Baqarah, but he will not do what the ignorant village people do. Ignorant village people resort to magicians for sexual dysfunction, and taking advantage of this opportunity, Shaytan and evil jinn establish dominance over him and his wife. When he consummates the marriage through sexual intercourse with his wife, he will do the following things:1. He will place his hand on his wife's forehead and recite this du'a:اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكَ لِيْ فِيْهَاTransliteration: "Allaahumma, innee as-aluka khayrahaa wa khayra maa jabaltahaa 'alayhi, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa wa min sharri maa jabaltahaa 'alayhi. Allaahumma baarik lee feehaa"Translation: O Allah, I ask You for goodness, such goodness that You have placed in her (wife), and at the same time I seek refuge in You from evil influence, such evil as is in her; O Allah, grant me blessing.2. Both of them will begin this new life of theirs by performing two rak'ahs of nafl salah, and will pray to Allah for mercy.3. When he engages in intercourse with his wife, he will recite the following du'a:بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَاTransliteration: Bismillaahi, Allaahumma, jannibnash-shaytaana wa jannibish-shaytaana maa razaqtanaaTranslation: In the name of Allah, O Allah, keep Shaytan away from us and keep Shaytan away from whatever You provide for us.4. He will regularly do dhikr and continue to pray to Allah seeking protection.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Introduction
ruqyah_articles.text: Ruqyah baths are a very effective method to weaken the effects of magic. These baths should be an important part of the treatment. One has to motivate oneself and take the trouble to take these baths, because they are definitely worth the time and effort. One should recall that healing comes from Allah, so one should ask Him to heal one through the baths, and one should do this as regularly as possible.There are a few different variants of the Ruqyah bath, but they are all quite similar. The ingredients can vary (see "Variation of the Ruqyah Bath" below).One should not postpone the bath unnecessarily if one does not have a certain ingredient. The most important is anyway the recitation of the Qur'an on the water. Here, too, one should not go into extremes and let Satan induce doubts, e.g. that the pronunciation of the Arabic might not be good enough so that the Ruqyah would be ineffective. If one makes efforts, Allah will make the Rukyah work by His permission.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Ingredients
ruqyah_articles.text: 1. Saffron - 3 pinches2. Sidr (lote tree) leaves. 7 leaves, or 7 pinches if it is in powder form3. 3 table spoons of Apple cider vinegar4. Dead sea salt (coarse, not powdered)5. Orange blossom water6. Rosewater7. 1 litre of WaterMost of these ingredients can be found in 'middle eastern' or 'ethnic foods' stores, or can be ordered on the internet.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Method
ruqyah_articles.text: On all the ingredients should be recited. One can either recite on the ingredients individually in their own bottles or one can put the ingredients in a bowl and recite on the mixture. This is better because the shorter the time between recitation and usage, the more effective it is. One should recite (in Arabic) and then blow on the mixture, but with little spit, e.g. by slightly moistening the lips:Al-Fatitah (7-times)بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿١﴾ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿٢﴾ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿٣﴾ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ﴿٤﴾ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ﴿٥﴾ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ﴿٦﴾ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ ﴿٧﴾Translation: (1) In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (2) [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds - (3) The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, (4) Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. (5) It is You we worship and You we ask for help. (6) Guide us to the straight path - (7) The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.Al-Baqarah (2:1-5)الم ﴿١﴾ ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ ﴿٢﴾ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ ﴿٣﴾ وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ ﴿٤﴾ أُولَـٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ﴿٥﴾Translation: (1) Alif, Lam, Meem. (2) This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah - (3) Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them, (4) And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith]. (5) Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.Al-Baqarah (2:102) [7-times]وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا لَمَنِ اشْتَرَاهُ مَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٠٢﴾Translation: (102) And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But the two angels do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allah . And the people learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But the Children of Israel certainly knew that whoever purchased the magic would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.Al-Baqarah (2: 255) [Ayat-ul-kursi]اللّٰهُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيمُTranslation: (255) Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.Al-Baqarah (2:256)لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِالطَّاغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَىٰ لَا انفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ ‎﴿٢٥٦﴾‏Translation: (256) There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing. Al-Baqarah (2:257)اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَوْلِيَاؤُهُمُ الطَّاغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ النُّورِ إِلَى الظُّلُمَاتِ ۗ أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ ‎﴿٢٥٧﴾Translation: (257) Allah is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light. And those who disbelieve - their allies are Taghut. They take them out of the light into darknesses. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein.Al-Baqarah (2:284) لِّلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِن تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُم بِهِ اللَّهُ ۖ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‎﴿٢٨٤﴾Translation: (284) To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whom He wills and punish whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent. Al-Baqarah (2:285)آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ‎﴿٢٨٥﴾Translation: (285) The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination." Al-Baqarah (2:286)لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ‎﴿٢٨٦﴾‏Translation: (286) Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."Al-Araf (7:117-122)وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ﴿١١٧﴾ فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ ﴿١١٨﴾ فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ ﴿١١٩﴾ وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ ﴿١٢٠﴾ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿١٢١﴾ رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ﴿١٢٢﴾Translation: (117) And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying. (118) So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing. (119) And Pharaoh and his people were overcome right there and became debased. (120) And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah]. (121) They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds, (122) The Lord of Moses and Aaron."Yunus (10:79-82)وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ ‎﴿٧٩﴾‏ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ ‎﴿٨٠﴾‏ فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ السِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ ‎﴿٨١﴾‏ وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ ‎﴿٨٢﴾Translation: (79) And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician." (80) So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw." (81) And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is [only] magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters. (82) And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."Taha (20:65-69)قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ ‎﴿٦٥﴾‏ قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ ‎﴿٦٦﴾‏ فَأَوْجَسَ فِي نَفْسِهِ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ ‎﴿٦٧﴾‏ قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْأَعْلَىٰ ‎﴿٦٨﴾‏ وَأَلْقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوا ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ ‎﴿٦٩﴾Translation: (65) They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw." (66) He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes]. (67) And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses. (68) Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior. (69) And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."Al-Ikhlas (112)قُلْ هُوَ اللَّـهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّـهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾Translation: (1) Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge. (3) He neither begets nor is born, (4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent."Al-Falaq (113)قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾Translation: (1) Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (2) From the evil of that which He created (3) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (4) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (5) And from the evil of an envier when he envies."An-Naas (114)قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَـٰهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾Translation: (1) Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (2) The Sovereign of mankind. (3) The God of mankind, (4) From the evil of the retreating whisperer - (5) Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - (6) From among the jinn and mankind."Take a small amount of Apple cider vinegar and massage it into your head, enough to cover your scalp/hair.Fill up your bath with warm water from the tap as you would if you were having a normal bath. Pour the contents of the bowl/ingredients into the bath. Sit in the bath for 30 minutes and submerge yourself as much as you can in the water.After some time (10/20 minutes) take the bowl and pour the water over your head at least three times or as much as possible. This will wash out the cider vinegar from your hair. You should take the bath in the evening, because Jinn are more active at night, so they are then combated when they are just waking up, and one is better protected when they are active.This is the best and most effective method. If you follow these instructions, you will feel a difference, inshaAllah.It is important to continue with the daily safety measures, to do the obligatory prayers on time, and to read as much as possible Qur'an, especially Sura alBaqarah. The etiquettes for sleeping should be observed to one's best ability (see appendix) and the daily Dhikr.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Important
ruqyah_articles.text: You may hesitate to get into the bath - this is shaytaan doing his utmost to put doubts in your mind and put you off doing the bath as, by Allah's will, it will weaken and hurt them. If you feel yourself hesitating or doubting, say 'Bismillah' and go forth. Don't think about it, just go ahead and do it.It is possible that you may feel like you are in pain and that the bath is causing you pain. This is actually a GOOD sign because this means your body is healing inshaAllah. One should then do his best and try to endure the pain. Even if you do not feel pain or something else, you should continue with the bath.Do the baths for seven days in a row. Don't falter - be strong in your resolve and have confidence that Allah will help you through the recitation and the Ruqya which you have done. After seven days you should continue with the bath as often as possible but at least once every two days. The more you do it the better.Sometimes it is necessary to support the treatment with hijamah (cupping) so that the magic can get out. You have to put the cupping head as close as possible to where the symptoms are.Hijamah is not difficult and harmless when practiced with some care. However, it would go beyond the purpose of this book to explain the techniques more closely. Yet, it should not be difficult to learn basic knowledge over the Internet and to consult a practitioner.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Variant of the Ruqyah bath and cleaning of the house of Jinn or Sihr
ruqyah_articles.text: Take 20 liters of water (preferably rainwater, as there are most probably no 20 liters of Zam-Zam water available) and recite the same verses as mentioned in the previous chapter and blow / spit on the water like described. This each 11 times.Drink two glasses of this water.Two glasses pour into the bath water and bath or shower with it.Two glasses of the water are poured into a small bucket of water, stirr and then fill the water into a spray bottle like one uses for flowers. Then spray the interior of the whole house, also under the furniture, in the oven, washing machine, sink, fireplace, windows and doors (also the outside), especially the door threshold of the entrance door and the marriage bed. In the bathroom, first close the toilet and then sprinkle the rest. Outside only the windows, doors and corners of the house. If you have a business, especially the warehouse where the goods are kept, and all machines.It is important to say "Bismillah" before spraying, so that the Jinn have the opportunity to avoid the water and are not burnt by it, because it could hit believing Jinn and those who not do evil.This is done for 11 days. If the 20 liters are finished, prepare another 20 liters.One should not be amazed or frightened when one hears sighs, sees smoke as if something would burn, one smells burned things or sees dying animals in one's dream (rats, snakes, lizards, etc). This is a sign that the Ruqyah has worked.In addition, candles can be recited on, preferably scented candles. Recite on them 30 times Ayat-ul-kursi, ignite them and let them burn for an hour in every room. This can also be done with wood, which is burned in the fireplace.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: The Concept of the Evil Eye (ayn)
ruqyah_articles.text: A person who afflicts others by the evil eye is known as "Al-A'in" and a person affected by the evil eye is called "Al-Ma'yoon". Ibn Al Qayyim (R) said in his book Zaad al Ma'ad: "It is the arrow that is taken out from the soul of the envious individual, the one whom causes the affliction of the evil eye, and then it is fired upon the subject of the evil eye. This individual can be affected sometimes and manage to escape it at other times. If one encounters this and is exposed to it then there will be no protection from its effect, however it then becomes imperative if one encounters this to take care and prepare themselves with the best defence and not allow it to be implanted upon them. It is in this manner that a person can protect themselves from the envious individual and not be affected by them. Sometimes these arrows return to the one whom they belong and this archery makes the envious individual feel the same negativity in his life like the negatively he tried to push on the subject.Allah (ﷻ) says: وَإِن يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ ﴿٥١﴾ Translation: "And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message and they say, "Indeed, he is mad.'" (Al-Qalam: 51)Ibn Katheer (R) uses this verse as evidence to show that the evil eye is real and that it has the ability to affect people since Allah (ﷻ) mentions 'those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message'.An incident which is narrated from the time of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) saw Quraish ask some people who were known to give the evil eye to another person which could cause illness, death or some other effect to put it on the Prophet (ﷺ). However, Allah (ﷻ) protected the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) from those who were intent on destroying him with Ayn.Ibnul Qayyim (R) mentioned in his book Zaad al Ma'ad that some people have denied the effects of Ayn; and he describes these people as arrogant with no knowledge.According to some scholars the concept of effecting a person with the evil eye (Ayn) can be likened to the effect of when a person walks into a room and they feel embarrassment or shyness due to people looking at them, perhaps causing the face to change colour. Another example could be where someone sees someone they fear and they become pale in the face.Ibnul Qayyim (R) describes it as a physical or spiritual effect that leaves the eye and affects the human being.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: The Different Types Of Evil Eye (ayn)
ruqyah_articles.text: There are different types of Evil Eye which a person can become afflicted with. They are:(العين) Ayn - The eye from someone who may love or know you and not have evil intentions towards you.(الحســـد) Hasad - The envious eye from someone who hates or dislikes you or something you have but wants it removed from you..(النفس) Nafs - The admiring eye which a person can put on themself.(النظرة) Nathara - The evil eye which comes from the Jinn.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Evidence for the different types of Evil Eye
ruqyah_articles.text: AynThe Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The evil eye is real and if anything were to overtake Qadr (divine decree), it would have been the evil eye…". This alludes to the speed of the evil eye and expresses that if anything was to overtake the decree of Allah it would have been the evil eye, i.e. in its speed.HasadIblees envied Adam (AS) as he disliked his creation and the fact he was ordered to prostrate to him. He thought he was better because he was made from fire and Adam (AS) was created from clay. Therefore it was only envy which pushed iblees to transgress and disobey the order of Allah (ﷻ).NafsThe Prophet (ﷺ) "Whoever among you sees something in himself or in his possessions or in his brother that he likes, let him pray for blessings for it because the evil eye is real."Narrated by Ibn al-Sunni, Al-Haakim and classed as saheeh by Al-Albaani 243.NatharaThis originates from the evil eye of a Jinn. The evidence for this is the narration of Umm Salamah (RA) who said the Prophet (ﷺ) saw in her house a slave girl with a discolouration on her face so he said: "Perform Ruqyah for her, for she has been afflicted by the eye of a Jinn."From the above, we see that the evil eye can be given by a human or by a Jinn. It is also known that animals can give the evil eye too when they look at something. There are many stories and encounters concerning this and Allah knows best.

ruqyah_articles.subcategory: Evidence For The Existance Of Envy
