perfect words of Allah from every devil, all harmful creatures and insects, and from every kind of evil eye.3. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيْكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيْكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنٍ حَاسِدٍ، اَللَّهُ يَشْفِيكْ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيْكَTransliteration: Bismillaahi arqeek, min kulli shay'in yu'zeek, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'aynin haasidin, Allaahu yashfeek, Bismillaahi arqeekTranslation: In the name of Allah Ta'ala, the Most Merciful, I recite ruqyah for you, from everything harmful to you, may Allah protect you from the evil of every soul or envier's eye, in the name of Allah Ta'ala, the Most Merciful, I recite ruqyah for you.4.بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ يُبْرِيْكَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ يَشْفِيْكَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ وَشَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي عَيْنٍTransliteration: Bismillaahi yubreeka wa min kulli daa'in yashfeeka wa min sharri haasidin idhaa hasad wa min sharri kulli dhee 'aynin.Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, may He grant you healing, may He cure you from all kinds of illnesses, and may Allah protect everyone from all kinds of envy and evil of an envier and from the effects of the evil eye.There are more duas and ruqyahs for protection from harm that a sick person can recite for himself; Ibn al-Qayyim (rahimahullah) mentioned some such duas in his book Zad al-Ma'ad:1. أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُTransliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammaatillatee laa yujaawizuhunna barrun wa laa faajirun, min sharri maa khalaqa wa bara'a wa dhara'a, wa min sharri maa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wa min sharri maa ya'ruju feehaa, wa min sharri maa dhara'a fil-ardi, wa min sharri maa yakhruju minhaa, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wan-nahaari, wa min sharri kulli taariqin illaa taariqan yatruqu bikhayrin yaa RahmaanTranslation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which cannot be surpassed by any righteous or wicked person, from the evil of what He has created, made, and scattered, from the evil of what descends from heaven and from the evil of what ascends into it, from the evil of what is scattered in the earth and from the evil of what comes out of it, from the evil of the trials of night and day, and from the evil of every visitor except a visitor who arrives with goodness, O Most Merciful.2.أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُوْنِTransliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammati (taammaati) min ghadabihee wa 'iqaabihee wa (min) sharri 'ibaadihee, wa min hamazaatish-shayaateeni wa an yahduroonTranslation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, from His wrath and anger, from His punishment, from the evil of His creation, from the whisperings or incitements of the devils, and from their presence near me.3.اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ وَكَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ اللّٰهُمَّ، أَنْتَ تَكْشِفُ الْمَغْرَمَ وَالْمَأْثَمَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لَا يُهْزَمُ جُنْدُكَ، وَلَا يَخْلُفُ وَعَدُكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَTransliteration: Allahumma inni a'oodhu biwajhikal-kareem wa kalimaatikat-taammaati min sharri maa anta aakhidhu bi naasiyatih, Allahumma anta takshiful-maghrama wal-ma'thama, Allahumma innahu laa yuhzamu junduka wa laa yukhlafu wa'duka, subhaanaka wa bihamdika.Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge through Your noble grace and perfect words from the evil of that which You seize in full control. O Allah, forgive my sins and relieve nervous strain. O Allah, Your army can never be defeated, Your promise can never be broken; all glory and praise are Yours alone.4.اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّيْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا وَأَحْصِيْ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ عَدَدًا. اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرِكِهِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّيْ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍTransliteration: "Allahumma anta rabbi laa ilaaha illaa anta 'alayka tawakkaltu wa anta rabbul-'arshil-'azeem. Maashaa'Allaahu kaana wa maa lam yasha' lam yakun wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah. A'lamu annallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer wa annallaaha ahaata bikulli shay'in 'ilman wa ahsaa kulla shay'in 'adadaa. Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa sharakihi wa min sharri kulli daabbatin anta aakhidhun bi naasiyatihi, inna rabbi 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem."Translation: "O Allah, O my Lord, there is no god except You. In You is all my trust, and You are the Lord of the sacred Mighty Throne. Whatever Allah wills happens, and whatever He does not will never happens. There is no power and no strength except with Allah. I know that Allah Ta'ala is capable of doing all things; everything that exists all around and everything that happens is within Allah's knowledge, and He has numbered all things in count. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil of myself, I pray for protection from Shaytan and his trap, and I also seek refuge from the evil of all those creations which You seize under Your complete control. Surely, my Lord is on a straight path."Then he said: Those who recite these duas and supplications for seeking refuge should also have knowledge of their benefits and importance. By Allah's will and permission, these duas protect people from the attack of the evil eye and nullify the evil eye, but this will depend on the strength of faith of the reciter of the dua, the strength of his soul, receptivity, the strength of his trust in Allah, and the firmness of his heart. Because these duas are a kind of weapon, and when a person uses this weapon, it works very well. [Zad al-Ma'ad, 4/170]
